racial.glitchDescription: Surprised. This simple log makes an effective seat.
racial.humanDescription: It's a log. Yessir I like it.
racial.hylotlDescription: Most of the logs I've sat on have been floating.
racial.novakidDescription: Looks perfect for sittin' on round a campfire.

missing.description: A glowing orb. It looks like there's room to store things inside.

racial.apexDescription: This plant emits a sickly green glow.
racial.avianDescription: A glowing plant, the orb is hollow inside.
racial.glitchDescription: Astonished. This orb is an impressive natural light source.
racial.humanDescription: There's room to store quite a few things inside this little orb.
racial.hylotlDescription: The light this orb casts is hauntingly beautiful.
racial.novakidDescription: It don't look like much, but you never know what's hidin' inside.

missing.description: Lots of tempting buttons that should probably be left alone.

racial.apexDescription: I wonder what this button does...
racial.avianDescription: Will something happen if I push this button?
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. What will pressing these buttons do?
racial.humanDescription: All of these buttons to press! What could possibly go wrong?
racial.hylotlDescription: Before pressing buttons on this panel I should make sure I'm prepared for anything.
racial.novakidDescription: There's buttons here, I wonder what'll happen if I push 'em all.

missing.description: Large logs assembled as a construction platform.

racial.apexDescription: These logs are arranged to support great weight.
racial.avianDescription: This assembly looks like it's made for building a large structure.
racial.floranDescription: Floran ssstand on platform, leap down on unsssuspecting enemies.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. How were Floran able to move these enormous logs into place?
racial.humanDescription: If I played a game with this, it'd be a platform game.
racial.hylotlDescription: A very structurally solid construction platform.
racial.novakidDescription: A whole mess o' logs stacked up for standin' on.

missing.description: Large logs arranged as a construction staging platform.

racial.apexDescription: These logs look stacked to aid in construction.
racial.avianDescription: This platform looks designed to support builders.
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. This crude platform could fall apart at any minute.
racial.humanDescription: This large staging platform looks like it could support a lot of weight.
racial.hylotlDescription: It seems like this is a temporary structure, intended to be taken apart and moved.
racial.novakidDescription: These logs make a pretty solid lookin' platform.

missing.description: A prison torture rack. It's not a stretch to say this would hurt.

racial.apexDescription: Big Ape uses similar devices when interrogating prisoners.
racial.avianDescription: A stretching rack. Torture is so barbaric.
racial.floranDescription: Floran sstretch on this rack until they talk.
racial.glitchDescription: Disapproving. Floran still practice torture against their prisoners.
racial.humanDescription: I've always fancied being a bit taller.
racial.hylotlDescription: I've seen so much Floran brutality that this doesn't shock me.
racial.novakidDescription: I wouldn't want to find myself strapped up on this awful thing.

missing.description: An empty shelving rack.

racial.apexDescription: A shelf made from reinforced plant material.
racial.avianDescription: Some empty shelves.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I wonder what this shelf was used to hold.
racial.humanDescription: A Floran shelving rack made from plants and wood.
racial.hylotlDescription: A simple shelf rack made from natural materials.
racial.novakidDescription: Whatever was sittin' on this shelf ain't here now.

missing.description: This torch is wrapped in a plant covering.

racial.apexDescription: A burning torch, held together by a plant.
racial.avianDescription: The plant wrapped around this torch isn't singed by the flames.
racial.floranDescription: Floran usse special plantss to contain fire.
racial.glitchDescription: Surprised. This torch is made from a plant that does not burn.
racial.humanDescription: I can't believe the plant this torch is made from isn't burning up.
racial.hylotlDescription: Some component of the plant in this torch is fuelling the flame.
racial.novakidDescription: How's the plant holding this torch not burnin' up?

missing.description: An arcane torture device. Best not to ask how it's used.

racial.apexDescription: Is this a torture device or a fountain?
racial.avianDescription: Some cruel and unusual form of punishment.
racial.floranDescription: Floran quiver in fear at sssight of this.
racial.glitchDescription: Discontent. A particularly unpleasant method of torture, especially for Glitch.
racial.humanDescription: Cool, a relaxing water feature.
racial.hylotlDescription: The one Floran torture device that simply won't work on Hylotl. A minor victory.
racial.novakidDescription: What is this, some kinda fountain?

missing.description: This would be a neat venue for a stall.

racial.apexDescription: I am not a fan of Mazebound64. I've heard horror stories about Miniknog testing... Mazes give me the creeps.
racial.avianDescription: Mazebound64 was developed by an Avian team. There aren't many Avian video games... Perhaps I should make some.
racial.floranDescription: Floran thinksss Mazebound64 is big bore. Not even meats at the end.
racial.glitchDescription: Determined. I will escape from this hellish labyrinth and defeat Mazebound64 once and for all! 8/10.
racial.humanDescription: Mazebound64 is reminiscent of some of the very first video games from Earth. It's very charming.
racial.hylotlDescription: Navigating dimly lit corridors, just steps away from freedom... Mazebound64 is beautiful in its simplicity.
racial.novakidDescription: Mazebound64? Mazes are a big ol' waste of time.

racial.avianDescription: Super Tralgar Blaster 2 is all about waging war across the stars.
racial.floranDescription: Pew pew pew! Floran shoot down all the shipsss in Super Tralgar Blassster 2.

racial.novakidDescription: It's a game called Super Tralgar Blaster 2. Nothin' like a good ol' fashioned space shoot-out.

missing.description: I wouldn't want to find myself locked behind these thick iron bars.

racial.apexDescription: An iron cell door.
racial.avianDescription: The Avians used doors much like these to guard their tombs.
racial.glitchDescription: Surprised. This looks similar to the cell doors in Glitch dungeons.
racial.humanDescription: Looks like the kind of door you'd find on a cell.
racial.hylotlDescription: An oppressive door.
racial.novakidDescription: I betcha' some varmint has found themselves behind doors like these.

missing.description: A small barred vent.

racial.apexDescription: A standard vent.
racial.avianDescription: Ventilation. I can feel a breeze ruffle my feathers
racial.glitchDescription: Acknowledgement. A vent.
racial.humanDescription: Looks like a vent.
racial.hylotlDescription: Some simple yet strong ventilation.
racial.novakidDescription: A sturdy lookin' vent.

missing.description: A metal sign with a biohazard symbol.

racial.apexDescription: A universal symbol for biohazard. Best be careful.

racial.floranDescription: Sssymbol means something! Floran doesn't know!
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I suppose I am meant to know what this symbol means?
racial.humanDescription: This is an age-old symbol meaning 'Beware! Bad stuff!'
racial.hylotlDescription: This ugly symbol is a warning of sorts.
racial.novakidDescription: Is this here sign advertising some new Novakid brand?

missing.description: A bird's nest with an egg in it.

racial.apexDescription: A bird's nest with an egg in it. I wonder if the egg is viable.
racial.avianDescription: A sweet little bird's nest. How adorable!
racial.glitchDescription: Informed. Nests like these are how birds populate offspring.
racial.humanDescription: It's a bird's nest. I wonder if there are little baby birds in there.
racial.hylotlDescription: A bird's nest. Nature.
racial.novakidDescription: Must be some tiny birds to live'n a nest that small.

missing.description: A cold blue light.

racial.apexDescription: These lights give off a cold blue hue.

racial.floranDescription: Floran thinksss blue is okay colour. Not asss good as green or red!
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. Why does this light make me feel so cold?
racial.humanDescription: Blue lights, for when you want to give a room a cool atmosphere.
racial.hylotlDescription: This blue light reminds me of sunbeam filtered through sapphire oceans.
racial.novakidDescription: This light's like a cold burnin' star, though a little smaller.

racial.hylotlDescription: A wooden crate. It's functional, but not very pretty.
racial.novakidDescription: A simple lookin' crate made from wood.

racial.hylotlDescription: A simple wood and metal crate.

racial.hylotlDescription: Delightful little bugs.
racial.novakidDescription: This little tumble weed is all covered in bugs.

racial.apexDescription: A metallic ceiling light fixture.
racial.avianDescription: This hanging ceiling light is crafted from copper.
racial.floranDescription: Shiny metal light issn't hot to touch.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This electric light prevents copper around it from becoming hot.
racial.humanDescription: A device you attach to your head, and... wait, no, it's just a light.
racial.hylotlDescription: An industrial ceiling light made from copper.
racial.novakidDescription: A shiny lookin' copper light.

missing.description: An oil lantern made of copper.

racial.apexDescription: A copper lantern burning oil as fuel.
racial.avianDescription: Fuel keeps this lantern flame alight.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This lantern contains oil.
racial.humanDescription: A simple copper lantern.
racial.hylotlDescription: The fuel in this lantern would not burn under the sea.
racial.novakidDescription: A lantern made outta copper.

missing.description: A wall shelf made from copper.

racial.apexDescription: It's a wall shelf made from copper.
racial.avianDescription: A mounted copper wall shelf.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This wall shelf is made from copper.
racial.humanDescription: It's a wall shelf crafted from copper.
racial.hylotlDescription: A copper wall shelf of very basic design.
racial.novakidDescription: A copper shelf hangin' on the wall.

missing.description: A copper structural support beam.

racial.apexDescription: A copper support beam.
racial.avianDescription: A metal structural support.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This copper beam is not actually supporting any structural weight.
racial.humanDescription: It's a copper support beam.
racial.hylotlDescription: A solidly constructed copper support.
racial.novakidDescription: A big ol' copper beam.

missing.description: Sell food and produce to Terramart from the comfort of your own doorstep, by blasting it into space.

racial.apexDescription: Put the produce in the crate, fire the crate into space, get pixels for the produce. Very handy.
racial.avianDescription: A crate that can be launched into space? If you're going to sell produce, this is the way to do it.
racial.floranDescription: Sselling stuff is boring... Unless you fire a crate into sspace to do it!
racial.glitchDescription: Excited. A space shipping system! I can sell produce to Terramart by firing it into space!
racial.humanDescription: I can blast stuff into space with this! And if it's the right stuff, I'll get paid to do it!
racial.hylotlDescription: This device launches crates into space. A somewhat novel way of selling produce...
racial.novakidDescription: Fireworks ain't got nothing on a produce shippin' crate you can fire into space.

missing.description: An antiquated computer terminal, with a deep red display.

racial.apexDescription: The screen on this computer terminal is a menacing red.
racial.avianDescription: This looks like an old computer terminal. It seems to be running well, despite its age.
racial.floranDescription: Floran wantsss to know why box is ssso red.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This old computer seems to be running smoothly despite minimal maintenance.
racial.humanDescription: Ouch, computer display that is only red. That must be a strain on the eyes.
racial.hylotlDescription: This computer has a very off-putting colour scheme, that much is certain.
racial.novakidDescription: This ol' thing was probably more impressive a century ago.

missing.description: This station seems to be transmitting a lot of data.

racial.apexDescription: It appears to be processing a lot of data.
racial.avianDescription: This machine looks like it's working hard.
racial.glitchDescription: Analytical. This terminal appears to be processing topographical data about the planet.
racial.humanDescription: It's some sort of computer station. It looks important, so I probably shouldn't touch it.
racial.hylotlDescription: This station appears to be processing a large amount of information.
racial.novakidDescription: Some fancy computer with all kinds of flashy panels.

missing.description: This durasteel elevator will get the job done.

racial.apexDescription: A sturdy elevator.
racial.avianDescription: The easiest way to get around a multilevel facility.
racial.glitchDescription: Bored. An uninspiring elevator.
racial.humanDescription: An elevator for getting up and down levels.
racial.hylotlDescription: A sleek durasteel elevator.
racial.novakidDescription: Some kinda elevator, useful!

missing.description: This durasteel elevator will get the job done.

racial.apexDescription: A sturdy elevator.
racial.avianDescription: The easiest way to get around a multilevel facility.
racial.glitchDescription: Bored. An uninspiring elevator.
racial.humanDescription: An elevator for getting up and down levels.
racial.hylotlDescription: A sleek durasteel elevator.
racial.novakidDescription: Some kinda elevator, useful!

missing.description: This chair is egg-shaped. I'm not sure whose idea that was.

racial.apexDescription: This is style gone mad.
racial.avianDescription: An egg-shaped chair. I feel very comfortable sitting in it.
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. This chair design does not support proper posture.
racial.humanDescription: It's not very practical, but it looks cool!
racial.hylotlDescription: Style over substance.
racial.novakidDescription: A big ol' egg lookin' chair.

missing.description: It's some sort of electrical barrier. Looks dangerous...

racial.apexDescription: This current forms a shield to keep things from passing through.
racial.avianDescription: A door fashioned from electricity? Remarkable.
racial.floranDescription: Door sssizzless, Floran don't like electric doorss.
racial.glitchDescription: Unconcerned. The current here is completely grounded, there is no danger.
racial.humanDescription: It's a gate made from electricity. Who makes a door like this?
racial.hylotlDescription: The Hylotl are very cautious with electrical currents.
racial.novakidDescription: A big rowdy spark of electric energy.

missing.description: A cheap electric light.

racial.apexDescription: A small electrical light.
racial.avianDescription: Electricity harnessed to produce a simple light.
racial.glitchDescription: Approving. This basic light can be mounted on most surfaces.
racial.humanDescription: A basic light mounted up.
racial.hylotlDescription: Just an ordinary looking light.
racial.novakidDescription: Just a little hangin' electric light.

missing.description: A string of small, twinkling fairy lights.

racial.apexDescription: These little lights are quite pretty.
racial.avianDescription: It's hard not to love these pretty little lights.
racial.glitchDescription: Contentment. These twinkling lights help build a relaxed atmosphere.
racial.humanDescription: I've always been fond of fairy lights.
racial.hylotlDescription: Such simple beauty.
racial.novakidDescription: Bunch'a sparklin' li'l lights all strung up.

missing.description: A fiery-looking flower in a pot.

racial.apexDescription: The petals of this flower look like tongues of flame.
racial.avianDescription: The movement of this flower in the breeze looks like fire.
racial.glitchDescription: Amazed. The colour and shape of this flower closely resemble fire.
racial.humanDescription: A beautiful soft flower, what power does it hold?
racial.hylotlDescription: Flowers on the surface are so vibrant.
racial.novakidDescription: A fancy lookin' flower growin' in a pot.

missing.description: Little glowing bugs appear to be living in this bush.

racial.apexDescription: Beautiful fireflies wheel and dance.
racial.avianDescription: These tiny creatures make me long to soar.
racial.floranDescription: Floran eat glowy flies with fruit.
racial.glitchDescription: Amazed. These fireflies fly in a hypnotic pattern.
racial.humanDescription: Fireflies, they're attracted to this bush for some reason.
racial.hylotlDescription: At times the beauty of nature is overwhelming.
racial.novakidDescription: These bugs are all lit up like tiny candles.

missing.description: An Apex flag. The symbol of the Miniknog. Use ^green;[E]^white; to bookmark a teleportation location.

racial.apexDescription: An Apex flag. I can use this as a waypoint for teleportation.
racial.avianDescription: This Apex flag can be bookmarked as a destination for my ship teleporter.
racial.floranDescription: Apex flag makess good point to teleport back to ussing teleporter!
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. A small locator module attached to this Apex flag allows it to be bookmarked for teleportation.
racial.humanDescription: This Apex flag can be saved as a location for my teleporter. Then I can return to it any time.
racial.hylotlDescription: This Apex flag can act as a way point, enabling me to return to this point using a teleporter.
racial.novakidDescription: I can bookmark this Apex flag for quick teleportin'.

missing.description: If I look at these lights any longer, I'll probably go blind.

racial.apexDescription: Blazingly bright lights.
racial.avianDescription: A light such as this could turn night into day!
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. I can see clearly with these lights shining.
racial.humanDescription: Floodlights that live up to their name.
racial.hylotlDescription: The Hylotl use similar lights to illuminate beneath the ocean.
racial.novakidDescription: These big lamps are brighter'n a summer sun.

missing.description: This fluorescent light has seen better days.

racial.apexDescription: This light has only the faintest flicker of power. Perhaps it can be repaired.
racial.avianDescription: This light is almost completely broken.
racial.glitchDescription: Displeased. This fluorescent light is almost non-functional.
racial.humanDescription: A broken light that flickers faintly.
racial.hylotlDescription: This light appears to not be functioning correctly.
racial.novakidDescription: This busted light ain't flickerin' more'n a candle.

missing.description: Bright fluorescent light.

racial.apexDescription: The light here is unnatural and unattractive.
racial.avianDescription: This light is harsh and cold.
racial.glitchDescription: Irritated. The light buzzes gently while turned on.
racial.humanDescription: I've always hated lights like these.
racial.hylotlDescription: The light this gives off is very synthetic.
racial.novakidDescription: This fancy light is buzzin' like flies 'round a mule.

missing.description: Let's find out what that fossil was! Place it down and smash it open!

racial.apexDescription: -todo-
racial.avianDescription: -todo-
racial.glitchDescription: -todo-
racial.humanDescription: -todo-
racial.hylotlDescription: -todo-

missing.description: A beautiful stone fountain. The water looks refreshing.

racial.apexDescription: A pretty fountain. The sound of the water is soothing.
racial.avianDescription: A large fountain. Reminds me of a birdbath.
racial.floranDescription: Water is bringer of life for Floran.
racial.glitchDescription: Relaxed. The sounds of this water is calming.
racial.humanDescription: If I had a penny I'd throw it in.
racial.hylotlDescription: Beautiful clear water. Sometimes I miss the ocean.
racial.novakidDescription: Some kinda splashy statue spoutin' water.

missing.description: A peaceful stone fountain. The water gently flows.

racial.apexDescription: A fountain made from stone.
racial.avianDescription: This fountain has large beautiful streams of water.
racial.floranDescription: Floran likess clear water in fountain.
racial.glitchDescription: Peaceful. The sound of water flowing trickles from this fountain.
racial.humanDescription: I feel compelled to make a wish.
racial.hylotlDescription: Stone shaped and carved into a fountain.
racial.novakidDescription: Some kinda splashy statue spoutin' water.

missing.description: A frog merchant. What it really is, or what it wants, nobody knows.

racial.apexDescription: A silent frog merchant. Unusual.
racial.avianDescription: Who is this curious merchant?
racial.floranDescription: Floran ssslightly ssscared by sssilent frog.
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. This frog seems unwilling to communicate.
racial.humanDescription: If I kiss it, do you think it'll turn into a prince merchant?
racial.hylotlDescription: This silent creature is not one of us.
racial.novakidDescription: Don't see many frog merchants round these parts!

missing.description: A statue of a frog sitting peacefully.

racial.apexDescription: A statue of a peaceful-looking frog.
racial.avianDescription: This creature looks pensive and thoughtful.
racial.glitchDescription: Interested. This statue depicts a species of frog of which I am not aware.
racial.humanDescription: If there were a few more of these guys, we could have a sing-along.
racial.hylotlDescription: It's a grand statue of a frog.
racial.novakidDescription: How's this frog sittin' this way? Seems t'me he'd break his legs.

missing.description: A cheap fluorescent light.

racial.apexDescription: A basic light that does the job.
racial.avianDescription: Provides luminosity.
racial.floranDescription: Floran likess light. Light makess shadow, Floran creep in shadow.
racial.glitchDescription: Bored. The components of this light are of little interest.
racial.humanDescription: A handy light.
racial.hylotlDescription: Waterproof lights.
racial.novakidDescription: A watertight light fitting.

missing.description: A hi-tech container for guns.

racial.apexDescription: I've seen many a Miniknog guard store their guns in chests like this.
racial.avianDescription: I believe these chests are used to store firearms.
racial.floranDescription: Ugly fishmen put guns in this chesst.
racial.glitchDescription: Reassured. A hi-tech chest universally recognised for gun storage.
racial.humanDescription: A storage container for guns. I've seen people on TV use these.
racial.hylotlDescription: A chest for gun storage. I've seen one of these before somewhere.
racial.novakidDescription: This is some fancy way to store guns.

missing.description: A large microscope, designed for observing potentially hazardous bacteria.

racial.apexDescription: A microscope - A classic universal tool for study and research.
racial.avianDescription: Looking at small things isn't as interesting as looking at the stars.
racial.floranDescription: Floran can look at plantsss very close with thisss!
racial.glitchDescription: Fascinated. Organic materials are curious when you look very close.
racial.humanDescription: A microscope! Small things can turn out to be creepy up close.
racial.hylotlDescription: This device can be used to observe things on a very small scale.
racial.novakidDescription: Ain't got time to be lookin' down microscopes.

missing.description: An iron bed made of swords. Perfect for a power nap.

racial.apexDescription: An uncomfortable-looking bed.
racial.avianDescription: What an unusually sharp bed.
racial.floranDescription: Bed is sssharp and full of ssspikey.
racial.glitchDescription: Bliss. A comfortable iron bed. The Glitch can rest easily here.
racial.humanDescription: I don't think I'd get much sleep on a bed like this.
racial.hylotlDescription: A remarkably brutal bed. Such design does not suggest comfort.

missing.description: A door of crossed blades. It looks like they can be withdrawn.

racial.apexDescription: A menacing iron door.
racial.avianDescription: This door looks designed to keep something out... Or in.
racial.floranDescription: Floran like sstabby door. Floran ssslam door.
racial.glitchDescription: Envious. A fine door a fortress, or similar establishment.
racial.humanDescription: This reminds me of my days exploring old castles.
racial.hylotlDescription: What barbarian would make a door out of blades?
racial.novakidDescription: This spiky door ain't scarin' anybody.

missing.description: Is it a light, or is it a sabre? Maybe both.

racial.apexDescription: An unusual sword that gives off light.
racial.avianDescription: Strange. This sword serves as a light, not a weapon.
racial.floranDescription: Sssharp light, cut through shadow. Floran edgy.
racial.glitchDescription: Practical. This light could serve as a torch and a weapon.
racial.humanDescription: A sword that lights up. I owned similar things in my Goth days.
racial.hylotlDescription: A weapon re-purposed to light up a room. I approve.

missing.description: The sword in the... console?

racial.apexDescription: These swords function as levers. I wonder what they activate?
racial.avianDescription: An intelligent use of worn-out weapons.
racial.floranDescription: Floran tug sword. Sword make lights buzz.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. A good blade has many uses, even after it dulls. Here, it serves as a lever.
racial.humanDescription: I'm torn between pulling the lever and worrying about cutting myself.
racial.hylotlDescription: Could devices like this be a step towards peace? Or are they a threat of violence?

missing.description: A table with swords for legs. Not ideal for playing footsie.

racial.apexDescription: This table brings a sense of finality to stubbing one's toe.
racial.avianDescription: Sitting here would be enough to make anyone edgy.
racial.floranDescription: Floran cut on table. Now, Floran cut WITH table.
racial.glitchDescription: Comfort. A casual table. Others seem wary of it.
racial.humanDescription: I'm extremely hesitant to sit here.
racial.hylotlDescription: Perhaps this is slightly too dangerous as an alternate use of weapons.

missing.description: A toilet made of swords. Risky.

racial.apexDescription: This is not the most appealing toilet I've ever seen.
racial.avianDescription: I can't imagine these things being very popular.
racial.floranDescription: Ssspiky brain bowl, Floran steal design for own brain bowl.
racial.glitchDescription: Puzzlement. This toilet is only really safe for the Glitch, who don't need it.
racial.humanDescription: A toilet made of swords. I'll be having nightmares for weeks.
racial.hylotlDescription: One would almost prefer it if these swords were still used for combat.

missing.description: An adorable kennel for an adorable pet.

racial.apexDescription: For an Apex, this is a luxury house.
racial.avianDescription: Some kind of small house for a creature.
racial.floranDescription: Floran hide in house till creature come back, then ssstab!
racial.glitchDescription: Happy. This kennel could house an adorable robot dog.
racial.humanDescription: A kennel. Now I just need a dog to go with it.
racial.hylotlDescription: This crude house smells of wet dog.
racial.novakidDescription: A pet kennel! A lil on the crooked side but who's complainin'?

missing.description: A bare lightbulb hanging from a metal rod in the ceiling.

racial.apexDescription: A light bulb.
racial.avianDescription: Light!
racial.glitchDescription: Compassionate. I wish to donate this lightbulb a lampshade.
racial.humanDescription: A depressing fixture.
racial.hylotlDescription: An undecorated light.
racial.novakidDescription: A lone lightbulb.

racial.glitchDescription: Compassionate. I wish to donate this lightbulb a lampshade.

racial.hylotlDescription: An undecorated light.
racial.novakidDescription: A lone lightbulb.

racial.apexDescription: A storage locker.
racial.avianDescription: A metal box, probably built for storage.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A small amount of wall storage.
racial.humanDescription: There's no lock on this locker...
racial.hylotlDescription: Useful storage.
racial.novakidDescription: This locker doesn't actually lock.

racial.novakidDescription: This locker doesn't actually lock.

missing.description: It's a set of loudspeakers through which people speak loudly.

racial.apexDescription: A speaker. The Apex are used to seeing these in their homes.
racial.avianDescription: A crackle comes from this device.
racial.glitchDescription: Testing. This device is capable of receiving signals at multiple frequencies.
racial.humanDescription: A set of speakers. They're probably very loud.
racial.hylotlDescription: A device for projecting sound.
racial.novakidDescription: This here speaker is cracklin' away.

missing.description: Display and easily equip armour sets!

racial.floranDescription: Floran plant marker to sssay "keep out!"
racial.glitchDescription: Proud. A handy plaque to signify ownership.
racial.humanDescription: With one of these plaques, everyone will know which is my house.
racial.hylotlDescription: Hylotl dwellings are unique as it is, but this plaque would seal the deal.
racial.novakidDescription: A fancy plaque to tell strangers that this property is taken.

racial.avianDescription: An elevator with a clever cog and gear system.

racial.humanDescription: A clockwork elevator, a satisfyingly smooth ride.
racial.hylotlDescription: Clockwork elevators are some of the smoothest I've encountered.

racial.avianDescription: This station is made for piecing together large mech vehicles.

missing.description: Unhelpful road signs.

racial.apexDescription: A road sign. But it's blank...
racial.avianDescription: It appears to give directions but the directions are not labeled.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. What could explain this blank sign?
racial.humanDescription: I'm not sure how useful a blank sign is.
racial.hylotlDescription: This sign has no writing, perhaps as a result of weathering over time.
racial.novakidDescription: A blank sign ain't no use to anyone.

missing.description: A darkly coloured woven banner.

racial.apexDescription: The dark colours on this banner make it rather foreboding.
racial.avianDescription: This banner has copper finely woven into the trim. What a nice detail!
racial.floranDescription: Thisss banner isss dark like shadows. Floran wantsss to hide under it.
racial.glitchDescription: Worried. This kind of banner tends to be displayed when less than friendly individuals are nearby...
racial.humanDescription: This black woven banner is trying very hard to be menacing.
racial.hylotlDescription: It's a pity such a nice banner was created with such dismal choices of colour.
racial.novakidDescription: This banner is as dark as week-old oil.

missing.description: A small darkly coloured woven banner.

racial.apexDescription: The dark colours on this banner make it rather foreboding.
racial.avianDescription: This banner has copper finely woven into the trim. What a nice detail!
racial.floranDescription: Thisss banner isss dark like shadows. Floran wantsss to hide under it.
racial.glitchDescription: Worried. This kind of banner tends to be displayed when less than friendly individuals are nearby...
racial.humanDescription: This black woven banner is trying very hard to be menacing.
racial.hylotlDescription: It's a pity such a nice banner was created with such dismal choices of colour.
racial.novakidDescription: This banner is as dark as week-old oil.

missing.description: A dark chequered flag bearing an emblem.

racial.apexDescription: I wonder if this is here to mark territory?
racial.avianDescription: I wonder if the dark choices of colour were to make it look more menacing?
racial.floranDescription: Floran doessn't like flag sso much. Boring coloursss.
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. Glitch who make flags with these colours aren't often the nicest people.
racial.humanDescription: A moody coloured banner that can be placed anywhere.
racial.hylotlDescription: The drab colours show that a Hylotl didn't make this.
racial.novakidDescription: This flag is so dark, it'll make folk wonder if it's a warnin' sign.

missing.description: A spade, a rake and a broom for all sorts of back-breaking farm work.

racial.apexDescription: Tools for someone that lives by tending the land.
racial.avianDescription: A rack of various different tools. The spade is the only one I recognise.
racial.glitchDescription: Sentimental. Many common Glitch live their lives as farmers. These are the tools of their trade.
racial.humanDescription: Farming tools. Earth farming was largely automated.
racial.hylotlDescription: The Hylotl have no use for tools such as these under the ocean.
racial.novakidDescription: Farmin' tools. Nothin' beats gettin' your hands dirty!

missing.description: Tools used for poking at burning coals or kindling.

racial.apexDescription: Tools used to tend to a fire.
racial.avianDescription: Sharp sticks. What are they for?
racial.glitchDescription: Content. A set of iron tools for taking care of a fire.
racial.humanDescription: I think these are tools you use in a fireplace.
racial.hylotlDescription: What are these tools for?
racial.novakidDescription: Metal tools, for stokin' a fire.

missing.description: Common, workshop tools used for quick repairs.

racial.apexDescription: These look like tools for some quick and dirty metal work.
racial.avianDescription: Tools for shaping metal.
racial.glitchDescription: Unimpressed. Rudimentary tools like these are not useful for much.
racial.humanDescription: Simple DIY tools.
racial.hylotlDescription: Tools of the trade for many a craftsman.
racial.novakidDescription: Some ordinary craftin' tools.

missing.description: A brutal yet effective execution device.

racial.apexDescription: An old but effective form of punishment.
racial.avianDescription: Not as bad as being defeathered.
racial.floranDescription: Blade cutss fasst! Great for food preparationss!
racial.glitchDescription: Sadness. The preferred form of capital punishment among the Glitch.
racial.humanDescription: I would not want to be on the receiving end of this thing.
racial.hylotlDescription: A barbaric form of punishment...
racial.novakidDescription: Quick and easy. Too easy for my likin'!

missing.description: A pile of hay. Probably not a great hiding place.

racial.apexDescription: A pile of hay.
racial.avianDescription: A big, fresh pile of hay. Avians use hay as bedding.
racial.glitchDescription: Mischievous. A pile big of hay, enough to hide in.
racial.humanDescription: I am tempted to dive in.
racial.hylotlDescription: The hay looks soft and smells fresh.
racial.novakidDescription: A fresh hay pile.

missing.description: A rolled up bale of hay.

racial.apexDescription: Tightly rolled hay.
racial.avianDescription: Avians do not roll hay in this way.
racial.glitchDescription: Happy. Hay all rolled up and ready to be sold.
racial.humanDescription: A great big roll of hay.
racial.hylotlDescription: A surface plant, dried and rolled up in a bundle.
racial.novakidDescription: It's temptin' to give this hay roll a nudge...

missing.description: A neat bale of hay, ready for stacking.

racial.apexDescription: A bale of hay. What are these for, I wonder?
racial.avianDescription: Hay formed into a cube.
racial.floranDescription: Floran could make big cassstle from hay building block.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. Hay formed into bales for easy storage.
racial.humanDescription: I believe these are called bales of hay.
racial.hylotlDescription: A dried surface plant, made into a cube.
racial.novakidDescription: A bale of hay.

missing.description: A digital hourglass. It's stuck in a constant state.

racial.apexDescription: An hourglass. It's not running out. A glitch perhaps?
racial.avianDescription: A time measurement device. It seems stuck.
racial.floranDescription: The sssand doesssn't fall through. Why is thiss?
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This timer never runs out.
racial.humanDescription: An old hourglass... The sand just keeps going.
racial.hylotlDescription: The sand appears to be never-ending. What's going on here?
racial.novakidDescription: Why ain't this timer ever running out?

missing.description: A keg full of juice. Mmm, juice!

racial.apexDescription: A keg that smells of sweet juice.
racial.avianDescription: A sweet-smelling barrel filled with liquid.
racial.glitchDescription: Delighted. Juice kegs always mean merriment is ahead.
racial.humanDescription: A keg. It's full of juice.
racial.hylotlDescription: The liquid inside smells wonderful.
racial.novakidDescription: Tasty juice is inside.

missing.description: Tools for creating pure, unadulterated deliciousness.

racial.apexDescription: Kitchen utensils. I wonder what dishes these have been used to make.
racial.avianDescription: A set of tools that look like they're made for making food.
racial.glitchDescription: Appreciative. These tools are for making food.
racial.humanDescription: I wonder how fast I could chop vegetables with these?
racial.hylotlDescription: Hylotl use a katana to chop their food. Just kidding.
racial.novakidDescription: Utensils for cookin'.

missing.description: This bell must make quite a sound.

racial.apexDescription: A large bell. This must ring out very loudly.
racial.avianDescription: A huge bell. I wonder how it sounds.
racial.glitchDescription: Fearful. This bell signals danger.
racial.humanDescription: A giant bell. The temptation to ring it is strong.
racial.hylotlDescription: The sound of bells is something most Hylotl have never heard.
racial.novakidDescription: I'd bet this bell can be heard from far away.

missing.description: A huge, intimidating door.

racial.apexDescription: A huge door. You'd need a battering ram to take this down.
racial.avianDescription: This is perhaps the biggest door I've ever seen.
racial.glitchDescription: Comforted. This door can be barred from the inside by a huge plank of wood.
racial.humanDescription: A huge fortified door. It'd require more than a battering ram to get this open.
racial.hylotlDescription: Such doors are built for those that fear intruders.
racial.novakidDescription: Whoever built this door sure don't want visitors.

missing.description: A wooden crate.

racial.apexDescription: A wooden crate.
racial.avianDescription: A wooden storage box.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A wooden crate.
racial.humanDescription: It's just a crate.
racial.hylotlDescription: A crate made of wood.
racial.novakidDescription: A huge crate.

missing.description: Shiny armour stands resolute.

racial.apexDescription: A beautiful set of armour.
racial.avianDescription: It appears to be battle armour.
racial.floranDescription: Doess metal man wear metal armour?
racial.glitchDescription: Unimpressed. This armour is built purely for decoration. Real battle armour is far more rugged.
racial.humanDescription: An attractive suit of armour.
racial.hylotlDescription: This armour looks as if it's never seen battle.
racial.novakidDescription: Seems unnecessary to wear somethin' like this when fightin'.

missing.description: Shiny armour stands armed and resolute.

racial.apexDescription: A beautiful set of armour.
racial.avianDescription: It appears to be battle armour.
racial.floranDescription: Doess metal man wear metal armour?
racial.glitchDescription: Unimpressed. This armour is built purely for decoration. Real battle armour is far more rugged.
racial.humanDescription: An attractive suit of armour.
racial.hylotlDescription: This armour looks as if it's never seen battle.
racial.novakidDescription: Seems unnecessary to wear somethin' like this when fightin'.

missing.description: Shiny armour stands resolute. Hmm... The shield looks loose.

racial.apexDescription: A beautiful set of armour. The shield looks loose.
racial.avianDescription: It appears to be battle armour. The shield looks strange.
racial.floranDescription: Doess metal man wear metal armour? Floran sssmell ssomething sstrange here.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. This armour has a switch mechanism under the sheild.
racial.humanDescription: An attractive suit of armour. If this were a movie, the shield would be a secret switch.
racial.hylotlDescription: This armour looks as if it's never seen battle. The shield looks particularly flimsy.
racial.novakidDescription: Seems unnecessary to wear somethin' like this when fightin'. What's with the sheild?

missing.description: These display axes look very sharp.

racial.apexDescription: A couple of decorative axes. They look sharp enough to use.
racial.avianDescription: Brutal-looking axes. These look very sharp indeed.
racial.floranDescription: Sssilly! Axess not for putting on wall.
racial.glitchDescription: Boastful. A sharp axe is a work of art to the Glitch.
racial.humanDescription: Two short, sharp axes.
racial.hylotlDescription: The Hylotl also see artistic value in their weaponry.
racial.novakidDescription: Flashy display items. Nothin' compared to a faithful old favourite.

missing.description: A firm bed with silky sheets.

racial.apexDescription: The bed is hard but the sheets are silky.
racial.avianDescription: The sheets are pleasantly soft to the touch.
racial.floranDescription: Floran enjoy the touch of sssilky bed.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. Glitch sheets tend to stay silky, as our metal shell doesn't wear them down.
racial.humanDescription: Silky sheets on a harsh bed.
racial.hylotlDescription: Fine silky sheets. The Hylotl make good use of silks.
racial.novakidDescription: Nice bedsheets doesn't make a nice bed.

missing.description: A bookcase for storing folk tales and legends...

racial.apexDescription: A nicely decorated bookcase.
racial.avianDescription: A dusty old home for books.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. The Glitch have not produced many books. I wonder if there are any here.
racial.humanDescription: I wonder how old some of these books are.
racial.hylotlDescription: Perhaps there are some great legends in these old books.
racial.novakidDescription: This bookcase looks mighty old!

missing.description: One of these books looks out of place... I wonder...

racial.apexDescription: Some of these books don't look quite right.
racial.avianDescription: A dusty old home for books. Some of them don't look real...
racial.floranDescription: Old and dusssty books. Those oness look sstrange.
racial.glitchDescription: Suspicious. Some of the books appear to be placed strangely.
racial.humanDescription: I wonder how old some of these books are. Those ones aren't the same as the others...
racial.hylotlDescription: There's definitely something strange about this bookcase.
racial.novakidDescription: I got a hunch there's somethin up with these books!

missing.description: A bowl. It doesn't look very clean.

racial.apexDescription: A simple, dirty bowl.
racial.avianDescription: It appears food is eaten from this.
racial.floranDescription: Bowl too sssmall for Floran appetite.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A simple bowl. Likely made from clay.
racial.humanDescription: A little bowl, it looks like clay.
racial.hylotlDescription: What is eaten from this bowl, I wonder...
racial.novakidDescription: A simple bowl for a simple meal.

missing.description: There's a hole in this bucket.

racial.apexDescription: A wooden bucket.
racial.avianDescription: Used to carry water, I believe.
racial.glitchDescription: Humbled. This bucket has been used to draw water from wells and streams.
racial.humanDescription: The kind of bucket you'd find in a well.
racial.hylotlDescription: Does someone use this bucket to carry water? I can't imagine a world in which water is lacking.
racial.novakidDescription: A plain ol' bucket.

missing.description: A charming and well-made wooden cabinet.

racial.apexDescription: A tall wooden cabinet. Lots of storage.
racial.avianDescription: A roomy cabinet. Not to be mistaken for an outhouse.
racial.floranDescription: Tall wood box. Good for Floran to hide in.
racial.glitchDescription: Grateful. A finely made wooden cabinet.
racial.humanDescription: I wonder if there's a gateway to another world in here.
racial.hylotlDescription: An attractive cabinet made of wood with an intricate grain.
racial.novakidDescription: A nice lookin' cabinet.

missing.description: A small wax candle in a holder.

racial.apexDescription: A small candle.
racial.avianDescription: Avian priests often work by candlelight.
racial.glitchDescription: Sentimental. Candlelight, how I have missed it.
racial.humanDescription: A pretty little candle.
racial.hylotlDescription: Little is as beautiful as the flickering of a candle flame.
racial.novakidDescription: A neat lil candle.

missing.description: An extremely basic bed of hay.

racial.apexDescription: An uncomfortable-looking bed with nothing but some hay for warmth.
racial.avianDescription: As close to a nest as can be.
racial.floranDescription: Bed too hard. Floran getss back pain.
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. I can't imagine anyone getting a good nights sleep here.
racial.humanDescription: A hay bed. I can't imagine sleeping on this night after night.
racial.hylotlDescription: An uncomfortable bed built out of hay and hard wood.
racial.novakidDescription: This bed's gotta be a form of punishment.

missing.description: A hard chair, it would get uncomfortable pretty quickly.

racial.apexDescription: A hard wood dining chair.
racial.avianDescription: An uncomfortable wooden seat. Decorated with modesty.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. A common dining room chair styled in typical medieval fashion.
racial.humanDescription: A fancy dining chair. It's hard and uncomfortable.
racial.hylotlDescription: An uncomfortable wooden seat, decorated modestly.
racial.novakidDescription: A hard wood chair.

missing.description: An iron chandelier. A good way to light a large room.

racial.apexDescription: A metal chandelier. It appears to cast long shadows.
racial.avianDescription: A way of suspending lights from the ceiling so they reach out across the room.
racial.glitchDescription: Comforted. A chandelier, this simple light source feels like home.
racial.humanDescription: If this were a videogame, this might fall down and crush someone.
racial.hylotlDescription: This chandelier bathes its surroundings in a warm glow.
racial.novakidDescription: Who has time to light all them candles up there?

missing.description: An old wooden chest, still going strong.

racial.apexDescription: An old chest. It looks strong.
racial.avianDescription: A hard wooden lockbox. What could be inside?
racial.glitchDescription: Excited. The Glitch often store weapons in chests like these. Is there one in here?
racial.humanDescription: This chest is straight out of a fairytale.
racial.hylotlDescription: A strong chest. Good for storing sharp items.
racial.novakidDescription: The kinda chest you'd expect to find in a castle.

missing.description: A small clock with a pendulum. It ticks and tocks but the hands never move.

racial.apexDescription: A small clock. The swaying pendulum is calming.
racial.avianDescription: It appears to be a device used for reading the time. The Avians make use of the sun.
racial.glitchDescription: Sympathetic. The time on this clock never changes.
racial.humanDescription: A pretty little pendulum clock. The pendulum swings but the time doesn't seem to change.
racial.hylotlDescription: This time piece appears to be broken, although the pendulum still swings...
racial.novakidDescription: The time on this clock never changes.

missing.description: This book is full of strange illustrations.

racial.apexDescription: A book. It's entirely full of portraits.
racial.avianDescription: There are pictures of many different people in this book.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. A compendium of old illustrations.
racial.humanDescription: It appears to be some kind of almanac. There are illustrations here of lots of different people.
racial.hylotlDescription: This books feels as though it bears importance. Each page contains portraits of unknown persons.
racial.novakidDescription: A picture book, sorta.

missing.description: Ye olde counter.

racial.apexDescription: This counter seems well-suited for displaying items.
racial.avianDescription: This counter seems sturdy.
racial.glitchDescription: Nostalgic. Handcrafted counters like this are very common in Glitch storefronts.
racial.humanDescription: A rough, but strong-looking counter.
racial.hylotlDescription: The wood has a rich scent. Such smells are rare beneath the waves.
racial.novakidDescription: This counter has seen a lotta use over the years.

missing.description: A dirty-looking wooden cup.

racial.apexDescription: A little wooden cup.
racial.avianDescription: A wooden cup, difficult to keep clean.
racial.floranDescription: Floran drink fleshy juicess from sssuch cupss.
racial.glitchDescription: Disintered. A common wooden goblet.
racial.humanDescription: A goblet made of wood.
racial.hylotlDescription: A stained wooden goblet.
racial.novakidDescription: A plain ol' wooden cup.

missing.description: A nicely made wooden desk.

racial.apexDescription: A desk for paperwork. It's covered in ink stains.
racial.avianDescription: A desk built for an academic.
racial.floranDescription: Scholarss put ink on paper here.
racial.glitchDescription: Cheerful. This is a desk suitable for scholars.
racial.humanDescription: A writing desk. The surface is covered in splattered ink.
racial.hylotlDescription: The Hylotl practice calligraphy on desks like these.
racial.novakidDescription: An old writin' desk.

missing.description: A fancy feasting table.

racial.apexDescription: The main feature of this table seems to be the attractive tablecloth.
racial.avianDescription: Someone has laid a cloth over this fancy table to keep it clean.
racial.floranDescription: Iss it bed or table? It'ss fancy.
racial.glitchDescription: Greedy. It has been a long time since I was present at a Glitch feast. Few in the universe are capable of such merriment.
racial.humanDescription: A giant dining table. Perfect for a feast.
racial.hylotlDescription: Looks like a table at which Royalty gather socially. The tablecloth suggests a banquet.
racial.novakidDescription: A fine lookin' table for a hootenanny!

missing.description: This dresser has a musty smell. It doesn't look very clean.

racial.apexDescription: A simple dresser, probably full of simple clothes.
racial.avianDescription: A storage unit and table in one.
racial.floranDescription: Floran ssniff old furniture. Floran get nosse full of dusst.
racial.glitchDescription: Satisfied. An old dresser.
racial.humanDescription: An old and dusty wooden dresser.
racial.hylotlDescription: An old storage unit, possibly for clothes.
racial.novakidDescription: A dusty ol' chest of drawers, probably for clothes.

missing.description: A stone fireplace. A good way to warm a cold castle.

racial.apexDescription: The crackle of the fire puts me at ease.
racial.avianDescription: A stone structure and a fire within. Likely built to provide warmth.
racial.floranDescription: Floran would rather be cold than sssit by fire.
racial.glitchDescription: Wistful. I adore sitting by a fire on a cold night.
racial.humanDescription: A warm stone fire. All I need now is a bag of marshmallows.
racial.hylotlDescription: The temperature in Hylotl cities is carefully controlled. It's nice to feel the warmth of a fire on my skin.
racial.novakidDescription: Nothin' beats the sweet smell of woodsmoke.

missing.description: A flagpole fit for topping any building.

racial.apexDescription: A flag pole. Built to sit on a roof where it can be seen for miles.
racial.avianDescription: A flag on a long pole flying an emblem.
racial.glitchDescription: Proud. Seeing this atop my home would be pleasing.
racial.humanDescription: A flag on top of a long pole so everyone can see it.
racial.hylotlDescription: A very smart looking flag, the emblem may signify a Royal family.
racial.novakidDescription: A fancy lookin' golden flag.

missing.description: A old fashioned furnace for tempering tools.

racial.apexDescription: An old fashioned furnace. Looks as if it's built for metal work.
racial.avianDescription: A stone furnace, built to handle high temperatures.
racial.glitchDescription: Amazed. Smithies like these are used to produce tools and weaponry.
racial.humanDescription: The old kind of furnace, used to produce big, hefty weapons.
racial.hylotlDescription: An old fashioned furnace for metalwork.
racial.novakidDescription: A good ol' fashioned furnace.

missing.description: A model of an unknown planet.

racial.apexDescription: A globe. It doesn't match up with my ship's readings of this planet.
racial.avianDescription: It appears to map out landmasses.
racial.glitchDescription: Disappointed. A globe, made by a poor cartographer.
racial.humanDescription: A globe of a world that's nothing like this one.
racial.hylotlDescription: According to my ship, this globe is completely inaccurate.
racial.novakidDescription: A map of sorts. Who knows what planet this is!

missing.description: An oil lamp. It gives off some warmth.

racial.apexDescription: A small iron lamp, suitable to hang on a wall.
racial.avianDescription: An iron lamp built to hang on a hook.
racial.floranDescription: Fire in a cage. Floran like thiss.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This lamp is built to hang on a hook, to keep a your hands free.
racial.humanDescription: A little iron lamp. The loop on top is becomes a hook.
racial.hylotlDescription: A portable lamp that can be hung on the wall.
