racial.hylotlDescription: A gaudy sock. Why is it hanging on the wall? Is there anything inside?
racial.novakidDescription: Socks ain't no good on a wall, what will keep your feet warm?

missing.description: A synthetic fir tree.

racial.apexDescription: It's a synthetic tree. Needs more lights and decorations.
racial.avianDescription: This tree looks convincingly real.
racial.glitchDescription: Disappointed. This synthetic tree lacks decoration.
racial.humanDescription: It's a shame it's synthetic, I can still remember the smell of real fir trees.
racial.hylotlDescription: Despite its inauthenticity, this is a very pretty tree.
racial.novakidDescription: Its a tree, but not a real tree?

missing.description: Fairy lights that spell out 'waz', whatever that means.

racial.apexDescription: I don't know what to make of these lights...'waz'?
racial.avianDescription: What's a 'waz'?
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. What is a 'waz'?
racial.humanDescription: Waaaaaaaz.
racial.hylotlDescription: Does this 'waz' have some deeper meaning?

missing.description: The flashing light is meant to signal that there's been some sort of emergency...

racial.apexDescription: These alarms were common in Apex housing, signalling unacceptable behaviour.
racial.avianDescription: The machine, it squawks like a bird.
racial.floranDescription: Ssswirling light. Like firefly in a jar.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A coloured light.
racial.humanDescription: These things scream danger.
racial.hylotlDescription: A clumsy dancing light.
racial.novakidDescription: A light cravin' attention.

missing.description: Ouch! I shouldn't get too close to that.

racial.apexDescription: Barbed wire. The Miniknog often use this to keep people out... or in.
racial.avianDescription: Sharp wire. Have to be careful it doesn't snag my feathers.
racial.glitchDescription: Cautious. This sharp wire could scratch even the toughest Glitch shell.
racial.humanDescription: Barbed wire. The bane of human clothing.
racial.hylotlDescription: Sharp spikes fashioned with wire. A barbaric, primitive form of security.
racial.novakidDescription: Barbed wire.

racial.apexDescription: A cute little bath. Looks pretty small for an Apex.
racial.avianDescription: A bath with a shower. Like water off an Avian's back.
racial.glitchDescription: Smug. Glitch do not need to take baths.
racial.humanDescription: A nice hot bath. Just what the doctor ordered. Only things missing are some bubbles and candles.
racial.hylotlDescription: A trough in which humans wash. We Hylotl simply go for a swim.
racial.novakidDescription: I do enjoy a hot bath every once in a while.

racial.apexDescription: A cute little bath. Looks pretty small for an Apex.
racial.avianDescription: A bath with a shower. Like water off an Avian's back.
racial.glitchDescription: Smug. Glitch do not need to take baths.
racial.humanDescription: A nice hot bath. Just what the doctor ordered. Only things missing are some bubbles and candles.
racial.hylotlDescription: A trough in which humans wash. We Hylotl simply go for a swim.
racial.novakidDescription: I do enjoy a hot bath every once in a while.

missing.description: A normal looking toilet! Thank the stars!

racial.apexDescription: A small toilet. It doesn't look entirely hygienic.
racial.avianDescription: A place for droppings.
racial.glitchDescription: Disinterested. A toilet.
racial.humanDescription: A toilet. Always a welcome sight.
racial.hylotlDescription: A crude toilet.
racial.novakidDescription: Just a simple toilet. Not glamorous, but highly necessary.

missing.description: A television! I don't think this has worked for a long time.

racial.apexDescription: A television set. I keep expecting to see Big Ape's face.
racial.avianDescription: A monitor, for watching old shows.
racial.glitchDescription: Appreciative. The television is truly humanity's most valuable export.
racial.humanDescription: Nothing better than relaxing on the sofa watching Saturday morning cartoons.
racial.hylotlDescription: While the technology is impressive, many television shows are devoid of artistic merit.
racial.novakidDescription: A good ol' television. I do enjoy watching a gritty mystery unfold.

missing.description: The amount of data on this screen is overwhelming.

racial.apexDescription: A set of monitors. I keep expecting to see Big Ape's face.
racial.avianDescription: A monitor, for... data readings, perhaps.
racial.floranDescription: Too much information for Floran to take in right now.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. The readings on this monitor indicate they involve the nearest star.
racial.humanDescription: This middle screen here seems to be analysing the local star. Hint: It's very hot.
racial.hylotlDescription: According to these monitors, the local star is not in danger of collapsing just yet.
racial.novakidDescription: Data readings. For what?

missing.description: There's a book in here titled, 'How to Travel Backwards in Time for Dummies'.

racial.apexDescription: A bookcase, filled with interesting books. The Miniknog would burn all of these.
racial.avianDescription: A lot of scientific books. There doesn't seem to be many religious texts.
racial.floranDescription: Many books with wordsss, few books with picturesss.
racial.glitchDescription: Interested. Some of these books are hundreds of years old. They may fall apart at the slightest touch.
racial.humanDescription: There's a bunch of familiar books written by humans. I wonder how many people read these?
racial.hylotlDescription: Tomes rich with human history. They aren't as well-written as Hylotl books, of course.
racial.novakidDescription: A book case. There's a lot of self-help books here...

missing.description: It looks like it's full of hazardous materials.

racial.apexDescription: A metal cabinet. A strange smell emanates from within.
racial.avianDescription: The contents seem dangerous. Toxic or explosive, maybe.
racial.floranDescription: Dangerousss metal box? Can't be more dangerousss than Floran!
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. Despite the warning sign, this crate actually contains a collection of odd socks.
racial.humanDescription: A vile smell seeps out from under the lid. Reminds me of my teenage years.
racial.hylotlDescription: A hazardous container. Apparently humans often disposed of such things in their oceans.
racial.novakidDescription: A container with warnin' stripes. I ain't openin' it.

missing.description: A metallic ceiling lamp.

racial.apexDescription: A metallic ceiling light.
racial.avianDescription: A ceiling light.
racial.glitchDescription: Bored. A light fixture.
racial.humanDescription: A device you attach to your head, and... wait, no, it's just a light.
racial.hylotlDescription: An uninteresting ceiling light.
racial.novakidDescription: A plain lookin' ceilin' light.

missing.description: A metallic ceiling lamp.

racial.apexDescription: A metallic ceiling light.
racial.avianDescription: A ceiling light.
racial.glitchDescription: Bored. A light fixture.
racial.humanDescription: A device you attach to your head, and... wait, no, it's just a light.
racial.hylotlDescription: An uninteresting ceiling light.
racial.novakidDescription: A plain lookin' ceilin' light.

missing.description: Looks like it's mainly used for data entry. Nothing too interesting.

racial.apexDescription: A computer. The keyboard is too small for Apex fingers.
racial.avianDescription: What does this operate, I wonder?
racial.floranDescription: Computer for typing and ssstaring at.
racial.glitchDescription: Wistful. I feel a kinship with this human computer.
racial.humanDescription: A computer. It's running a program that requires you to enter a code at regular intervals.
racial.hylotlDescription: A human computer. Technologically, this is quite impressive.
racial.novakidDescription: This is a computer. I ain't sure it's relevant.

missing.description: It's full of really tempting levers but I should probably leave it alone.

racial.apexDescription: A command console. Not sure what it does.
racial.avianDescription: This looks dangerous to fiddle with.
racial.floranDescription: Machine with many buttonsss and levers! Tempting, but Floran better not fiddle with thisss...
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. The more levers a console as, the more dangerous it is to fiddle with.
racial.humanDescription: I think this opens the pod bay doors. Or blows something up. It does something, anyway.
racial.hylotlDescription: Must... not... pull... levers...
racial.novakidDescription: Who knows what these buttons and levers do. I ain't findin' out the hard way, that's for sure.

missing.description: Two keyboards and one monitor?

racial.apexDescription: A command console. Not sure what it does.
racial.avianDescription: This looks dangerous to fiddle with.
racial.floranDescription: Computer hasss unnecessary amount of buttonsss. Floran baffled.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. The more keyboards a console has, the more... nope. Stumped.
racial.humanDescription: Ah, the infamous 'dual keyboard' design. It never really caught on.
racial.hylotlDescription: Why would one ever need two keyboards?
racial.novakidDescription: This computer has more than one keyboard. Seems excessive if you ask me.

missing.description: It looks like a screen full of personnel memos.

racial.apexDescription: There's a message on the screen. "Dear Marjory. Please remember to put the cat out. Love David" Interesting.
racial.avianDescription: There's a message on the screen. "The results of yesterday's toxicity tests were inconclusive. Please schedule more. Doctor Kleiner" Okay.
racial.floranDescription: Hmm... A highlighted message on the ssscreen. "Buy eggs after work".
racial.glitchDescription: Nosy. There's a message on the screen. "Let me explain to you why you are wrong..." The rest of the post descends into unintelligible ranting.
racial.humanDescription: Judging from this email account, someone's fallen victim to the well-known 'reply-all' faux pas. Poor guy.
racial.hylotlDescription: Judging from these posts, humans simply bash their faces against the keyboard when arguing via computer.
racial.novakidDescription: A personal computer station. I ain't the snoopin' kind.

missing.description: It's a screen full of super top secret mission data... Boring.

racial.apexDescription: Apparently this planet was going to explode. I think it was a false alarm.
racial.avianDescription: A team was sent out to recover a cursed artifact. They never returned. Maybe they just got sidetracked?
racial.floranDescription: Hunting... partiesss.... Floran have parties on hunt too.
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. It appears as if the previous user of this console went insane. There are a number of alarming messages.
racial.humanDescription: Ooh, secret data. Turns out the government was spying on us! Who knew?
racial.hylotlDescription: Detailed here is an alarming plan to drain this world's oceans. Thankfully, it was vetoed.
racial.novakidDescription: There's some info here about a petition to ban moon walkin'. Followed by a recipe for onion soup.

missing.description: A support beam painted with cautionary stripes. Mind your head!

racial.apexDescription: A support beam.
racial.avianDescription: A metal support.
racial.glitchDescription: Bored. A support beam.
racial.humanDescription: A metal beam.
racial.hylotlDescription: Metallic support beam.
racial.novakidDescription: A support beam.

missing.description: A metal crate.

racial.apexDescription: A metal crate.
racial.avianDescription: A crate made of metal.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A metal box.
racial.humanDescription: A large metal crate.
racial.hylotlDescription: A heavy-looking metal crate.
racial.novakidDescription: It's a plain metal crate.

missing.description: An office desk with a built-in monitor. Looks like someone was doing some coding.

racial.apexDescription: This desk has a monitor built into it.
racial.avianDescription: A plain desk with a monitor stuck to it.
racial.floranDescription: Desssk with ssscreen sstuck to it.
racial.glitchDescription: Cynical. Inbuilt electronics are often inferior to their separate counterparts. Except in the case of Glitch, of course.
racial.humanDescription: This monitor is built into the desk.
racial.hylotlDescription: A built in monitor. An intelligent fusion of technology and comfort.
racial.novakidDescription: A screen stuck to a desk.

missing.description: The display shows a round central room branching off into several hallways.

racial.apexDescription: Looks like some kind of digital map.
racial.avianDescription: Perhaps a layout of this area?
racial.floranDescription: Squiggly linesss make no sssense to Floran.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This appears to depict the layout of the area we're in.
racial.humanDescription: A basic map display.
racial.hylotlDescription: Corridors and rooms are laid out on this map.
racial.novakidDescription: Pretty sure this is a map.

missing.description: A screen with a pie chart representing budget statistics.

racial.apexDescription: A pie chart. Doesn't look very tasty.
racial.avianDescription: This chart sort of looks like a berry tart, with a piece missing.
racial.glitchDescription: Sarcastic. A fascinating pie chart detailing stationary expenditure.
racial.humanDescription: Ooh, an info-graphic. Sadly not one of those funny internet ones.
racial.hylotlDescription: It makes sense for humans to keep a careful eye on their expenditure.
racial.novakidDescription: Ain't sure what this big circle is supposed to illustrate. But it's got a chunk missin'.

missing.description: It's a map displaying a round central room branching out into several corridors.

racial.apexDescription: Looks like some kind of digital map.
racial.avianDescription: Perhaps a layout of this area?
racial.floranDescription: Squiggly linesss make no sssense to Floran.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This appears to depict the layout of the area we're in.
racial.humanDescription: A basic map display.
racial.hylotlDescription: Corridors and rooms are laid out on this map.
racial.novakidDescription: Pretty sure this is a map.

missing.description: That's no moon...

racial.apexDescription: A holographic orb. It appears to be significant.
racial.avianDescription: The orb depicted here appears to be celestial, but there are tell-tale signs it's man-made.
racial.glitchDescription: Terrified. Scans suggest this is... no... it can't be...
racial.humanDescription: Wow, is this the moon?
racial.hylotlDescription: The orb glows with a cold light. It sends chills through me.
racial.novakidDescription: Looks like the moon, starin' down at me a cold winter night.

missing.description: A device to scan eyeballs and match them to personnel data.

racial.apexDescription: An eye scanner. It doesn't seem to recognise Apex eyeballs.
racial.avianDescription: A device for scanning human eyeballs. But for what purpose?
racial.floranDescription: Machine wants to ssscan eyes. Floran refussse!
racial.glitchDescription: Thoughtful. With the correct calibration, this scanner could be tricked by a Glitch eye.
racial.humanDescription: An eye scanner. Someone's rubbed ink around the eye piece. Oh, you jokers.
racial.hylotlDescription: An eye scanner. Such devices are awkward for Hylotl. Our heads are not the right shape.
racial.novakidDescription: An eye scanner? Ain't sure what I'm supposed to do with it.

missing.description: It scans fingerprints and matches them to personnel data.

racial.apexDescription: A fingerprint scanner. Smaller than an Apex hand.
racial.avianDescription: Avians do not have fingerprints. Such security devices are pointless for us.
racial.floranDescription: Device for ssscanning hands. Doesn't react to Floran's hand...
racial.glitchDescription: Resentful. Biometric security devices are a luxury only certain species can indulge in.
racial.humanDescription: A fingerprint scanner. Sadly, I'm not registered. I've always wanted to activate one of these.
racial.hylotlDescription: Hylotl hands can cause these things to go haywire.
racial.novakidDescription: A type of scannin' device for hands. Doubt it'll pick up mine.

missing.description: A space heater!

racial.apexDescription: A warm, cosy portable heater.
racial.avianDescription: Perfect for warming the feathers.
racial.floranDescription: Nice heat, no fire. Safe for Floran.
racial.glitchDescription: Disinterested. A small heater.
racial.humanDescription: A space heater. The name makes it sound futuristic and cool.
racial.hylotlDescription: A clever way to achieve portable warmth.
racial.novakidDescription: A radiator. I never felt the need for one.

missing.description: A blindingly bright fluorescent light.

racial.apexDescription: A bright light. Reminds me of Miniknog cells.
racial.avianDescription: This light is overly bright.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. The brightness levels are slightly too high for human eyes.
racial.humanDescription: An uncomfortably bright light.
racial.hylotlDescription: The creator of this light got a bit carried away.
racial.novakidDescription: A brightly lit lamp.

missing.description: A blindingly bright fluorescent light.

racial.apexDescription: A bright light. Reminds me of Miniknog cells.
racial.avianDescription: This light is overly bright.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. The brightness levels are slightly too high for human eyes.
racial.humanDescription: An uncomfortably bright light.
racial.hylotlDescription: The creator of this light got a bit carried away.
racial.novakidDescription: A brightly lit lamp.

missing.description: Stay still! It can't see you if you stay still.

racial.apexDescription: This appears to be a motion detector.
racial.avianDescription: A motion detector. Better be careful.
racial.floranDescription: Floran think this machine want Floran to dance.
racial.glitchDescription: Analysis. A fairly rudimentary motion detector.
racial.humanDescription: A motion detector. Better watch out.
racial.hylotlDescription: This appears to be some kind of motion detecting device.
racial.novakidDescription: Looks like this thing is scannin' for movement.

missing.description: This panel appears to monitor some obscure environmental data.

racial.apexDescription: This appears to be a panel displaying local sub-proton changes.
racial.avianDescription: Data is being broadcast to this screen, which is displaying many measurements.
racial.floranDescription: Floran hasss no time for tiny wordsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. This panel is displaying extraordinarily small environmental changes. For what purpose?
racial.humanDescription: Someone was doing a lot of obscure data analysis with the aid of this screen.
racial.hylotlDescription: Data on the surrounding environment. The changes measured are on a miniscule level.
racial.novakidDescription: I'm sure this data is interestin' to someone out there. That someone ain't me.

missing.description: It's a screen displaying an old medical scan.

racial.apexDescription: This screen appears to display a medical diagnostic.
racial.avianDescription: A scan of what appears to be medical data.
racial.floranDescription: Screen showsss flesh perssson. Floran wondersss if perssson is trapped inssside.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. This appears to be a full-body medical scan. I wonder what was wrong with them?
racial.humanDescription: A digital medical scan! It's all blue, because blue is the default colour of scientific technology.
racial.hylotlDescription: A medical scan - judging by the images, it wasn't of a Hylotl.
racial.novakidDescription: I wonder what this information was bein' used for?

missing.description: A flashy electronic recruitment poster.

racial.apexDescription: A recruitment station? It appears military recruitment is optional here. For the Apex, there is no such luxury.
racial.avianDescription: A military recruitment ad. The grounded often choose to become warriors.
racial.floranDescription: Recruitment panel. Floran don't recruit for warrior life style. Floran born thisss way.
racial.glitchDescription: Thoughtful. A recruitment panel. Glitch who are not self-aware often choose to become warriors.
racial.humanDescription: Ah, a military recruitment panel. Their methods of recruitment get flashier by the minute.
racial.hylotlDescription: A military recruitment sign. How obnoxious.
racial.novakidDescription: This ad is blindin'.

missing.description: That's not very encouraging.

racial.apexDescription: If this was a Miniknog poster, the missing text would read "you won't be terminated".
racial.avianDescription: The Avians pray to Kluex for calm. We have no need of silly motivational posters.
racial.floranDescription: The possster is damaged. Floran feels less calm after seeing this possster.
racial.glitchDescription: Frustrated. Trying to guess the missing text will irritate me for days.
racial.humanDescription: I'm not surprised someone defaced this.
racial.hylotlDescription: We Hylotl do not need posters to help us achieve Zen.
racial.novakidDescription: Keep calm and what? I guess I'll never know.

missing.description: There is no need to be upset.

racial.apexDescription: Big Ape? Here? Why would humans have such a poster? Is it a joke?
racial.avianDescription: This appears to feature that Big Ape character. Do the humans have some connection to the Apex?
racial.floranDescription: Floran not sssure why there's an Apex on this possster. Or maybe hairy human?
racial.glitchDescription: Suspicious. Why do the humans have a poster of Big Ape, I wonder?
racial.humanDescription: This cartoon character seems familiar. Wait... is that Big Ape?
racial.hylotlDescription: A human poster, an Apex villain. Curious.
racial.novakidDescription: An Apex. It's tellin' me not to be upset.

missing.description: It's a large server cabinet.

racial.apexDescription: A server cabinet.
racial.avianDescription: An unremarkable server cabinet.
racial.floranDescription: Beepy machines do not interessst this Floran.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. A server cabinet. What information could it contain?
racial.humanDescription: A server.
racial.hylotlDescription: A server cluster.
racial.novakidDescription: A machine containin' information.

missing.description: This sliding door makes me feel like I'm in a sci-fi game...

racial.apexDescription: A sliding door. Exciting.
racial.avianDescription: Some cultures believe that if you have no soul, these doors will not react.
racial.glitchDescription: Hypnotised. There is something fascinating about the movement of these doors.
racial.humanDescription: Once, I ran at a door like this and it didn't open in time and... yeah.
racial.hylotlDescription: A sleek sliding door.
racial.novakidDescription: I always liked these types of sliding doors.

missing.description: A simple metal table.

racial.apexDescription: A simple table.
racial.avianDescription: A basic table.
racial.floranDescription: This table would be good for ssslicing meat on.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A table.
racial.humanDescription: This is the second most generic table I've ever seen.
racial.hylotlDescription: A table. Unremarkable.
racial.novakidDescription: It's a table.

missing.description: A solid metal table.

racial.apexDescription: A simple table.
racial.avianDescription: It's just a table.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A plain table.
racial.humanDescription: This is the third most generic table I've ever seen.
racial.hylotlDescription: A table. Unremarkable.
racial.novakidDescription: I ain't a professional table judge, but this is a rather borin' table.

missing.description: Ideal for laying out battle strategies, holding meetings and snacking.

racial.apexDescription: A table with a warning strip. Maybe to warn you not to stub your toes?
racial.avianDescription: A table I wouldn't use at home, personally.
racial.floranDescription: Metal table is hard and sssturdy.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This is a solid metal table.
racial.humanDescription: An industrial looking table.
racial.hylotlDescription: An unremarkable and rather ugly table.
racial.novakidDescription: A table made from metal.

missing.description: A monitor displaying a task list.

racial.apexDescription: This appears to display a list of tasks that need completing. Someone is going to be busy.
racial.avianDescription: A well-ordered list. One of the items is "cleaning the latrines".
racial.floranDescription: A long lissst of tasssks. Just looking at it makes Floran tired.
racial.glitchDescription: Wary. One of the items on the list is "fix up the robot".
racial.humanDescription: A to-do list. It's not even mine and I'm feeling under stress.
racial.hylotlDescription: A neat, comprehensive list of tasks to accomplish. I approve of such forward-planning.
racial.novakidDescription: A list of chores. Who's got time for chores?

missing.description: A set of three TV monitors facing in different directions.'

racial.apexDescription: A series of monitors. They don't say anything interesting.
racial.avianDescription: A number of screens.
racial.glitchDescription: Bored. A few screens.
racial.humanDescription: Screens. They don't seem to be displaying much of anything.
racial.hylotlDescription: A set of three screens.
racial.novakidDescription: These screens don't come on.

missing.description: Sterile, recycled air whirs through the fanblades at a steady pace.

racial.apexDescription: A vent.
racial.avianDescription: A vent to recycle air.
racial.floranDescription: Floran can feel a ssslight breeze coming through here.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. The air recycling process isn't fully functional.
racial.humanDescription: An uninspiring vent.
racial.hylotlDescription: A vent with a fan.
racial.novakidDescription: It's a vent. Still, the air feels stuffy in here.

missing.description: This is just an electrical fire waiting to happen.

racial.apexDescription: Wires.
racial.avianDescription: Haphazard wires.
racial.floranDescription: Tugging wires is dangerousss. Floran learned this sssome time ago.
racial.glitchDescription: Cautious. Scans indicate a ninety eight percent chance of electrical failure.
racial.humanDescription: Cable ties are in short supply these days.
racial.hylotlDescription: A messy heap of wires. Unsafe.
racial.novakidDescription: Wires. They'll be powering somethin' around here.

missing.description: Someone couldn't count to 25.

racial.apexDescription: Similar markings are often found on the walls of Miniknog cells.
racial.avianDescription: Someone was counting something, but what?
racial.floranDescription: Floran uses these markssss to count killsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. This signifies twenty five occurrences of... something. We shall never know what.
racial.humanDescription: A series of tally marks, or some drawings of picket fences? Impossible to tell, really.
racial.hylotlDescription: A simple, yet effective method of counting.
racial.novakidDescription: A guy I once knew used to count kills this way.

missing.description: This looks like a nice place to hide.

racial.apexDescription: Luxurious curtains. Privacy is not something we Apex are used to.
racial.avianDescription: Flowing curtains. Like feathers in the breeze.
racial.floranDescription: Curtains are sssilky sssoft, but Floran prefersss leather.
racial.glitchDescription: Nostalgic. These curtains are as soft as Glitch bedsheets.
racial.humanDescription: Curtains. These are quite nice.
racial.hylotlDescription: Well-crafted curtains. They have a luxurious feel.
racial.novakidDescription: A soft curtain.

missing.description: The sign says "DANGER". Wait, how do these people know my middle name?

racial.apexDescription: This says danger, but there's no indication of what's dangerous...
racial.avianDescription: Something dangerous is nearby.
racial.floranDescription: Floran laugh in the face of danger. Haha!
racial.glitchDescription: Brave. This sign is more of a challenge than a warning.
racial.humanDescription: Is the danger nearby, or is the sign itself dangerous? The edges do look pretty sharp...
racial.hylotlDescription: A clear, if garish, warning.
racial.novakidDescription: The only danger here is me.

missing.description: The sign says "DANGER". Wait, how do these people know my middle name?

racial.apexDescription: This says danger, but there's no indication of what's dangerous...
racial.avianDescription: Something dangerous is nearby.
racial.floranDescription: Floran laugh in the face of danger. Haha!
racial.glitchDescription: Brave. This sign is more of a challenge than a warning.
racial.humanDescription: Is the danger nearby, or is the sign itself dangerous? The edges do look pretty sharp...
racial.hylotlDescription: A clear, if garish, warning.
racial.novakidDescription: The only danger here is me.

missing.description: Perfect for storing a lot of food and keeping it fresh.

racial.apexDescription: A fridge. Hopefully it contains banana milkshake.
racial.avianDescription: A fridge. Ideally filled with drinks and snacks.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. This fridge is operating at the optimal temperature.
racial.humanDescription: I'm practically vibrating with excitement thinking about the possible contents.
racial.hylotlDescription: Underwater, refrigeration is easier. These devices are a clever substitute.
racial.novakidDescription: A plain ol' fridge.

missing.description: A shiny glass panel.

racial.apexDescription: Coloured glass. Very pretty.
racial.avianDescription: This glass sparkles like jewels.
racial.floranDescription: Pretty glassss serves as bad hiding place.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. Human craftsmanship can be somewhat remarkable.
racial.humanDescription: Coloured glass like this can be used to make stylish sunglasses.
racial.hylotlDescription: This glass sparkles like colourful sea shells.
racial.novakidDescription: Clear glass. I can see right through it.

missing.description: This brightly coloured tape clearly indicates that the area is unsafe.

racial.apexDescription: This tape warns people of danger.
racial.avianDescription: There's a hazard nearby.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. Similar markings are used to denote areas in which self-aware Glitch lurk.
racial.humanDescription: I've always wanted to brush this kind of tape aside while flashing an ID.
racial.hylotlDescription: If they wanted it to serve as a warning, perhaps the humans should not have made this tape so colourful.
racial.novakidDescription: This tape is tryin' to tell me to keep my distance. I don't take orders from a tape.

missing.description: This brightly coloured tape clearly indicates that the area is unsafe.

racial.apexDescription: This tape warns people of danger.
racial.avianDescription: There's a hazard nearby.
racial.glitchDescription: Reminiscing. Similar markings are used to denote areas in which self-aware Glitch lurk.
racial.humanDescription: I've always wanted to brush this kind of tape aside while flashing an ID.
racial.hylotlDescription: If they wanted it to serve as a warming, perhaps the humans should not have made this tape so colourful.
racial.novakidDescription: This tape is tryin' to tell me to keep my distance. I don't take orders from a tape.

missing.description: This jukebox sounds great! Too bad there only seems to be one track.

racial.apexDescription: A cheerful music box. There's only one band, though.
racial.avianDescription: This jukebox can brighten even the darkest spirits.
racial.floranDescription: Noisssy box. Floran doesn't see the point!
racial.glitchDescription: Groovy. The music affects my circuits in such a way that I can't help but dance.
racial.humanDescription: Oh boy, they have my favourite album! Space just got funkier.
racial.hylotlDescription: Human music lacks the tonal nuance of its Hylotl counterpart.
racial.novakidDescription: These tunes are unfamiliar, but not bad I must admit.

missing.description: It's entrancing. I can't look away.

racial.apexDescription: A hypnotising lamp.
racial.avianDescription: This lamp demands to be stared at.
racial.floranDescription: Is thisss lamp living? It has moving insssides!
racial.glitchDescription: Calm. This liquid moves in a mesmerising way.
racial.humanDescription: Reminds me of a bad dream I once had.
racial.hylotlDescription: The way the liquid ebbs and flows makes me nostalgic.
racial.novakidDescription: This lamp looks the way I feel. Peculiar.

missing.description: What does USCM stand for, again?

racial.apexDescription: A sign promoting the USCM, a disbanded human military faction.
racial.avianDescription: This area clearly had a human military presence once.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstupid, blatant sign. Floransss try to be more sssneaky about their presence.
racial.glitchDescription: Thoughtful. Human military tactics involve a lot of bravado.
racial.humanDescription: The USCM, huh? These guys didn't like the Terrene Protectorate so much.
racial.hylotlDescription: The human military certainly like to make their presence felt.
racial.novakidDescription: I ain't heard o' these guys, but judgin' by the state of this sign, they've been gone a while.

missing.description: Nuke all the foods!

racial.apexDescription: A device for quickly cooking food.
racial.avianDescription: A bit like an oven, but quicker.
racial.floranDescription: Machine for heating sssnacks. Floran used one before.
racial.glitchDescription: Uncomfortable. Microwaves can be somewhat damaging to Glitch circuitry.
racial.humanDescription: I once microwaved a salad. It wasn't too bad, actually!
racial.hylotlDescription: A method of cooking for those who do not care about the quality of their preparation.
racial.novakidDescription: Not sure what this machine does... But it smells like somethin' died in there.

missing.description: It's been so long since I had a home cooked meal... or a home.

racial.apexDescription: An oven. Just thinking about cooking makes my stomach rumble.
racial.avianDescription: An oven, for making tasty dishes.
racial.floranDescription: Cooked meat tassstes even better than raw meat!
racial.glitchDescription: Relieved. A conventional oven. Time to whip up a banquet.
racial.humanDescription: This oven faintly smells of roast chicken. At least, I think it's chicken. Could be anything, really.
racial.hylotlDescription: An oven. Perfect if you want hot food.
racial.novakidDescription: An oven.

missing.description: An ornate gothic arch.

racial.apexDescription: Humans at least have pleasant architecture to look at.
racial.avianDescription: I can't decide if this is pretty or foreboding.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. Human and Glitch architecture seem to share certain similarities.
racial.humanDescription: This would go great with my spooky interior decorating skills.
racial.hylotlDescription: It is simple but there is something to be admired in the crafting.
racial.novakidDescription: Pretty or terrifying?

missing.description: Fire in a rusted-out barrel.

racial.apexDescription: A burning oil drum. I don't think this is official prison heating.
racial.avianDescription: Getting too close to this would scorch my feathers.
racial.floranDescription: Floran will keep fingers away from burning drum...
racial.glitchDescription: Uncomfortable. This almost looks like a burning Glitch.
racial.humanDescription: Ah, the old makeshift burning barrel. A classic.
racial.hylotlDescription: Despite the crude appearance, lighting a fire in a metal drum is somewhat inspired.
racial.novakidDescription: A heat source. A crude heat source.

missing.description: Thick metal bars surround each cell. Chance of escape seems pretty slim.

racial.apexDescription: Strong metal bars. Somehow, they're quite pretty.
racial.avianDescription: These bars look pretty sturdy.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. A remarkably strong set of bars.
racial.humanDescription: Bars. No matter which side we're on, aren't we always behind them? And now I have a headache.
racial.hylotlDescription: Even in a cage, a mind can travel freely.
racial.novakidDescription: You'd need some good tools to break outta here.

missing.description: A cold, hard slab of metal meant to serve as a bed.

racial.apexDescription: An uncomfortable-looking metal bed.
racial.avianDescription: This bed would benefit from a layer of hay.
racial.floranDescription: This is bed?! Floran feel bad.
racial.glitchDescription: Content. This bed would be perfectly comfortable for me.
racial.humanDescription: Sometimes the best way to punish someone is by making them sleep on such a bed.
racial.hylotlDescription: A remarkably uncomfortable bed. I would not want to end up sleeping here.
racial.novakidDescription: Some would say that an uncomfortable sleeping place is the worst punishment.

missing.description: A simple bench, save for the fact that the legs are nailed to the floor.

racial.apexDescription: A bench. It's a lot more comfortable than you'd expect.
racial.avianDescription: A fairly comfortable metal bench.
racial.floranDescription: Floran wouldn't mind sssitting here for a minute.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. A relatively comfortable bench.
racial.humanDescription: A bench. It's nailed to the floor. Disappointing. I could do with a new bench.
racial.hylotlDescription: A secure bench. Nobody will be stealing this in a hurry.
racial.novakidDescription: A seat for those who have lost their way.

missing.description: Looks like it used to be filled with medical supplies - not any more.

racial.apexDescription: A busted supply cabinet. Someone's looted it.
racial.avianDescription: This cabinet used to contain medicine, from the looks of it.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. The faintest trace of iodine can be detected.
racial.humanDescription: Is there anything more depressing than a ransacked medical cabinet? Actually, yeah, being torn apart by tentacle monsters.
racial.hylotlDescription: This cabinet should have been secured more thoroughly.
racial.novakidDescription: Stealing medicine is pretty low.

missing.description: A set of monitors displaying the feeds from security cameras. Watch out for paranormal activity.

racial.apexDescription: I'm sure I saw someone disappearing around a corner on one of the screens.
racial.avianDescription: I feel like a voyeur.
racial.floranDescription: Ssso many ssscreens. They're all equally uninteresssting.
racial.glitchDescription: Inspecting. I am certain one of these cameras is on a loop.
racial.humanDescription: One of these screens is displaying a feed of me watching the screens.
racial.hylotlDescription: What an intrusive set-up.
racial.novakidDescription: A spyin' station.

missing.description: A control panel that appears to operate lights, doors and alarms.

racial.apexDescription: It feels strange to be on the operating side of a security control panel.
racial.avianDescription: This appears to be the way to manage all sorts of security functions.
racial.floranDescription: What does thisss machine do? Floran is tempted to find out the quick way.
racial.glitchDescription: Understanding. This machine controls a variety of security functions.
racial.humanDescription: Tempted to gather up a bunch of prisoners then release them, just so I can yell "Jailbreak!"
racial.hylotlDescription: A hands-off approach to security management.
racial.novakidDescription: A control panel. Too bad it can't control the pests.

missing.description: A decorative gothic corner.

racial.apexDescription: Humans at least have pleasant architecture to look at.
racial.avianDescription: I can't decide if this is pretty or foreboding.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. Human and Glitch architecture seem to share certain similarities.
racial.humanDescription: This would go great with my spooky interior decorating skills.
racial.hylotlDescription: It is simple but there is something to be admired in the crafting.
racial.novakidDescription: Pretty or terrifying?

missing.description: A door made of thick metal bars.

racial.apexDescription: Strong metal bars. Somehow, they're quite pretty.
racial.avianDescription: These bars look pretty sturdy.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. A remarkably strong set of bars.
racial.humanDescription: Bars. No matter which side we're on, aren't we always behind them? And now I have a headache.
racial.hylotlDescription: Even in a cage, a mind can travel freely.
racial.novakidDescription: You'd need some good tools to break outta here.

missing.description: If you go this way, you're sure to be exiting... something.

racial.apexDescription: An exit sign.
racial.avianDescription: A sign pointing to the way out.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This sign points the way to the exit.
racial.humanDescription: A welcome sight for any prisoner. Unless you just happen to see it on the way to somewhere else, I suppose.
racial.hylotlDescription: The way out of here.
racial.novakidDescription: This way to the exit.

missing.description: It's a chain-link fence.

racial.apexDescription: A chain-link fence.
racial.avianDescription: A fence. Cruel mockery for the grounded.
racial.floranDescription: Floran is sssure Floran could jump this fence! But Floran won't try.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A chain-link fence.
racial.humanDescription: A strong chain-link fence.
racial.hylotlDescription: If this fence was under the ocean, I could just swim over it. Then again, why would it be?
racial.novakidDescription: A metal fence.

missing.description: It's a chain-link fence.

racial.apexDescription: A chain-link fence.
racial.avianDescription: A fence. Cruel mockery for the grounded.
racial.floranDescription: Floran is sssure Floran could jump this fence! But Floran won't try.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A chain-link fence.
racial.humanDescription: A strong chain-link fence.
racial.hylotlDescription: If this fence was under the ocean, I could just swim over it. Then again, why would it be?
racial.novakidDescription: A metal fence.

missing.description: There were some office supplies and inmate files in this filing cabinet.

racial.apexDescription: One of these files mentions a man imprisoned for throwing banana skins at vehicles. Chilling.
racial.avianDescription: A veritable host of criminal scum. Apparently someone dropkicked a Glitch.
racial.floranDescription: Ssso many files... This one sssays bad human ssset fire to a Floran! Desssspicable!
racial.glitchDescription: Amazed. Someone was imprisoned for assassinating an emperor. He was sent to jail for a week.
racial.humanDescription: There is a person here who looks just like me. It's a coincidence. I've never defaced a public mural.
racial.hylotlDescription: Someone was jailed for fishing without a license. I hope they threw away the key.
racial.novakidDescription: Inmate files. We all have our dark secrets n' regrets. I won't snoop.

missing.description: There were some office supplies and inmate files in this filing cabinet.

racial.apexDescription: Apparently public nudity is illegal for humans. Who knew?
racial.avianDescription: A woman was arrested for wearing overly large glasses. Apparently they were a fire hazard.
racial.floranDescription: This file cabinet is full of documented crimesss. Humans are a dangerousss bunch!
racial.glitchDescription: Subdued. A large number of humans go to prison for punching each other in the face.
racial.humanDescription: Oh hey, this woman's a pretty famous smuggler. Says here she broke out.
racial.hylotlDescription: This man has 'criminal' written all over his face. Quite literally. He seems proud of his accomplishments.
racial.novakidDescription: Inmate files. We all have our dark secrets n' regrets. I won't snoop.

missing.description: It feels like I'm on stage!

racial.apexDescription: Such spotlights are used by the Miniknog to force people to talk. Spotlights, and worse...
racial.avianDescription: An annoying, blinding light.
racial.floranDescription: Floran feelss like centre of attention.
racial.glitchDescription: Stealthy. By analysing this floodlight's patterns, it would be easy to sneak around it.
racial.humanDescription: I've always wanted to be in the spotlight.
racial.hylotlDescription: A bright, piercing floodlight.
racial.novakidDescription: A bright light.

missing.description: A flickering light to set that creepy mood.

racial.apexDescription: Such spotlights are used by the Miniknog to force people to talk. This one seems rather damaged though.
racial.avianDescription: An annoying, flickering light.
racial.glitchDescription: Annoyed. Someone should fix this light.
racial.humanDescription: A flickering light! A few more of these and we could open a nightclub!
racial.hylotlDescription: A damaged flood light. I doubt it will be replaced any time soon.
racial.novakidDescription: A flickerin' light source. Annoying.

missing.description: Some sort of solitary confinement device, maybe?

racial.apexDescription: This cell seems more secure than the rest.
racial.avianDescription: Being trapped in such a small space would be hellish, even for one of the grounded.
racial.floranDescription: Tiny pod to keep bad people inssside... But does it make them good again?
racial.glitchDescription: Cautious. The forcefield in this cell is designed to incapacitate.
racial.humanDescription: A cell designed for the most dangerous of prisoners. Killers, thieves, jaywalkers...
racial.hylotlDescription: A barbaric form of holding cell.
racial.novakidDescription: This sure is one tiny cell.

missing.description: Rusty old girder beams - can't be too safe.

racial.apexDescription: A rusted girder.
racial.avianDescription: An unsafe-looking girder.
racial.glitchDescription: Cautious. The likelihood of this girder collapsing is high.
racial.humanDescription: Looks perfectly safe to climb on.
racial.hylotlDescription: A rusty metal girder.
racial.novakidDescription: A rusty girder.

missing.description: Rusty old girder beams - can't be too safe.

racial.apexDescription: A rusted girder.
racial.avianDescription: An unsafe-looking girder.
racial.glitchDescription: Cautious. The likelihood of this girder collapsing is high.
racial.humanDescription: Looks perfectly safe to climb on.
racial.hylotlDescription: A rusty metal girder.
racial.novakidDescription: A rusty girder.

missing.description: Waz.

racial.apexDescription: It says 'WAZ'. Poignant.
racial.avianDescription: What does this word even mean? My translator has nothing.
racial.floranDescription: Floran write messsssage on wall in blood.
racial.glitchDescription: Academic. It is possible this is meant to convey the mathematical equation for evolution.
racial.humanDescription: Hehe. Waz. You guys.
racial.hylotlDescription: This is a word neither I or my translator are familiar with.

missing.description: Sure seems that way, Anonymous Graffiti Artist.

racial.apexDescription: No escape, apparently. A warning the Apex know too well.
racial.avianDescription: Someone clearly had a bleak outlook.
racial.floranDescription: Pretty writing, but Floran doesssn't agree with the messsage.
racial.glitchDescription: Dubious. Despite the graffiti's message, my scans indicate at least four methods of escape.
racial.humanDescription: Challenge accepted.
racial.hylotlDescription: The graffiti drips hopelessness as much as it drips paint.
racial.novakidDescription: Someone wrote this one a bad day.

missing.description: Graffiti. A harsh warning. Ignore it.

racial.apexDescription: "Get out while you still can". How do I know when that expires?
racial.avianDescription: I'm sure it's just a joke.
racial.floranDescription: Floran wonderss if the person writing this got out?
racial.glitchDescription: Alarmed. A severe warning.
racial.humanDescription: Oh, those jokers.
racial.hylotlDescription: Perhaps I should follow the advice.
racial.novakidDescription: A warnin' from someone. I will keep it in mind.

missing.description: A crudely-drawn skull. It looks cheerful.

racial.apexDescription: It looks like a human skull.
racial.avianDescription: A skull. Is it a warning?
racial.floranDescription: Floran likesss this drawing. Great artisssst.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. A crudely-drawn human skull.
racial.humanDescription: Another striking piece of street art.
racial.hylotlDescription: The artist was clearly inept.
racial.novakidDescription: A skull. Either it's a warning... or there be pirates here!

missing.description: Graffiti. The writer seems somewhat peeved.

racial.apexDescription: I wonder who this graffiti refers to.
racial.avianDescription: The poor writer.
racial.floranDescription: Floran is sssure the person came back. It's a happy ssstory, probably.
racial.glitchDescription: Sympathetic. Perhaps the writer should have been careful what they wished for.
racial.humanDescription: This is like something out of a horror movie.
racial.hylotlDescription: You can never count on anyone in this world.
racial.novakidDescription: Dramatic.

missing.description: Graffiti reading "turn back". Chances of it being adhered to: zero.

racial.apexDescription: I'll turn back when I reach a dead end.
racial.avianDescription: This graffiti is so pushy.
racial.floranDescription: Don't tell Floran what to do!
racial.glitchDescription: Defiant. No.
racial.humanDescription: How does this graffiti know which direction you've approached it from?
racial.hylotlDescription: Demanding.
racial.novakidDescription: There ain't no turnin' back now.

missing.description: The words "get out" have been written in blood. You can tell the writer was serious.

racial.apexDescription: This graffiti seems to be written in blood.
racial.avianDescription: Clearly the artist had a flair for the dramatic.
racial.glitchDescription: Uncomfortable. The blood used here came from a Hylotl.
racial.humanDescription: No, you get out!
racial.hylotlDescription: This graffiti artist needs to take a time out.
racial.novakidDescription: Written in blood. Was it their own?

missing.description: Rusted metal grates meant for ventilation.

racial.apexDescription: A rusted metal grate.
racial.avianDescription: A grate made of metal. It's rusty.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. Maybe an agile Glitch to fit through here.
racial.humanDescription: I've always wanted to go crawling through vents.
racial.hylotlDescription: A vent. It has not been looked after.
racial.novakidDescription: A vent. Ain't sure it's workin'. Sure is stuffy in here.

missing.description: Rusted metal grates meant for ventilation.

racial.apexDescription: A rusted metal grate.
racial.avianDescription: A grate made of metal. It's rusty.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. Maybe an agile Glitch to fit through here.
racial.humanDescription: I've always wanted to go crawling through vents.
racial.hylotlDescription: A vent. It has not been looked after.
racial.novakidDescription: A vent. Ain't sure it's workin'. Sure is stuffy in here.

missing.description: A good place to stash contraband.

racial.apexDescription: A locker. I wonder what's inside.
racial.avianDescription: A locker. Possibly filled with prisoner belongings.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstealing from thieves and robbers! Floran doesn't even feel bad.
racial.glitchDescription: Thoughtful. Is it a crime to steal stolen goods?
racial.humanDescription: I've always wanted to raid a prison locker, and now my dreams can come true!
racial.hylotlDescription: The prisoners are long-gone. It's fair to take what's inside.
racial.novakidDescription: A locker for criminals.

missing.description: A good place to stash contraband.

racial.apexDescription: A locker. I wonder what's inside.
racial.avianDescription: A locker. Possibly filled with prisoner belongings.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstealing from thieves and robbers! Floran doesn't even feel bad.
racial.glitchDescription: Thoughtful. Is it a crime to steal stolen goods?
racial.humanDescription: I've always wanted to raid a prison locker, and now my dreams can come true!
racial.hylotlDescription: The prisoners are long-gone. It's fair to take what's inside.
racial.novakidDescription: A locker for criminals.

missing.description: This mattress is filthy! I swear I just saw something crawling around inside.

racial.apexDescription: This is approaching Miniknog-level conditions.
racial.avianDescription: A disgusting mattress.
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. This mattress needs to be fumigated. I can detect life signs.
racial.humanDescription: I've slept on worse.
racial.hylotlDescription: A vile, rotting mattress. I would prefer to keep my distance.
racial.novakidDescription: What's that smell? It can't be... this mattress?!

missing.description: Looks like someone had a case of the Mondays.

racial.apexDescription: A broken mirror. Have to be careful not to cut myself.
racial.avianDescription: I won't be preening my feathers here any time soon.
racial.floranDescription: Sharp mirror shards make for good throwing daggersss.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. There are at least four hundred and six shards of glass here.
racial.humanDescription: Looks like someone's due for seven years bad luck. And for once it's not me!
racial.hylotlDescription: Such a breakage can only have been done in anger.
racial.novakidDescription: I can see my distorted reflection in the few remainin' pieces of mirror.

missing.description: Looks like someone had a case of the Mondays.

racial.apexDescription: A broken mirror. Have to be careful not to cut myself.
racial.avianDescription: I won't be preening my feathers here any time soon.
racial.floranDescription: Sharp mirror shards make for good throwing daggersss.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. There are at least four hundred and six shards of glass here.
racial.humanDescription: Looks like someone's due for seven years bad luck. And for once it's not me!
racial.hylotlDescription: Such a breakage can only have been done in anger.
racial.novakidDescription: I can see my distorted reflection in the few remainin' pieces of mirror.

missing.description: The panel displays information about interacting with prisoners...

racial.apexDescription: According to this, prisoners should not be poked with sticks.
racial.avianDescription: Apparently requests for "A nice cup of tea" are to be denied.
racial.floranDescription: "Do not harm the inmates." Too many ssstrict rulesss.
racial.glitchDescription: Sceptical. Seems guards have to perform checks to ensure prisoners are actually human. Surely this mistake isn't common?
racial.humanDescription: Prisoners are only allowed a maximum of thirty video games at one time. Talk about oppressive.
racial.hylotlDescription: This talks about something called 'water-boarding'. Perhaps some kind of treat.
racial.novakidDescription: A guide for interactin' with prisoners. "Remember: the inmate is never right".

missing.description: A notice written in ink.

racial.apexDescription: I cannot read this handwriting.
racial.avianDescription: I can't read this handwriting, it's chicken scratch.
racial.floranDescription: Ssome kind of notice... Floran finds the writing hard to read.
racial.glitchDescription: Baffled. It's really quite difficult to read this handwriting.
racial.humanDescription: If you're going to put a notice up, at least make it legible.
racial.hylotlDescription: The person who wrote this note has very attractive handwriting... Illegible, but attractive.
racial.novakidDescription: Some kinda notice... Darned if I can read the handwritin' though.

missing.description: The paper is ripped and the words are smudged.

racial.apexDescription: I'm sure whatever this said was very important.
racial.avianDescription: I can't entirely make the words out.
racial.floranDescription: Floran can't read this broken messsaage. Too bad!
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. It appears this was a passive-aggressive note aimed at someone stealing milk.
racial.humanDescription: This was clearly a hugely important message from USCM. It's impossible to read now.
racial.hylotlDescription: This paper appears to have had some liquid spilled on it.
racial.novakidDescription: The message is lost forever. It can't have been important.

missing.description: Inmate #2162's Study Group for Criminals Who Can't Read Good

racial.apexDescription: It appears prisoners were allowed to get an education, something the Miniknog specifically forbid.
racial.avianDescription: A flyer for a prisoners study group. It's nice to see prisoners trying to better themselves.
racial.floranDescription: Floran can't read good. Floran not underssstand thisss.
racial.glitchDescription: Optimistic. A flyer for a study group. The concept of prisoners learning skills while locked up fills me with positivity.
racial.humanDescription: A study group flyer. If I'd known prison could be educational, I'd have gone to jail instead of school.
racial.hylotlDescription: A poster for a study group. Encouraging prisoners to learn is something all cultures should do.
racial.novakidDescription: A flyer for a prisoners study group.

missing.description: A fence fashioned out of heavy metal pipes.

racial.apexDescription: A fence made of pipes. Clever.
racial.avianDescription: A fence. Cruel mockery for the grounded.
racial.floranDescription: Floran is sssure Floran could jump this fence! But Floran won't try.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. A series of pipes fashioned into a fence.
racial.humanDescription: A clever pipe fence.
racial.hylotlDescription: If this fence was under the ocean, I could just swim over it. Then again, why would it be?
racial.novakidDescription: A pipe fence.

missing.description: The space heater emits a low, unpleasant hum.

racial.apexDescription: A warm, cosy portable heater.
racial.avianDescription: Perfect for warming the feathers.
racial.floranDescription: Nice heat, no fire. Sssafe for Floran.
racial.glitchDescription: Disinterested. A small heater.
racial.humanDescription: A space heater. The name makes it sound futuristic and cool.
racial.hylotlDescription: A clever way to achieve warmth.
racial.novakidDescription: A radiator. I never felt the need for one.

missing.description: A security camera. An all-seeing eye.

racial.apexDescription: A security camera. Big Ape is watching?
racial.avianDescription: A security camera.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstaring little box with an eye. It's ssstaring at Floran!
racial.glitchDescription: Uncomfortable. I feel like I am being watched.
racial.humanDescription: I'm going to be a star!
racial.hylotlDescription: Such an invasion of privacy.
racial.novakidDescription: A security camera. Better be on my best behaviour.

missing.description: A shower. Perfect for a clean getaway. If the water was actually clean.

racial.apexDescription: I could use a shower about now.
racial.avianDescription: If only I had the time for a hot shower.
racial.glitchDescription: Uncomfortable. Showers and Glitch do not mix.
racial.humanDescription: I'd take a shower, but my singing might alert hostiles.
racial.hylotlDescription: The touch of water would be a blessing right now.
racial.novakidDescription: Ah, a shower.

missing.description: A shower. Perfect for a clean getaway.

racial.apexDescription: I could use a shower about now.
racial.avianDescription: If only I had the time for a hot shower.
racial.glitchDescription: Uncomfortable. Showers and Glitch do not mix.
racial.humanDescription: I'd take a shower, but my singing might alert hostiles.
racial.hylotlDescription: The touch of water would be a blessing right now.
racial.novakidDescription: Ah, a shower.

missing.description: The sign says, "Cell Block".

racial.apexDescription: A sign reading "Cell Block".
racial.avianDescription: This points to a cell block.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. "Cell Block".
racial.humanDescription: I've always wanted to visit a cell block! Wait, no, I'm thinking of the zoo.
racial.hylotlDescription: A sign for people incapable of looking at their surroundings.
racial.novakidDescription: The sign says "Cell Block".

missing.description: The sign says, "Mess Hall".

racial.apexDescription: Mess hall. Perhaps there's food beyond here.
racial.avianDescription: A sign pointing to a dining room of sorts.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. The sign for the mess hall.
racial.humanDescription: The idea of visiting a mess hall fills me with existential dread. I don't know why. Can't explain it.
racial.hylotlDescription: Why would humans label a room as messy instead of simply tidying up? Perhaps I have misunderstood.
racial.novakidDescription: A mess hall? I suppose inmates need food too.

missing.description: USCM, huh? I wouldn't wanna be one of their prisoners.

racial.apexDescription: A bold display of USCM authority - not that it means much anymore.
racial.avianDescription: No danger of forgetting who runs this place.
racial.floranDescription: A big rock for a ssshort name. Now Floran wantsss rock with Florans name!
racial.glitchDescription: Worried. This rock appears to have come from an ancient burial ground. It may be cursed!
racial.humanDescription: Something about this sign chills me to the core. It looks cold and weathered.
racial.hylotlDescription: The USCM, once again clamouring to make their presence felt.
racial.novakidDescription: This sure looks like a grand gravestone. For some, I'm sure it pretty much is.

missing.description: Just a typical cafeteria table.

racial.apexDescription: A table.
racial.avianDescription: An unremarkable table.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A regular table.
racial.humanDescription: A normal table.
racial.hylotlDescription: A table, no class or craftsmanship on display.
racial.novakidDescription: A plain lookin' table.

missing.description: Looks like someone had a rough night.

racial.apexDescription: We Apex are used to horrific conditions such as this.
racial.avianDescription: I think I'll go elsewhere.
racial.glitchDescription: Disgusted. I have no words.
racial.humanDescription: Nothing a bit of bleach and napalm won't sort.
racial.hylotlDescription: Never in my life have I seen such a grotesque disregard for basic hygiene.
racial.novakidDescription: No one likes cleanin' but this is beyond reasonable.

missing.description: A torture bed. Terrifying! Thank goodness for the pillow.

racial.apexDescription: A torture bed. Already, I'm getting flashbacks.
racial.avianDescription: A menacing torture bed. I don't even want to think about what's gone on here.
racial.floranDescription: Floran thinksss it looks comfortable! Is it really usssed for punishment?
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I wonder which methods of torture humans currently employ.
racial.humanDescription: Hey, a fairground ride! What's it doing in a prison though? Uh, right, it's a torture bed.
racial.hylotlDescription: Torture should be outlawed. Barbaric and cruel. It's a sick, sad universe.
racial.novakidDescription: The paddin' looks soft enough, but the straps tell a different story...

racial.novakidDescription: The paddin' looks soft enough, but the straps tell a different story...

missing.description: It's a turbine. Y'know, for science.

racial.apexDescription: A turbine. For, er, turbining things.
racial.avianDescription: This could blow the feathers straight off me.
racial.floranDescription: Floran tempted to leap into tube. Perhapsss Floran will.
racial.glitchDescription: Suspicious. The blades of this turbine are stained with trace amounts of blood.
racial.humanDescription: I believe these are here so that the USCM can quickly convert anything into a flying fortress. I may have made this up.
racial.hylotlDescription: A turbine. Such things can also be used underwater to power machines.
racial.novakidDescription: Ain't sure what these here are used for.

missing.description: Ooh, what should I get?

racial.apexDescription: A vending machine. No banana-flavoured snacks, sadly.
racial.avianDescription: Perfect to stave off hunger.
racial.glitchDescription: Indecisive. I can't decide what to buy.
racial.humanDescription: Oh boy, it's the kind of vending machine where you win every time!
racial.hylotlDescription: A vending machine for sugary drinks. They will have to do.
racial.novakidDescription: A vendin' machine for sugary type drinks.

missing.description: It's one of those drinking machines people use to make small-talk.

racial.apexDescription: Cool, clear water. Refreshing!
racial.avianDescription: I could do with a drink.
racial.floranDescription: Big water bottle is sstuck to the machine... Too bad.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. A water cooler. It keeps a larger amount of water cool.
racial.humanDescription: I'm so thirsty, I could drink a horse. If the horse was made of water.
racial.hylotlDescription: A small container of water. To see it in such short supply makes me long for home.
racial.novakidDescription: A water dispenser. Useful, if you're thirsty.

missing.description: A sturdy airlock door.

racial.apexDescription: A great big airlock door. Sturdy.
racial.avianDescription: An intimidatingly large metal door.
racial.floranDescription: Fishman build big sturdy doors! Not bad, Fishman... Not bad...
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. Where is the doorknob?
racial.humanDescription: This is a departure from the Hylotl's traditional aesthetic.
racial.hylotlDescription: This airlock door provides top-notch security.
racial.novakidDescription: A tough lookin' door.

missing.description: A sturdy airlock hatch.

racial.apexDescription: A great big airlock hatch. Sturdy.
racial.avianDescription: An intimidatingly large metal hatch.
racial.floranDescription: Fishman build big sturdy hatchesss! Not bad, Fishman... Not bad...
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. Where is the doorknob?
racial.humanDescription: This is a departure from the Hylotl's traditional aesthetic.
racial.hylotlDescription: This airlock hatch provides top-notch security.
racial.novakidDescription: A tough lookin' hatch.

missing.description: The machine runs a game called 'Psychedelic Rodeo Melee'.

racial.apexDescription: Psychedelic Rodeo Melee really opened my eyes. I see everything a little differently now.
racial.avianDescription: Psychedelic Rodeo Melee is actually a very soothing game.
racial.floranDescription: Floran thought game wasss called Psychotic Rodeo Melee, got excited. Is not.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. I give Psychedelic Rodeo Melee a 4/10.
racial.humanDescription: You'd never know it, given the title, but Psychedelic Rodeo Melee is pretty deep.
racial.hylotlDescription: I believe, at its core, Psychedelic Rodeo Melee is a coming-of-age story.
racial.novakidDescription: Psychedelic Rodeo Melee? This isn't like a real rodeo at all...

missing.description: Let's play some Dance-Dance!

racial.apexDescription: I'm not sure I will ever be good at Dance-Dance. The arrows move so fast!
racial.avianDescription: Dance-Dance isn't very talon-friendly.
racial.floranDescription: Stupid Dance-Dance arrows move too fassst!! Frustrate Floran!
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. It is an easy game, once you learn to recognize the patterns. 9/10.
racial.humanDescription: I wish I could tell the developers of Dance-Dance that their game reached the stars.
racial.hylotlDescription: Mastering the art of Dance-Dance can prove very challenging indeed.
racial.novakidDescription: Yeehaw! Let's get our Dance-Dance on!

missing.description: This machine runs a game called 'Stylish Thief Wasteland'.

racial.apexDescription: Stylish Thief Wasteland is about thieves robbing other thieves. The most stylish thief wins!
racial.avianDescription: It takes quite a bit of skill and luck to do well at Stylish Thief Wasteland.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstylish thieving game! Floran like this game!
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. Stylish Thief Wasteland sees stylish thieves facing off against other stylish thieves. 8/10.
racial.humanDescription: Stylish Thief Wasteland is the best! I'm going to be the most stylish thief of all.
racial.hylotlDescription: Stylish Thief Wasteland is often criticized for its depictions of violence, but you must admire their fashion sense.
racial.novakidDescription: There's somethin' about Stylish Thief Wasteland I can really relate to.

missing.description: This machine runs a game called 'Sleazy Burger Heroes'.

racial.apexDescription: Sleazy Burger Heroes is a game about flipping burgers. I love burgers!
racial.avianDescription: Achieving a good score in Sleazy Burger Heroes is all about honing your reflexes.
racial.floranDescription: Game about flipping meat. Makesss Floran hungry.
racial.glitchDescription: Entertained. Something about the tedious task of flipping burgers in order to achieve a higher score is quite addictive. 7/10.
racial.humanDescription: Sleazy Burger Heroes. A game about flipping burgers! It's oddly compelling.
racial.hylotlDescription: Sleazy Burger Heroes is a good game for keeping young children busy and entertained.
racial.novakidDescription: This here's a game called Sleazy Burger Heroes. Why pretend to flip burgers? Why?

missing.description: This machine runs 'Screaming Fashion Agent'.

racial.apexDescription: This game is called Screaming Fashion Agent. The things I've seen here... I will never forget them.
racial.avianDescription: It's a mystery game called Screaming Fashion Agent. Why are they screaming? Is that the mystery?
racial.floranDescription: Game is called Sscreaming Fashion Agent. Floran likess this game.
racial.glitchDescription: Uneasy. This game is called Screaming Fashion Agent and I am very unsettled by it. 6/10.
racial.humanDescription: Are fashion agents usually as terrifying as the one in Screaming Fashion Agent? What even is a fashion agent?
racial.hylotlDescription: I have heard rumours that Screaming Fashion Agent is an artistic retelling of a true crime story.
racial.novakidDescription: That fashion agent sure is screamin' a lot. Am I s'posed to figure out why?

missing.description: This machine runs a game called 'Cool Wizard Island'.

racial.apexDescription: It's called Cool Wizard Island. I think I'm supposed to rule over this island inhabited by Cool Wizard. Interesting...
racial.avianDescription: In Cool Wizard Island, my dream of ruling over an island inhabited by cool wizards can finally be realized.
racial.floranDescription: Wizardss in Cool Wizard Island set things on fire with handsss! How can Floran learn thiss trick?
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. If I'm not careful, I'll waste the whole day playing Cool Wizard Island. 9/10.
racial.humanDescription: In Cool Wizard Island, you're the wizard mayor on an island full of cool wizards. It was really popular back on Earth.
racial.hylotlDescription: Cool Wizard Island was one of my favourite arcade games as a young Hylotl. I liked to decorate the island.
racial.novakidDescription: Bein' a wizard mayor in Cool Wizard Island sure is time consumin'. I got no patience for that kinda responsibility.

missing.description: An arcade sign. There's probably an arcade nearby.

racial.apexDescription: An arcade!
racial.avianDescription: An arcade. Joyful!
racial.glitchDescription: Delighted. An amusement arcade!
racial.humanDescription: I love arcades! Take all of my money!
racial.hylotlDescription: Hmm, it's been a while since my last arcade trip. Could be fun!
racial.novakidDescription: An arcade?

missing.description: An arcade machine running a game called 'Starbound'.

racial.apexDescription: A space exploration game called Starbound. It feels familiar.
racial.avianDescription: Never heard of this Starbound game. And yet...
racial.floranDescription: Sstarbound spaceship game. Floran get achievement for sssmashing fourth wall.
racial.glitchDescription: Determined. I will set the high score on this new Starbound video game.
racial.humanDescription: Starbound? I can't say I've ever heard of this one. Must be old.
racial.hylotlDescription: This Starbound game speaks to me on a spiritual level.
racial.novakidDescription: Some kinda space explorin' game called Starbound. I do that stuff in real life!

missing.description: This machine runs a game called 'Zombie Banana Mansion'.

racial.apexDescription: Zombie Banana Mansion is a classic Apex game! It terrified me when I was young.
racial.avianDescription: Zombie Banana Mansion-- you must shoot all the zombies to preserve your mansion's stock of bananas. Interesting concept.
racial.floranDescription: Why sssave icky bananas? Just eat zombies!
racial.glitchDescription: Disturbed. Do the creatures in Zombie Banana Mansion exist in reality?
racial.humanDescription: Zombie Banana Mansion. Leave it to the Apex to make the preservation of bananas their highest priority.
racial.hylotlDescription: I understand the urge to protect one's home, but I find Zombie Banana Mansion excessively violent.
racial.novakidDescription: Zombie Banana Mansion? I've had just about enough of zombie games, truth be told.

missing.description: Bad Goo Plushie. A cuddly goo doll.

racial.apexDescription: An adorable goo doll.
racial.avianDescription: A cute little goo toy.
racial.glitchDescription: Appreciative. A cuddly little goo.
racial.humanDescription: Cool, I want one of these!
racial.hylotlDescription: Squee! I need this plushie for my collection!
racial.novakidDescription: Ain't sure what the point of this thing is.

missing.description: A wobbly bar stool.

racial.apexDescription: It's just a bar stool.
racial.avianDescription: A bar stool. I could do with sitting down.
racial.floranDescription: A round bar ssstool! Floran can ssspin on it! Dizzy fun.
racial.glitchDescription: Unimpressed. The metal on that stool needs a polish.
racial.humanDescription: Just like the classic bar stools back home.
racial.hylotlDescription: A rather typical seat found in urban bars.
racial.novakidDescription: A bar stool. I'm familiar with these. Too familiar.

missing.description: A cuddly bear plushy. Awwwww.

racial.apexDescription: An adorable cuddly bear.
racial.avianDescription: How cute, a cuddly toy bear.
racial.floranDescription: Fluffy toy is ssstaring at Floran.
racial.glitchDescription: Excited. This delightful bear is almost too much!
racial.humanDescription: I just wanna cuddle this bear forever.
racial.hylotlDescription: Shriek! A wonderful bear plushie. I need this one!
racial.novakidDescription: This lil' guy is pretty cute, I guess.

missing.description: An arcade machine with an interactive narrative game.

racial.apexDescription: A brightly coloured arcade machine, what sort of game is this?
racial.avianDescription: The game on this bright arcade machine seems like it could be relaxing.
racial.floranDescription: Thisss arcade machine isss colourful like a flower.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. Games of this type have an unclear objective.
racial.humanDescription: This bright machine has a popular Hylotl game on it.
racial.hylotlDescription: This one is a classic, every Hylotl knows all the endings.
racial.novakidDescription: This arcade machine is mighty pretty lookin'.

missing.description: Colourful ceiling lights found in clubs.

racial.apexDescription: Just need a fog machine to really give this place a nightclub vibe.
racial.avianDescription: I wonder what sort of crystal could give off a blue light?
racial.glitchDescription: Uninterested. It's a blue light.
racial.humanDescription: Ambient lights to set the mood. Which mood? Not sure.
racial.hylotlDescription: Ambient blue club lights.
racial.novakidDescription: This blue light sure lights up the room.

missing.description: The huge speakers pump out loud dance music.

racial.apexDescription: This music makes me want to dance!
racial.avianDescription: What is that terrible noise?
racial.floranDescription: This music make Floran want to move hipsss!
racial.glitchDescription: Negative. This music is not pleasant.
racial.humanDescription: Just your typical club music, not unlike the kind I've heard in clubs on Earth.
racial.hylotlDescription: This is a really popular club song.
racial.novakidDescription: Ain't heard anythin' like this before. Not sure it's my kinda tune.
