missing.description: The classiest curtain.

racial.apexDescription: -todo- this is a temporary object...
racial.avianDescription: Soft to the touch.
racial.floranDescription: Apex make curtain from heavy velvet, Floran make curtain from ssskin.
racial.glitchDescription: Tactile. Few objects are as pleasurable to caress.
racial.humanDescription: These curtains belong in a mansion.
racial.hylotlDescription: These curtains almost stick to Hylotl skin.

missing.description: A directional light used to illuminate items on display.

racial.apexDescription: It's a light, it's sole purpose is to point at that thing.
racial.avianDescription: I should check out what the light is pointing at, it might be more interesting.
racial.floranDescription: Bright light shinesss on pretty objects.
racial.glitchDescription: Humbled. This light is diligently performing it's one purpose.
racial.humanDescription: I should probably be more interested in what this light is aimed at.
racial.hylotlDescription: This light is here to illuminate a subject more worthy of my interest than itself.
racial.novakidDescription: I wonder what this light could be pointin' at?

missing.description: This light is meant to illuminate a display of some kind.

racial.apexDescription: Maybe it just needs a new bulb.
racial.avianDescription: What would it be illuminating if if was on?
racial.glitchDescription: Horrified. What a tragic sight, this light needs a replacement bulb urgently.
racial.humanDescription: This light it out, anyone got a spare bulb?
racial.hylotlDescription: What a shame, someone should really fix that light before it causes an accident.
racial.novakidDescription: Flickerin' like a dyin' flame.

missing.description: A light meant to draw attention to an area.

racial.apexDescription: It's a small spotlight.
racial.avianDescription: It's a small spotlight.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A spotlight.
racial.humanDescription: A perfectly ordinary spotlight.
racial.hylotlDescription: An ordinary spotlight.
racial.novakidDescription: A spotlight.

missing.description: A small light that can work in water.

racial.apexDescription: A normal light bulb, protected so it can function underwater.
racial.avianDescription: This light appears to be waterproof so it can work in open water.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A waterproof light.
racial.humanDescription: It's a light designed to function when exposed to water.
racial.hylotlDescription: It's just a waterproof light bulb.
racial.novakidDescription: This light here is waterproof. Ingenious.

missing.description: A small flickering light that can work in water.

racial.apexDescription: A normal flickering light bulb, protected so it can function underwater.
racial.avianDescription: This flickering light appears to be waterproof so it can work in open water.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A flickering waterproof light.
racial.humanDescription: It's a flickering light designed to function when exposed to water.
racial.hylotlDescription: It's just a waterproof flickering light bulb.
racial.novakidDescription: This light here is waterproof. Something still managed to damage it.

missing.description: A classic football...or soccer ball, if you prefer.

racial.apexDescription: Some sort of ball meant for sport.
racial.avianDescription: Some sort of bouncing ball.
racial.floranDescription: What does Floran do with this?
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. Why does the ball have white and black spots?
racial.humanDescription: A football! Surprised to see one of these out here.
racial.hylotlDescription: It's a football. They've become popular with young Hylotl recently.
racial.novakidDescription: I type of decorative object, I believe.

missing.description: A large bronze statue of the Hylotl's home planet.

racial.apexDescription: Must be a model of the Hylotl's home planet.
racial.avianDescription: A model of the Hylotl's home planet, perhaps?
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. Is it the Hylotl's home planet?
racial.humanDescription: Looks like a big statue of the Hylotl's home planet.
racial.hylotlDescription: Ahh, home sweet home.
racial.novakidDescription: A planet I don't recognise.

missing.description: A light that can switch between green and red.

racial.apexDescription: Access denied by a lightbulb? This is a new low.
racial.avianDescription: I like this lightbulb better when it's green.
racial.floranDescription: Red or green makesss no difference. Floran will passs.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This light can be red or green.
racial.humanDescription: It's red, then it's green. What does it mean?
racial.hylotlDescription: This simple light holds the power to deny or grant access.
racial.novakidDescription: A colour changin' light. Is it tryin' to communicate somethin'?

missing.description: A classic air hockey table. First to ten wins!

racial.apexDescription: Air hockey? It looks fun!
racial.avianDescription: It's a sort of table game with pucks. It could be fun...
racial.floranDescription: Floran could beat anyone at ssstupid table game.
racial.glitchDescription: Determined. I will master this table game.
racial.humanDescription: Air hockey! I was great at this as a kid...
racial.hylotlDescription: To win at air hockey, one must have superb reflexes.
racial.novakidDescription: Air hockey? Is it anythin' like a game o' pool?

missing.description: Legend has it that if you spend the night in this bed, you'll lose consciousness.

racial.apexDescription: This bed is simple without being basic.
racial.avianDescription: A plain bed, it looks comfortable.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. This bed seems almost too simple, but its materials are high quality.
racial.humanDescription: This bed looks like it has a tradional style that hasn't needed to change.
racial.hylotlDescription: An exquisite traditional bed. Many species could learn from this.
racial.novakidDescription: Seen worse beds than this. Seen better too.

missing.description: A simple striped bowl.

racial.apexDescription: A striped bowl.
racial.avianDescription: A basic striped bowl.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. A bowl.
racial.humanDescription: It's a bowl.
racial.hylotlDescription: A pretty hand-painted bowl.
racial.novakidDescription: Good for servin' hot soup.

missing.description: Who knows what it might activate... just press it!

racial.glitchDescription: Tempted. A button, begging to be pressed.
racial.avianDescription: A rather tantalizing button.
racial.apexDescription: So much power in a simple button.
racial.humanDescription: An oversized button.
racial.hylotlDescription: A well made button.
racial.novakidDescription: A button. Should I press it?

racial.humanDescription: This is like one of those modern art pieces. I'm not a fan.
racial.hylotlDescription: The stark beauty brings tears to my eyes.

racial.avianDescription: Uninspiring to all but the Hylotl.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. Perhaps the Hylotl should frame the word 'hubris' instead.
racial.humanDescription: This is like one of those modern art pieces. I'm not a fan.
racial.hylotlDescription: The stark beauty brings tears to my eyes.
racial.novakidDescription: Looks like an accident happened on this canvas.

missing.description: Ka-ching!

racial.apexDescription: A device used to calculate transactions.
racial.avianDescription: A device used in the selling of things.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I wonder how well this establishment does, financially?
racial.humanDescription: Looks like a cash register.
racial.hylotlDescription: It is a cash register.
racial.novakidDescription: A machine for storin' currency.

missing.description: A teal blue chair.

racial.apexDescription: It's a chair.
racial.avianDescription: A blue chair.
racial.glitchDescription: Uninterested. I don't need to sit...
racial.humanDescription: It's a chair.
racial.hylotlDescription: A simple teal chair.
racial.novakidDescription: It's a chair.

missing.description: A framed poster of a city.

racial.apexDescription: It's a very nice photo of a city.
racial.avianDescription: A picture of an unfamiliar city.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. What city is depicted in this photograph?
racial.humanDescription: It's a really lovely photo. Reminds me a little of home.
racial.hylotlDescription: A beautiful photograph of a modern city. I could cry.
racial.novakidDescription: A big unfamiliar cityscape.

missing.description: A master work of craftsmanship. Beautiful.

racial.apexDescription: A number of Hylotl books. I'll, uh, read them later.
racial.avianDescription: There are a lot of books on Hylotl history here.
racial.floranDescription: Fishmen like to read. Ssstupid boring fishmen.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. Every single book is about how wonderful the Hylotl are. How tedious.
racial.humanDescription: I fell asleep just reading the titles.
racial.hylotlDescription: A bookshelf rich in Hylotl history. Other species flock to our grand libraries.
racial.novakidDescription: Shelves filled with books on Hylotl topics. I can think of several things I'd rather do than readin' these.

missing.description: A wooden cabinet. Its doors are full of etched decoration.

racial.apexDescription: Has someone defaced this cabinet, or is it meant to look like this?
racial.avianDescription: These decorations look nice! If you squint, anyway.
racial.floranDescription: Floran wondersss who decorated this ugly cabinet.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. Was this cabinet decorated by a child? It appears so.
racial.humanDescription: It appears as if an amateur artist has tried to decorate this. How quaint.
racial.hylotlDescription: The depth and meaning in these carvings is breathtaking.
racial.novakidDescription: A funny lookin' cabinet. Who would consider this pretty?

missing.description: A high-class wooden chair, is it intended for important figures.

racial.apexDescription: A decent chair. Not bad!
racial.avianDescription: This chair is pretty nice, I don't understand why it is for important guests.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This chair has been carved with care.
racial.humanDescription: Okay to sit on for a little while.
racial.hylotlDescription: Such astonishing chairs are reserved only for the most regal individuals.
racial.novakidDescription: Ain't a bad chair, I will admit.

missing.description: A classic style desk.

racial.apexDescription: A desk with lots of storage. Nice!
racial.avianDescription: This feels like the kind of desk to hold many secrets in it's drawers.
racial.glitchDescription: Neutral. It is an old desk.
racial.humanDescription: An old, musty desk.
racial.hylotlDescription: This is a fine example of a desk.
racial.novakidDescription: A desk. I don't enjoy spendin' much time at these.

missing.description: Hey, this gong has a big chip in it... oh. Oh, I see. It's a lily pad.

racial.apexDescription: I guess this gong is nice if you're into this kind of thing.
racial.avianDescription: The shape of the gong means it doesn't ring quite right.
racial.floranDescription: Floran sssmash gong, but noissse not sssatisfying.
racial.glitchDescription: Thoughtful. While the shape impairs the sound, it is pleasing to the eye.
racial.humanDescription: A gong in the shape of a lily pad. I could picture these in a gift shop.
racial.hylotlDescription: Such stunning work, it's almost a shame to hit it.
racial.novakidDescription: An instrument for makin' loud noises. For what purpose, I couldn't tell ye...

missing.description: An old calligraphy painting depicting an early Hylotl warrior.

racial.apexDescription: This looks like an old art print. I wonder how they keep it in such good condition?
racial.avianDescription: It is curious just how different cultures have different battle styles.
racial.floranDescription: Fleshy warrior would fight better with Floran weaponsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This warrior's pose shows he is ready for battle.
racial.humanDescription: This guy is posed ready to strike! Exciting stuff.
racial.hylotlDescription: An early Hylotl warrior, trained to defend his people. Inspiring.
racial.novakidDescription: This fella looks ready for action, doesn't he?

missing.description: A traditional style table.

racial.apexDescription: A good table to conduct research from.
racial.avianDescription: This table looks as though it's barely used.
racial.glitchDescription: Underwhelmed. One cannot imagine such a table in a fortress.
racial.humanDescription: My Grandpa used to own a table like this.
racial.hylotlDescription: A fine balance of ornamental and practical.
racial.novakidDescription: A strange desk.

missing.description: A delicately designed wooden table.

racial.apexDescription: A small table. It doesn't look very sturdy.
racial.avianDescription: The flimsy legs of this table look as if they could snap at any moment.
racial.floranDescription: Old table too fragile for Floran to use for chopping meat.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. One swift kick and this table would fall apart.
racial.humanDescription: This table wobbles quite easily.
racial.hylotlDescription: With a table like this, every meal is a joyous experience.
racial.novakidDescription: A simple table. Don't look sturdy to me.

missing.description: The lily pad rotates to lock its doors.

racial.apexDescription: This wardrobe is almost really nice!
racial.avianDescription: The lily pad ruins what is otherwise a decent enough wardrobe.
racial.floranDescription: Floran hide in wardrobe. Burssst out. Sssurprise friends. Fun!
racial.glitchDescription: Diplomatic. The lily pad motif is an interesting design choice.
racial.humanDescription: The lock on this wardrobe is fiddly and difficult to turn.
racial.hylotlDescription: An exceptional wardrobe with an inspired locking mechanism.
racial.novakidDescription: The lily pad seems to be a lock. Clever.

missing.description: A touch-screen console with all sorts of fun buttons.

racial.apexDescription: I wonder what happens if I press... This button?
racial.avianDescription: It's very tempting to press the buttons...
racial.floranDescription: Floran wants to presss all the nice buttonss.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I'm very tempted to press all these buttons.
racial.humanDescription: Maybe pressing a button or two will lead to something interesting.
racial.hylotlDescription: I should avoid pressing buttons... Who knows what might happen?
racial.novakidDescription: A console with several temptin' buttons. Should I...?

missing.description: A counter that oddly resembles a Hylotl.

racial.apexDescription: The Hylotl sure like to create things in their likeness.
racial.avianDescription: This counter is set with gems that resemble Hylotl eyes.
racial.floranDescription: Just like fishman to make furniture looksss just like them.
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. This piece of Hylotl furniture looks much like one of the Hylotl themselves.
racial.humanDescription: The Hylotl seem to enjoy making furniture in their own likeness.
racial.hylotlDescription: We Hylotl are intensely proud of our aesthetics, and thus enjoy creating art that resembles us.
racial.novakidDescription: Is that a Hylotl face starin' back at me from a piece of furniture? Uncanny.

missing.description: A vending machine filled with popular beverages.

racial.apexDescription: It's full of all sorts of soft drinks.
racial.avianDescription: The drinks in here look a little sweet for my taste...
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. I wouldn't mind trying some of these foreign beverages.
racial.humanDescription: The machine is selling soft drinks. I wonder what Reef-Cola tastes like?
racial.hylotlDescription: Personally, I'm quite partial to Reef-Cola.
racial.novakidDescription: Never been a great fan of fizzy drinks.

missing.description: It's a common emblem for the Hylotl. Three crystals representing their three eyes...

racial.apexDescription: The symbol of the Hylotl people.
racial.avianDescription: Avians prefer wing symbolism over eye symbolism.
racial.floranDescription: Three Hylotl eyes sssstaring at Floran... Floran doesn't like!
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. This Hylotl symbol is unsettling due to them having too many eyes.
racial.humanDescription: The Hylotl symbol for their people.
racial.hylotlDescription: A symbol of my people.
racial.novakidDescription: An emblem. The three gems represent Hylotl eyes, I guess.

missing.description: A hologram displaying the latest trends in Hylotl fashion.

racial.apexDescription: The Hylotl have interesting taste in clothes.
racial.avianDescription: These styles are not what I'm used to...
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. I wonder if these clothes would suit me.
racial.humanDescription: For all their pretentiousness, I have to admit the Hylotl are stylish.
racial.hylotlDescription: These looks are very on-trend.
racial.novakidDescription: Maybe I should give Hylotl fashion a go?

missing.description: It's some sort of floor ornament. Frog spawn swirls inside.

racial.apexDescription: There's frog spawn inside this. That is kind of gross.
racial.avianDescription: There's frog spawn floating around inside this thing. Who would want this on display?
racial.floranDescription: Floran can sssee little baby frogs swimming inside orb. Can Floran eatsss them?
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. It appears to be an orb with living frog spawn.
racial.humanDescription: Woah, there are frog spawns swimming around inside this ball. The temptation to smash this is overwhelming.
racial.hylotlDescription: I can see the precious frog spawn swimming around inside. A celebration of Hylotl life.
racial.novakidDescription: Are those frog spawn swimming inside the orb?

missing.description: A rack of traditional swords.

racial.apexDescription: An impressive display of traditional weaponry.
racial.avianDescription: An entire rack filled with sharp swords.
racial.glitchDescription: Fascinated. Many years of skill went into forming these blades.
racial.humanDescription: A whole rack of swords... I want to swing one about.
racial.hylotlDescription: A classic weapon, an apprentice trains for years before even forging one.
racial.novakidDescription: A rack o' swords, these sure are... Classic.

missing.description: A small lamp that gives off a low red light.

racial.apexDescription: I wonder what this lamp is made of?
racial.avianDescription: This looks similar in concept to Avian crystal lamps.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. I wonder how such lamps are made?
racial.humanDescription: It looks a little like a Hylotl eye. I wonder what it's made of?
racial.hylotlDescription: The glowing gem is cut to resemble a Hylotl eye. It gives off a very atmospheric light.
racial.novakidDescription: A lamp. It's okay.

missing.description: A paper ceiling lamp.

racial.apexDescription: A paper lantern doesn't seem like the best idea for fire safety.
racial.avianDescription: I wonder how often these catch fire.
racial.floranDescription: Paper lantern dangerousss to Floran. Fire!
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. A paper lantern. That definitely passes health and safety.
racial.humanDescription: Oh god, not the bees! Wait, it's a paper lantern. Well that's boring.
racial.hylotlDescription: A hand-crafted paper lantern. Eventually, the moisture takes them, as it does to us all.
racial.novakidDescription: Anyone knows it ain't a good idea to combine paper with a hot bulb.

missing.description: A clock in the shape of a lily pad.

racial.apexDescription: A clock in the shape of a lily pad. How adorable.
racial.avianDescription: It looks like some kind of fairground novelty.
racial.floranDescription: Tick tock tick tock fishmen have a ssstupid clock.
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. What a whimsical shape for a clock.
racial.humanDescription: This is kind of cute, for a gimmick.
racial.hylotlDescription: Not just a remarkable example of practicality, but a commentary on the fleeting nature of time itself.
racial.novakidDescription: A lily pad clock. I used to have a clock shaped like a cactus.

missing.description: A small lily pad decoration.

racial.apexDescription: A decorative lily pad. Nice.
racial.avianDescription: I haven't seen this many lily pads since that time I crash-landed in a swamp.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstupid plastic plant. Floran is disssgusted!
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. Someone is fond of lily pads.
racial.humanDescription: The perfect gift for someone who adores lily pads. Unfortunately, that someone is not me.
racial.hylotlDescription: The beauty of nature, captured in a single piece.
racial.novakidDescription: Someone sure likes their lily pads, huh.

missing.description: A small set of lily pad wall hangings.

racial.apexDescription: A decorative lily pad. Nice.
racial.avianDescription: I haven't seen this many lily pads since that time I crash-landed in a swamp.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstupid plastic plant. Floran is disssgusted!
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. Someone is fond of lily pads.
racial.humanDescription: The perfect gift for someone who adores lily pads. Unfortunately, that someone is not me.
racial.hylotlDescription: The beauty of nature, captured in a single piece.
racial.novakidDescription: Someone sure likes their lily pads, huh.

missing.description: A large lily pad wall hanging.

racial.apexDescription: A decorative lily pad. Nice.
racial.avianDescription: I haven't seen this many lily pads since that time I crash-landed in a swamp.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstupid plastic plant. Floran is disssgusted!
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. Someone is fond of lily pads.
racial.humanDescription: The perfect gift for someone who adores lily pads. Unfortunately, that someone is not me.
racial.hylotlDescription: The beauty of nature, captured in a single piece.
racial.novakidDescription: Someone sure likes their lily pads, huh.

missing.description: It looks like a decorative lily pad.

racial.apexDescription: A decorative lily pad. Nice.
racial.avianDescription: I haven't seen this many lily pads since that time I crash-landed in a swamp.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstupid plastic plant. Floran is disssgusted!
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. Someone is fond of lily pads.
racial.humanDescription: The perfect gift for someone who adores lily pads. Unfortunately, that someone is not me.
racial.hylotlDescription: The beauty of nature meets the harshness of the urban sprawl.
racial.novakidDescription: Someone sure likes their lily pads, huh.

missing.description: Don't use your finger! This trusty sensor indicates the presence of liquids.

racial.apexDescription: A useful object, it can be used for the detection of liquids.
racial.avianDescription: I have heard of these, they somehow detect liquids.
racial.floranDescription: Sssensor detects liquidsss. Can trip wiresss.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This device can detect liquid for use in wiring set-ups.
racial.humanDescription: I've heard of these, these were made to detect liquid for fancy wiring set-ups.
racial.hylotlDescription: One of my favourite devices, this automatically detects the presence of liquids.
racial.novakidDescription: This is one of those fancy liquid detectors.

missing.description: A blue mailbox.

racial.apexDescription: It's a mailbox.
racial.avianDescription: A box for sending letters.
racial.glitchDescription: Indifferent. A dropbox for mail.
racial.humanDescription: It's a mailbox.
racial.hylotlDescription: It's only a mailbox.
racial.novakidDescription: A box for sending mail? Don't look like a teleportation device to me...

missing.description: A framed poster from the movie "Cybernetic Apocalypse".

racial.apexDescription: Looks like another unrealistic giant robot movie.
racial.avianDescription: It appears to be a movie about giant walking mechs.
racial.floranDescription: Floran doesn't need big clunky metal robotsss. Floran only need ssstabby knife.
racial.glitchDescription: Interested. The robots in this film look powerful indeed.
racial.humanDescription: It's a giant robot movie! Those are fun.
racial.hylotlDescription: Another mindless action movie about giant robots.
racial.novakidDescription: A movie featurin' a giant tin man.

missing.description: A framed poster from the movie "Fiery Blade Crusader".

racial.apexDescription: This looks like one of those 'bloody quest for vengeance' movies.
racial.avianDescription: It looks like the sort of story with a sad ending...
racial.floranDescription: This is a movie Floran might like.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I wonder what the crusader is crusading against with his fiery blade?
racial.humanDescription: It's very reminiscent of an old samurai movie I once watched...
racial.hylotlDescription: Despite its cliche title, "Fiery Blade Crusader" is a truly beautiful film.
racial.novakidDescription: Looks like a movie about a lone warrior... I'd be up for watchin' this.

missing.description: A framed poster from the controversial romance film "10 Things I Hate About Florans".

racial.apexDescription: "10 Things I Hate About Florans". Sounds pretty sappy. And...kind of racist?
racial.avianDescription: "10 Things I Hate About Florans". I can think of a few things I don't like about Florans.
racial.floranDescription: Movie called "10 Things I Hate About Florans"... Floran should burn thisss!
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. "10 Things I Hate About Florans". Ten things? I can only think of three.
racial.humanDescription: This movie looks...boring.
racial.hylotlDescription: A very controversial romance film about a forbidden relationship between a Floran and Hylotl.
racial.novakidDescription: A poster for a romantic comedy. "10 Things I Hate About Florans".

missing.description: It's a painting of a great big wave.

racial.apexDescription: This painting is quite nice.
racial.avianDescription: Not bad! Brushwork's a bit sloppy, though.
racial.floranDescription: Floran not care for silly wave painting.
racial.glitchDescription: Envious. The artist was able to capture the wave perfectly.
racial.humanDescription: I'm pretty sure we had this exact same painting on Earth.
racial.hylotlDescription: Each brush stroke drips with emotion, the beauty of the waves captured for all eternity.
racial.novakidDescription: This painting of a giant wave sure is impressive.

missing.description: It's a copy of an old, famous painting.

racial.apexDescription: This painting is quite nice.
racial.avianDescription: Not bad! Brushwork's a bit sloppy, though.
racial.floranDescription: Floran not care for silly mountain painting.
racial.glitchDescription: Envious. This painting may be a copy, but it is well painted.
racial.humanDescription: I'm pretty sure we had this exact same painting on Earth.
racial.hylotlDescription: A stunning cavalcade of colour and emotion.
racial.novakidDescription: This is some kinda classic painting.

missing.description: It's a painting of a bridge over still water.

racial.apexDescription: This bridge doesn't look structurally sound, but it is pretty.
racial.avianDescription: What a pretty scene! I'd like to visit this place, if it was real.
racial.floranDescription: Floran wantsss to hide under bridge to ssscare people.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. The bridge in this painting appears fairly safe to cross.
racial.humanDescription: What a nice painting. If this bridge was real, I'd cross it again and again.
racial.hylotlDescription: The subdued strokes of this painting accentuate the tranquillity of the scene.
racial.novakidDescription: I wonder if a wagon could cross a small bridge like this beauty.

missing.description: A replica plant, it is obviously made of plastic.

racial.apexDescription: Why would anyone want a fake plant?
racial.avianDescription: A fake plant. Nice.
racial.glitchDescription: Unimpressed. A plastic plant. Cheap.
racial.humanDescription: Reminds me of waiting rooms.
racial.hylotlDescription: A disgusting fake plastic plant.
racial.novakidDescription: These leaves sure feel tough... Hang on, it's plastic!

missing.description: A decorative wooden post with a lantern in it.

racial.apexDescription: An unremarkable post.
racial.avianDescription: Pretty good for sharpening one's beak on.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. Even for a basic post, this is uninspiring.
racial.humanDescription: This post seems quite wobbly.
racial.hylotlDescription: This provides an pleasing outside light source.
racial.novakidDescription: A post with a lantern. Shine on, buddy.

missing.description: A glass case full of plushies and toys.

racial.apexDescription: Oohh, I wonder if I can win the unicorn plush?
racial.avianDescription: I wouldn't mind winning a Poptop plushie, myself.
racial.glitchDescription: Motivated. I'd like to win some of these...
racial.humanDescription: I'm partial to that Numi plushie...wonder how much it costs?
racial.hylotlDescription: Oooh! I want them all!
racial.novakidDescription: Ain't much for stuffed toys, but these are pretty cute.

missing.description: A bright blue alarm

racial.apexDescription: This light will flash and an alarm will sound when there is an emergency.
racial.avianDescription: A flashing light and siren that signal an emergency.
racial.glitchDescription: Nervous. A siren that announces an emergency.
racial.humanDescription: Is a blue alert different from a red alert emergency?
racial.hylotlDescription: A light that signals an emergency.
racial.novakidDescription: A warnin' light for when danger is near.

missing.description: A shoji screen door.

racial.apexDescription: A simple door. Serves its purpose.
racial.avianDescription: A decent door that lets plenty of light in.
racial.floranDescription: Once, Floran fall through door like thisss.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. This door is simply perfect if you abhor privacy.
racial.humanDescription: A flimsy door. Not much good at keeping anything out.
racial.hylotlDescription: The contours and construction of this door allow for a perfectly smooth opening motion.
racial.novakidDescription: This door don't seem safe. I could poke a hole in it with my finger.

missing.description: A screen for modest individuals to hide behind while getting changed.

racial.apexDescription: A screen. Apex are not allowed such things.
racial.avianDescription: This screen looks like it could fall over in the slightest breeze.
racial.floranDescription: Floran could poke two holes in ssscreen and peek through!
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. You can practically see through this screen. Pointless.
racial.humanDescription: You couldn't really hide behind this screen. People would see your silhouette.
racial.hylotlDescription: Modesty, integrity, beauty. This screen has it all.
racial.novakidDescription: A thin paper screen. I can practically see right through it.

missing.description: A cheery welcome sign meant for Hylotl-owned shops.

racial.apexDescription: This cheery Hylotl face is welcoming me into a shop. How can I resist?
racial.avianDescription: That face looks quite friendly.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. Maybe I should see what this shop has to offer.
racial.humanDescription: That cheery Hylotl face is tempting me into this shop.
racial.hylotlDescription: The sign is meant to indicate good customer service.
racial.novakidDescription: A shop sign. Maybe I should see what they have for sale.

missing.description: A table set at kneeling height.

racial.apexDescription: A small table. It doesn't look very sturdy.
racial.avianDescription: This table is set very low, it is unusual.
racial.floranDescription: Table too fragile for Floran to chop meat on.
racial.glitchDescription: Wary. I am not used to such a low table.
racial.humanDescription: This table is so low I wouldn't even need a chair. Maybe that is the idea.
racial.hylotlDescription: With a table like this, every meal is a joyous experience.
racial.novakidDescription: The lowest table I ever did see.

missing.description: A blue neon sign decorated with a seashell.

racial.apexDescription: Looks like the Hylotl are actually interested in something other than lily pads.
racial.avianDescription: The sign is buzzing faintly.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. Why are the arrows pointing to the shell?
racial.humanDescription: What is this sign telling me? Buy seashells? Collect seashells?
racial.hylotlDescription: I remember a lot of Hylotl used to collect seashells. It was quite the craze.
racial.novakidDescription: There's a seashell on that there sign.

missing.description: A green neon sign advertising furniture from a lily pad inspired design movement.

racial.apexDescription: This sign appears to advertise... a lily pad.
racial.avianDescription: Which lily pad is this sign even pointing to?
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. A sign depicting a lily pad! The Hylotl seem exceedingly fond of lilies.
racial.humanDescription: I wonder what this sign points to. Maybe the lily pad shop?
racial.hylotlDescription: Just seeing this sign brings warmth to my heart. So many memories.
racial.novakidDescription: A lily pad, if I ain't mistaken.

missing.description: An orange neon sign displaying what seems to be Big Ape.

racial.apexDescription: Big Ape's visage stretches even to the deep seas. Frightening.
racial.avianDescription: The face looks kind of like an Apex. Odd.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. Is this meant to be Big Ape?
racial.humanDescription: This displays an... Apex? What is this doing here?
racial.hylotlDescription: "Giant Gorilla is attracted to fish"? Seems like this was poorly translated.
racial.novakidDescription: Is that an Apex?

missing.description: A sign that looks like it says "BUBBLE"...

racial.apexDescription: A sign saying "bubble". That's nice, I suppose!
racial.avianDescription: I'm hesitant to even follow this sign's direction.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. A sign that simply says "bubble". How useful.
racial.humanDescription: I feel like these signs are more for decorative purposes. I can't see what this could advertise.
racial.hylotlDescription: Bubbles. Beautiful orbs of life floating up to the vast skies above.
racial.novakidDescription: Someone really likes bubbles.

missing.description: A sign that looks like it says "RIBBIT"...

racial.apexDescription: A sign saying "ribbit". That's nice, I suppose!
racial.avianDescription: I'm hesitant to even follow this sign's direction.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. A sign that simply says "ribbit". How useful.
racial.humanDescription: I'm sure this sign leads somewhere awesome. If only I wasn't so busy doing... Other stuff...
racial.hylotlDescription: Bathing in the neon glow of this sign, I am reminded of friends old and new. A lump forms in my throat.
racial.novakidDescription: What the heck does that say?

missing.description: It looks like the word 'croak', but apparently it means something completely different.

racial.apexDescription: A sign saying 'croak'. That's nice, I suppose!
racial.avianDescription: I'm hesitant to even follow this sign's direction.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. A sign that simply says 'croak'. How useful.
racial.humanDescription: I'm sure this leads somewhere awesome. If only I wasn't so busy doing... other stuff...
racial.hylotlDescription: Bathing in the neon glow of this sign, I am reminded of loves lost and found. A lump forms in my throat.
racial.novakidDescription: I don't rightly think I get it.

missing.description: Small ocean creatures swim within this sign.

racial.apexDescription: Could this sign be pointing to an aquarium?
racial.avianDescription: Perhaps this leads somewhere interesting. That would make a nice change.
racial.glitchDescription: Critical. Little fish swim inside the sign. I thought the Hylotl were supposed to care for their fellow creatures.
racial.humanDescription: If this aquarium has a bipedal shark, I am SO IN.

racial.glitchDescription: Observant. There are roots protruding from the ceiling.
racial.humanDescription: These roots look like brown tentacles.
racial.hylotlDescription: How far have these roots travelled? And to what plant do they belong?
racial.novakidDescription: It's just roots.

missing.description: A mysterious symbol.

racial.apexDescription: These symbols are mysterious indeed.
racial.avianDescription: What triggers this mysterious symbol?
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I can't parse the meaning of this symbol.
racial.humanDescription: Strange alien symbol. Odd.
racial.hylotlDescription: I have never seen a symbol like this, not even in books.
racial.novakidDescription: Writing in a foreign tongue. I ain't familiar with it.

missing.description: A mysterious symbol.

racial.apexDescription: These symbols are mysterious indeed.
racial.avianDescription: What triggers this mysterious symbol?
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I can't parse the meaning of this symbol.
racial.humanDescription: I wonder if this actually means anything, or just looks neat?
racial.hylotlDescription: This sigil could signify something.
racial.novakidDescription: Writing in a foreign tongue. I ain't familiar with it.

missing.description: A mysterious symbol.

racial.apexDescription: These symbols are mysterious indeed.
racial.avianDescription: Is this meant to represent something?
racial.glitchDescription: Thoughtful. I wonder if this sigil represents a digit.
racial.humanDescription: If you squint, it kind of looks like a happy face.
racial.hylotlDescription: This sigil could signify something.
racial.novakidDescription: Writing in a foreign tongue. I ain't familiar with it.

missing.description: Deep shadows stretch away from this menacing torch.

racial.apexDescription: This morbid torch provides warmth as well as light.
racial.avianDescription: A rather gruesome torch, if I might say...
racial.glitchDescription: Uncomfortable. I belive this is a real skull.
racial.humanDescription: A skull with flames for hair! Cool.
racial.hylotlDescription: Who would use the dead for this purpose?
racial.novakidDescription: Howdy, buddy.

missing.description: A sinister torch made from old bones.

racial.apexDescription: This morbid torch provides warmth as well as light.
racial.avianDescription: A rather gruesome torch, if I might say...

racial.humanDescription: A skull with flames for hair! Cool.
racial.hylotlDescription: Who would use the dead for this purpose?
racial.novakidDescription: Howdy, buddy.

missing.description: A light which indicates the status of a switch.

racial.apexDescription: The light indicates the status of the switch.
racial.avianDescription: When the light is blue, the switch is on.
racial.floranDescription: Blue light means ssswitch is on.
racial.glitchDescription: Perceptive. A blue light indicates an active switch.
racial.humanDescription: The switch is active when the light is blue.
racial.hylotlDescription: A light to indicate the status of a switch.
racial.novakidDescription: The light goes blue when the switch is hit.

missing.description: Strange organic webbing.

racial.apexDescription: This looks organic in origin. What could have made this substance?
racial.avianDescription: This looks sticky. I wouldn't want it to get into my feathers.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This fluid-like substance was created by something organic.
racial.humanDescription: This stuff smells worse than it looks. What made it?
racial.hylotlDescription: More Floran unpleasantness, perhaps? Or something more than that...
racial.novakidDescription: Like gum stuck to a boot.

missing.description: Used to trap tanks.

racial.apexDescription: A jagged metal shape used to trap tanks.
racial.avianDescription: These nails can stop a tank!
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. A jagged metal shape used to trap vehicles.
racial.humanDescription: This could stop a tank!
racial.hylotlDescription: A jagged metal shape used to trap tanks.
racial.novakidDescription: These nails could halt any ride. Classic.

missing.description: I can't stand on this stone platform for long!

racial.apexDescription: Some kind of pressure sensitive platform.
racial.avianDescription: What happens if I stand on this?
racial.floranDescription: There isss a funny platform here. Should Floran ssstand on?
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. I think this platform was built by someone for some purpose.
racial.humanDescription: A giant pressure sensitive platform.
racial.hylotlDescription: What does this activate?
racial.novakidDescription: I wouldn't want to step on that without knowin' what it does first.

missing.description: This chest is rigged with a sensor that sends a signal when its opened.

racial.apexDescription: A classic treasure chest. Or is it...?
racial.avianDescription: A chest filled with treasure! Or is it...?
racial.floranDescription: Chessst to keep trinketsss or treasures in.
racial.glitchDescription: Excitable. A treasure chest! What could be inside...?
racial.humanDescription: It's a treasure chest. But does it contain a treasure...?
racial.hylotlDescription: A chest created from wood and metal. It looks slightly weathered.
racial.novakidDescription: A treasure chest! It must be my lucky day! Or is it...?

missing.description: A magenta hologram of a palm tree.

racial.apexDescription: This is an impressively rendered tree... But it's unfortunate that holograms can only be a single colour.
racial.avianDescription: A tree that hangs in the air, a formation of light frozen in space! How wonderful.
racial.floranDescription: Floran seesss a tree, but cannot smell it. Sssuspicious.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This tree is made of light, but it has such a sense of presence...
racial.humanDescription: Holographic trees! Who needs to go on a beachside getaway?
racial.hylotlDescription: Artificial depictions of nature are no match for the real thing.
racial.novakidDescription: This is a mighty neat invention!

missing.description: A magenta street lamp post. Not the best colour for visibility, but it sure looks cool.

racial.apexDescription: The colouring of this lamp light puts me on high alert.
racial.avianDescription: This lamp post is rather aesthetically unpleasant, if I do say so myself.
racial.floranDescription: Floran might be able climb post for tactical advantagesss.
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. If this lamp is for streetside  visibility, why is it pink?
racial.humanDescription: Yep, that's a classic street lamp alright. I don't know if the pink light helps visibility, though.
racial.hylotlDescription: Such an inelegant design.
racial.novakidDescription: Lamp posts like this must be a common sight for city slickers!

missing.description: A slick, understated magenta light.

racial.apexDescription: These lights give off a warm magenta hue.
racial.avianDescription: This neon light reminds me of a sunset, shining through diamond clouds.
racial.floranDescription: Pink isss a strong colour! Colour of strong and healthy flower!
racial.glitchDescription: Calm. This light creates a pleasant atmosphere.
racial.humanDescription: neon lights, for when you want to give a room a cool atmosphere.
racial.hylotlDescription: This neon light reminds me of sunbeam filtered through sapphire oceans.
racial.novakidDescription: This light's like a cold burnin' star, though a little smaller.

missing.description: This wall ornament glows with a bold magenta light.

racial.apexDescription: This large neon sign looks particularly well-engineered.
racial.avianDescription: This wall-mounted emblem shines with the colours of a tropical sunset!
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This emblem glows as if it has an inner fire!
racial.humanDescription: This is like the regular Peacekeeper emblem, but... Cooler.
racial.hylotlDescription: This is quite a garish thing.
racial.novakidDescription: Mighty cool wall plaque!

missing.description: A store with an assortment of Neon Peacekeeper furniture.

racial.apexDescription: The individual manning this stall doesn't appear to be a Glitch. Perhaps they are some other kind of automaton?
racial.avianDescription: This store's neon aesthetic sure is intriguing!
racial.floranDescription: Floran thinksss Floran could beat shop perssson in fistfight.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. This shopkeeper appears to be mechanical, but he does not appear to be a Glitch.
racial.humanDescription: This guy doesn't seem to say much, but his shop sure looks pretty cool.
racial.hylotlDescription: If this shop needs to insist it is "cool" then my expectations are already low.
racial.novakidDescription: I sure would like to peruse this here store!

missing.description: This wall ornament glows with a bold magenta light.

racial.apexDescription: A triangle of glass tubing, filled with a neon filament.
racial.avianDescription: This wall light radiates with a calming glow!
racial.floranDescription: Floran wantsss to use wall thing as throwing weapon.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. The design of this wall-mounted emblem is very minimalist.
racial.humanDescription: This wall light definitely makes a room feel cool and ready for parties.
racial.hylotlDescription: What a garish colour.
racial.novakidDescription: I hafta say, I do have a personal preference for anythin' neon and glowin'!

missing.description: A sturdy wooden bed with mooshi hide sheets.

racial.apexDescription: I'm sure these hide sheets keep you warm while you sleep.
racial.avianDescription: Sleeping in leather sheets? I'd much prefer a bed of straw.
racial.floranDescription: A bed made from hunting trophiesss? Floran impresssed, good idea.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. Are these sheets actually made from animal hide?
racial.humanDescription: I... Wonder if this is real animal hide?
racial.hylotlDescription: I can tell that little thought was put into the making of this bed.
racial.novakidDescription: Now this is a bed I can really get some shut-eye in.

missing.description: A wooden chair with mooshi hide cushioning.

racial.apexDescription: This chair is comfortable enough. The animal hide cushions add a little character.
racial.avianDescription: The animal hide cushioning is itchy on the feathers.
racial.floranDescription: Chair ssstill smellss a bit like prey. Good chair.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This chair may look low quality but the hide cushions create a lot of potential comfort.
racial.humanDescription: This couch looks a little itchy to sit on.
racial.hylotlDescription: I'd be reluctant to sit on this chair. The animal hide cushioning doesn't look very comfortable.
racial.novakidDescription: The perfect chair. I'd rest my feet up at a chair like this any day.

missing.description: An old-fashioned standing clock, with a polished brass pendulum.

racial.apexDescription: This fine clock is much higher quality than the mass-produced ones the Miniknog create.
racial.avianDescription: This clock looks handmade. I'm impressed with the woodwork!
racial.floranDescription: Ssswinging metal thing looksss like ssmall axe. Isss this a weapon?
racial.glitchDescription: Charmed. This clock must have taken a lot of care to produce by hand.
racial.humanDescription: This clock has been waiting here, just for me. But I thought time waits for no-one?
racial.hylotlDescription: I must admit that the construction of this clock must have taken a great deal of time. I'm almost impressed.
racial.novakidDescription: This here clock is just tickin' away the hours.

missing.description: A rough wooden coffin. Luckily, no-one's inside!

racial.apexDescription: This coffin isn't the prettiest, but I guess aesthetics don't matter too much when you're dead.
racial.avianDescription: Traditional Avian culture would bury their dead in much grander coffins than this.
racial.floranDescription: Thisss box is right side to hide in. Floran could ussse it for ambushesss...
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. What would happen if you were locked inside this by accident?
racial.humanDescription: I feel like I'd get a splinter from touching this thing.
racial.hylotlDescription: Is this for burying the dead? How... Awful.
racial.novakidDescription: This gives me a pretty morbid feelin'.

missing.description: A wooden door, emblazoned with an iron emblem on both sides.

racial.apexDescription: This wood door has a large, strange symbol on it.
racial.avianDescription: I wonder if the emblem on this door has meaning.
racial.floranDescription: Thiss frontier door is dry and old.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. The different materials come together in an aesthetically pleasing way.
racial.humanDescription: This door has a very shiny handle. I like it!
racial.hylotlDescription: The symbol on this door is not familiar to me.
racial.novakidDescription: Ain't unusual to see doors like this in a frontier buildin'.

missing.description: An old copper and brass furnace.

racial.apexDescription: A rather archaic copper furnace.
racial.avianDescription: I feel like if I get too close to this, it'll singe my feathers.
racial.floranDescription: Thing looksss hot. Floran ssslightly worried.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. I wonder if all these pipes actually serve a purpose?
racial.humanDescription: This old metal furnace is actually quite hot to the touch.
racial.hylotlDescription: This old furnace is very energy inefficient. I can think of several ways to improve it, if I wanted to.
racial.novakidDescription: That smell o' burnin' coal... There ain't nothin' like it.

missing.description: A charming record player, playing an old tune.

racial.apexDescription: The music from this record player inspires something within me. It is an exciting feeling.
racial.avianDescription: This simple device produces music by turning a disc. How fascinating!
racial.floranDescription: Floran likesss music, hides soundsss of Floran being sssneaky.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. This device turns a disc that inexplicably produces pleasant music.
racial.humanDescription: An old timey gramophone! Gather round, children!
racial.hylotlDescription: This music player is surprisingly functional for how simple it is.
racial.novakidDescription: The song this is playin' is a real ace-high toe tapper!

missing.description: A decorative set of brass horns.

racial.apexDescription: This first appears to be a set of mounted horns, but in fact it appears to be artificial.
racial.avianDescription: This artificial set of mounted horns look very polished.
racial.floranDescription: Floran not impresssed with pretend hunting trophy.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. Is this an artificial pair of horns? For what purpose?
racial.humanDescription: An old wall mounted pair of horns... Wait, these aren't actually real horns!
racial.hylotlDescription: Are these an artificial pair of horns? I don't see the purpose.
racial.novakidDescription: These ain't real horns, they're just made to look like they are!

missing.description: A decorative iron symbol.

racial.apexDescription: A wrought iron symbol, for hanging on a wall.
racial.avianDescription: I wonder what this symbolises?
racial.floranDescription: Floran wondersss if hanging thing makesss for effective weapon.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. Does this wall decoration hold any deeper meaning?
racial.humanDescription: I wonder if this symbol means anything, or just looks nice?
racial.hylotlDescription: This wrought iron symbol seems to be decorative, but is rather poorly made.
racial.novakidDescription: This ol' symbol is a surefire sign of folks like me bein' nearby.

missing.description: A hanging gas lamp with a red glass cover.

racial.apexDescription: This brass oil lamp casts a warm red glow.
racial.avianDescription: This lamp gives off a slight perfume smell. Perhaps the oil it is burning is scented?
racial.floranDescription: Hanging red light hasss fire insside. Floran nervousss.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. The metalwork on this brass lamp is rather ornate. It must have been made with care.
racial.humanDescription: This lamp flickers with a soft flame. The red glass cover casts a warm glow!
racial.hylotlDescription: The flickering of this oil lamp is oddly calming.
racial.novakidDescription: Nothin' feels as homely as an ol' oil burnin' lamp lightin' up a room.

missing.description: A wrought iron lamp post with a gas lit flame.

racial.apexDescription: A tough wrought iron lamp post.
racial.avianDescription: A tall wrought iron lamp post.
racial.floranDescription: Floran wantsss to use long lamp as flaming ssspear!
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This is a very tall lamp.
racial.humanDescription: Lamp post, to keep the streets safe at night!
racial.hylotlDescription: This lamp post is made from wrought iron - I'm sure it could withstand a lot.
racial.novakidDescription: Light the way, lamp post!

missing.description: A detailed painting of a beautiful landscape.

racial.apexDescription: A painting of a rather picturesque landscape.
racial.avianDescription: A painting of a beautiful land. I'd like to visit this place!
racial.floranDescription: Floran sssees tiny world. Floran can't go in tiny world. Floran disssappointed.
racial.glitchDescription: Inspired. What a beautiful landscape.
racial.humanDescription: Such a beautiful scene! I wonder what inspired it?
racial.hylotlDescription: This painting is almost to Hylotl artistic standards. I particularly like the river running through the picture.
racial.novakidDescription: This is a mighty fine paintin'.

missing.description: A strange painting of a pulled wagon.

racial.apexDescription: This painting appears to be a green wagon pulled by an animal. I don't get it.
racial.avianDescription: I'm not quite sure what this painting is meant to represent.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. I'm not quite sure why this painting is green.
racial.humanDescription: This appears to be a painting of a wagon, except it is green. I don't get it.
racial.hylotlDescription: I can't discern the meaning of this curious painting.
racial.novakidDescription: This is a mighty odd paintin', I'll give you that.

missing.description: A painting of a proud mooshi against a setting sun.

racial.apexDescription: The mooshi in this painting looks very proud.
racial.avianDescription: What a noble looking beast!
racial.floranDescription: Floran wantsss to hunt tiny prey.
racial.glitchDescription: Inspired. What a majestic beast!
racial.humanDescription: The mooshi in this painting is very majestic for a farm animal.
racial.hylotlDescription: This painting captures an element of majesty in this wild beast.
racial.novakidDescription: That's a mighty fine lookin' mooshi.

missing.description: A huge ornate vault safe.

racial.apexDescription: A huge iron vault. Luckily it isn't locked.
racial.avianDescription: A great iron vault, the kind you'd keep precious things inside.
racial.floranDescription: Floran wantsss to hide in big box.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This vault is so tough I'm not confident I could break into it.
racial.humanDescription: Will I have to become an expert locksmith to break into this? No wait, it's already open.
racial.hylotlDescription: This vault looks quite sturdy.
racial.novakidDescription: A mighty fine place to hide your gold.

missing.description: A brass water pump that used to pump water, back when it was functioning.

racial.apexDescription: An old water pump. It doesn't seem to work anymore, so it is only decoration now.
racial.avianDescription: This pump appears to have stopped working long ago. It's a nice decorative piece, though!
racial.floranDescription: Floran doesssn't see point in thisss thing.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This pump appears to have rusted over long ago. I have no confidence in its continued pumping ability.
racial.humanDescription: This might have pumped water once, but now it's just a prop.
racial.hylotlDescription: Hylotl water pumps would never rust over and break like this.
racial.novakidDescription: An ol' water pump. It doesn't seem to work anymore though.

missing.description: A brass, wood and copper windmill, that spins in the direction of the wind.

racial.apexDescription: This simple windmill will spin in the direction of the blowing wind. A useful indicator.
racial.avianDescription: The propeller on this windmill can tell me the direction that the wind is blowing!
racial.floranDescription: Floran wonders if ssspinning bit could be effective weapon...
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. The propeller on this windmill appears to indicate the direction the wind is blowing.
racial.humanDescription: This old thing has a propeller that spins in the direction of the wind. Neat!
racial.hylotlDescription: This spinning propeller can inform me which way the wind is blowing.
racial.novakidDescription: This here windmill helps show the strength an' angle of the blowin' winds.

missing.description: A novelty cowboy picture stand.

racial.apexDescription: If the intent of this prop is to create an effective disguise, then it is a failure.
racial.avianDescription: Do I stand with my face in the hole to create a picture? How humorous!
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. What is the purpose of this?
racial.humanDescription: A novelty picture stand? Let me put my face behind it, and someone take my picture!
racial.hylotlDescription: This isn't very amusing.
racial.novakidDescription: Yee-haw! If I get behind this, I can look like an ol' gunslinger.

missing.description: An small, sturdy iron safe.

racial.apexDescription: A safe. This would sink easily. For extra security.
racial.avianDescription: While this would keep things secure, why would you need to?
racial.floranDescription: A sssafe. Keepss treasure away from otherss
racial.glitchDescription: Confidence. This is a functioning safe.
racial.humanDescription: I could use this to keep things... Safe.
racial.hylotlDescription: A safe. Useful for security against unwelcome visitors.
racial.novakidDescription: This'll stop those critters touching my loot!

missing.description: A polished bar top, complete with three stools.

racial.apexDescription: The surface of this bar has been polished to a shine. It's no doubt seen a lot of use.
racial.avianDescription: I'm sure all sorts of interesting people have sat at this bar!
racial.floranDescription: Floran thinksss bar might be good place to start fightsss...
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. This bar surface has seen a lot of use, but it's still polished to a shine.
racial.humanDescription: Ah, to sit behind this bar, seeing all sorts of people pass on through... What a life.
racial.hylotlDescription: I'm sure this bar has seen many stains over the years.
racial.novakidDescription: A slick lookin' bar. I'd gladly rest a drink down on this.

missing.description: A drinks cabinet, stocked with glassware and odd-shaped bottles.

racial.apexDescription: A fancy drinks cabinet, I don't see any banana juice though.
racial.avianDescription: A cabinet full of odd-shaped glasses and sweet-smelling liquid.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. The liquid inside these bottles appears to be juice.
racial.humanDescription: A vintage looking drinks cabinet. I'm not sure what's in these bottles.
racial.hylotlDescription: A drinks cabinet. The liquid inside these bottles smells wonderful...
racial.novakidDescription: Good for a boilermaker and his helper! Although I can't see any Prairie Dew...

missing.description: A swinging saloon door to keep those pesky tumbleweeds outside.

racial.apexDescription: An ape walks into a bar...
racial.avianDescription: For all its flapping, this poor door will never fly.
racial.floranDescription: Ssstupid ssswinging thing in Floran'sss way.
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. This 'door' seems to function only as a dramatic signal that someone has entered.
racial.humanDescription: This would very nearly make a better window than a door.
racial.hylotlDescription: One must be prepared for a duel before crossing a doorway such as this.
racial.novakidDescription: Steppin' through one o' these, you'd best be ready for anything.

missing.description: An electric wall sconce.

racial.apexDescription: The glow of this lamp is warm and comforting.
racial.avianDescription: The ironwork surpasses that of Avian spearsmiths.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. Although this lamp is overtly designed to use flammable gas, the light source is electric.
racial.humanDescription: An electric lamp. It looks built for a flame.
racial.hylotlDescription: The lamp appears to be designed to house a flame but is entirely electric.
racial.novakidDescription: A good ol' fashioned wall sconce, though it ain't powered by flame.

missing.description: It's a piano fit for a saloon!

racial.apexDescription: All Apex must learn to play. However, only sanctioned music may be performed. There's a microphone hidden in every piano.
racial.avianDescription: The buttons produce pleasant sounds.
racial.floranDescription: Floran make musssic from ssskin and bone, master of drum. Not sssilly sssound machine.
racial.glitchDescription: Smug. The mathematical principles behind this machine are trivially simple.
racial.humanDescription: A piano... I can play Chopsticks!
racial.hylotlDescription: Ah, music... It has the power to light up even our darkest hours.
racial.novakidDescription: A piano fit for the ol' honky-tonk.

missing.description: An uncomfortable-looking saloon chair.

racial.apexDescription: A wooden saloon-type chair.
racial.avianDescription: A harsh saloon chair with thin red cushioning.
racial.floranDescription: Chair hasss pillow. Floran can sssit.
racial.glitchDescription: Opinionated. Objectively uncomfortable.
racial.humanDescription: Pretty uncomfortable looking, but at least there's a cushion.
racial.hylotlDescription: A small effort has been made to make this comfortable.
racial.novakidDescription: It ain't a saddle, but a seats a seat.

missing.description: A painted wooden sign for saloons.

racial.apexDescription: This old painted sign reads "Saloon". It is self explanatory.
racial.avianDescription: A "Saloon"? This sounds nice!
racial.floranDescription: Floran hasss no time to read ssstuff.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. This sign appears very appealing - I suspect it is meant to draw in customers.
racial.humanDescription: A saloon, eh? Am I in for a bar fight, or merely a game of cards?
racial.hylotlDescription: A crude sign, decorated with cheap peeling paint.
racial.novakidDescription: Now this is just the kind of fine establishment I'm lookin' for.

missing.description: Eughh.

racial.apexDescription: Someone's been spitting into this pot. How uncivilised!
racial.avianDescription: It's full of spit...
racial.floranDescription: Floran doesss not even want to know.
racial.glitchDescription: Nauseous. I regret analyzing this pot's contents.
racial.humanDescription: I'm not sure what I was expecting...
racial.hylotlDescription: Eughh. The inside isn't a pretty sight...
racial.novakidDescription: A good ol' fashioned cuspidor...

missing.description: A richly-stained table fit for an old Western.

racial.apexDescription: This table's littered with playing cards.
racial.avianDescription: There's a bunch of coloured chips scattered across it.
racial.glitchDescription: Amused. A very simple table adorned with gaming paraphernalia.
racial.humanDescription: This table's straight out of the old west!
racial.hylotlDescription: A table designed for playing cards and starting fights.
racial.novakidDescription: A stem-winder! Mighty fine!

missing.description: A dirty-looking glass tumbler.

racial.apexDescription: A small glass for drinking from.
racial.avianDescription: A small drinking glass.
racial.floranDescription: Floran wantsss to see glasss smash.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. A small glass.
racial.humanDescription: A small glass. There's years of chips and scratches on its surface.
racial.hylotlDescription: A small, simple glass.
racial.novakidDescription: This glass looks a little dirty, but I'd still use it.

missing.description: A decorative wooden wagon wheel.

racial.apexDescription: A wheel, possibly from an old wagon.
racial.avianDescription: A wooden wheel. Perhaps it was once part of a vehicle?
racial.floranDescription: Floran doesssn't know purpose of wheel.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I wonder if this was once attached to an actual wagon?
racial.humanDescription: I wouldn't have expected an old wagon wheel to make for good decoration, yet it works pretty well!
racial.hylotlDescription: I'm not quite sure what the purpose of this wheel is. Is it simply decoration?
racial.novakidDescription: The wagon wheel - a mighty fine prop for any dwellin'!

missing.description: A faded poster, offering a bounty from long ago.

racial.apexDescription: I wonder if the subject of this bounty poster was a criminal, or perhaps a heroic rebel?
racial.avianDescription: This bounty poster is very old. I wonder if the criminal on it was ever caught?
racial.floranDescription: Floran likesss picture of impressive hunter.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. This old poster offered a bounty for catching a criminal - I wonder if they were ever caught?
racial.humanDescription: I wonder if the criminal on this old poster was ever caught?
racial.hylotlDescription: This poster is very old now. I wonder if the bounty offered upon it was ever claimed?
racial.novakidDescription: A "wanted" poster? I wonder if they ever caught the perp.

missing.description: Watch out!

racial.apexDescription: Sharp stone spikes.
racial.avianDescription: The stone looks razor sharp.
racial.glitchDescription: Cautious. Sharp rock could penetrate Glitch shell.
racial.humanDescription: I'd better not touch these.
racial.hylotlDescription: I will gracefully avoid these.
racial.novakidDescription: These sure look sharp, I'm ready to hightail it outta here!

missing.description: A wall-mounted screen lit up with lots of blue text.

racial.apexDescription: A screen, displaying what I presume is important information.
racial.avianDescription: The text on this screen is an icy cold blue.
racial.floranDescription: Floran doesssn't care about blue sssign.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. I wonder how much of the text on this screen is actually useful?
racial.humanDescription: An angular screen, complete with infinitely scrolling blue text.
racial.hylotlDescription: The cold blue lights remind me of rippling moonlight on the surface of a river.
racial.novakidDescription: There sure is a lot of information on this. I ain't sure I'd be able to remember it all.

missing.description: A sleek automated door, made from the same materials found on the exterior of space stations.

racial.apexDescription: A sleek metal door. I appreciate its pointed design.
racial.avianDescription: This is a rather well-made metal door!
racial.floranDescription: Door looksss sharp. Floran consssidering door as potential weapon.
racial.glitchDescription: Reminiscent. The angled design of this door reminds me of traditional Glitch banners.
racial.humanDescription: This door could probably take a few hits, to say the least.
racial.hylotlDescription: A rather impressively made door. Surprisingly, I find myself approving of it.
racial.novakidDescription: This here door looks like it could last through a storm or two.

racial.apexDescription: A hologram of a planet and a moon. The quality of the projection is questionable.
racial.avianDescription: A hologram of a planet - a 3-dimensional image made of light!
racial.floranDescription: Floran can't throw blue ball, ball isss not real.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I wonder what planet this hologram is depicting?
racial.humanDescription: I still wonder why all holograms are required to be blue. Is it a stylistic choice?
racial.hylotlDescription: Blue is truly the best colour for holographic projections.
racial.novakidDescription: A floatin' image of a sky blue world.

missing.description: A long industrial looking fluorescent light.

racial.apexDescription: This industrial light is quite large.
racial.avianDescription: This light isn't very nice looking, and the light it casts is cold.
racial.glitchDescription: Informed. These lights each have a compact power source built inside.
racial.humanDescription: Some big fluorescent lights, the kind seen in ships and stations.
racial.hylotlDescription: A large fluorescent light, I wonder if it's waterproof.
racial.novakidDescription: A big ol' electric light.

racial.apexDescription: This medical bed looks like a place I could rest a minute.
racial.avianDescription: Laying on this bed surrounded by these scanners would make me quite uncomfortable.
racial.floranDescription: Fancy lightsss all around this metal bed.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. I wonder if this medical bed can account for Glitch anatomy.
racial.humanDescription: Looks like some sort of medical scanner bed, but I guess it's still a place to lay down.
racial.hylotlDescription: This medical bed was likely designed to assist doctors or researchers.
racial.novakidDescription: Some fancy lookin' bed surrounded by bright lights.

missing.description: A large rotating generator, or radar, or perhaps an engine...

racial.apexDescription: This seems to be an incredibly complex piece of machinery. I wonder what it actually does?
racial.avianDescription: What a delightful machine! I cannot identify its purpose, however.
racial.floranDescription: Floran not sssure what ssspinning thing is.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. This machine appears to be very important, but I cannot identify its purpose.
racial.humanDescription: This piece of machinery is very big and important looking. Does it... Actually do anything?
racial.hylotlDescription: This unkempt machine doesn't appear to do anything immediately useful.
racial.novakidDescription: This certainly looks a splinter more complex than a steam engine, that's for sure...

racial.apexDescription: This industrial looking table looks very solid.
racial.avianDescription: It's a simple table, but it does the job.
racial.floranDescription: Thisss metal table is small and round.
racial.glitchDescription: Unimpressed. This small metal table is unremarkable.
racial.humanDescription: It's a short metal table.
racial.hylotlDescription: This simple metal table looks quite sturdy.
racial.novakidDescription: This round table looks like just the thing for a game of cards.

racial.avianDescription: This sign denotes an electronics station.

racial.humanDescription: A sign which marks an electronics station.
racial.hylotlDescription: Signs like this usually mean there is a nearby electronics station.
racial.novakidDescription: Reckon this sign means there's meant to be an electronics station 'round here.
