racial.apexDescription: This vending machine looks helpful, it could provide some necessary food supplies.
racial.avianDescription: This machine looks like it has some supplies inside, and appears to be in working order.
racial.glitchDescription: Interested. This vending machine seems in working order, it may have supplies.
racial.humanDescription: What luck having this vending machine here, I'm feeling a little hungry.
racial.hylotlDescription: A vending machine, similar to those found inside Hylotl cities.
racial.novakidDescription: This machine is like a robot shopkeeper! I give it money and supplies come out.

missing.description: A panel which is designed to attach to a space structure or ship.

racial.apexDescription: I'm not sure what this panel does, but it's interesting looking.
racial.avianDescription: This panel must have a purpose, I'm just not sure what it is.
racial.floranDescription: Thisss round panel sticks on the wall.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. I'm not sure what the function of this panel is.
racial.humanDescription: This is a panel which attaches to the wall, can't really say more.
racial.hylotlDescription: This industrial looking wall panel has some obscure purpose I'm sure.
racial.novakidDescription: Some sorta fancy wall panel. Dunno what it's used for.

missing.description: A scientific telescope, perfect for observing the stars.

racial.apexDescription: This large telescope may allow me to see objects far away.
racial.avianDescription: A telescope specially made for looking at the stars.
racial.floranDescription: Telessscopes let Floran look closely at the stars.
racial.glitchDescription: Excited. This telescope is the perfect tool for inspecting the stars from afar.
racial.humanDescription: This big telescope looks specially designed for stargazing.
racial.hylotlDescription: Mirrors on telescopes like this have to be very precisely positioned.
racial.novakidDescription: A big ol' telescope, for lookin' at stars.

missing.description: This practice target outputs a wire signal until broken.

racial.apexDescription: This practice target passes wire signal until broken.
racial.avianDescription: Practice targets like this can be connected to wired objects.
racial.floranDescription: Shiny target isss just begging to be broken.
racial.glitchDescription: Interested. This appears to be a practice target, which could be connected to something.
racial.humanDescription: This practice target can pass a wired signal until it's broken.
racial.hylotlDescription: This practice target is hypnotising, breaking it may trigger something.
racial.novakidDescription: Just what I need for shootin' practice. Wonder if breaking this target does somethin'.

missing.description: Place in an enclosed building with at least one door and light source and someone will move in!

racial.apexDescription: If placed in a building with a door and a light it will encourage someone to move in.
racial.avianDescription: This device will invite someone to move into the building. Just make sure there's a door and a light.
racial.floranDescription: Ssscreen to hang on building wall. Makes sssomeone move into home!
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. If placed in a correctly structured building, this colony deed will encourage someone to move in.
racial.humanDescription: These are great for expanding a colony. Place it in a building with a door and a light and someone will move in.
racial.hylotlDescription: If hung in an enclosed building with a door and a light, someone will move in and make it their home.
racial.novakidDescription: With a colony deed someone'll move into the building. Just make sure the building has a door an' a light source.

missing.description: A creature capture pod can be placed into this device, tethering the pet within its radius.

racial.apexDescription: A captured creature can be tethered to this spot.
racial.avianDescription: A handy post that a pet to be tethered to.
racial.floranDescription: Creaturess attached to post ssstay here.
racial.glitchDescription: Satisfied. A captured creature placed in this device will stay nearby.
racial.humanDescription: A tether for a captured creature.
racial.hylotlDescription: Once placed in this device, a captured creature will not wander far.
racial.novakidDescription: A handy tether post for keepin' captured creatures from wanderin'.

missing.description: Spawn your very own Apex villager!

racial.apexDescription: This will let me summon one of my people.
racial.avianDescription: An Apex dispenser. Unusual.
racial.glitchDescription: Philosophical. Do these spawned beings have souls?
racial.humanDescription: Cool, a monkey machine.
racial.hylotlDescription: Why would I want to spawn an Apex?

missing.description: Spawn your very own Avian villager!

racial.apexDescription: I could spawn some Avian friends.
racial.avianDescription: Perhaps I can use this to summon fellow Grounded.
racial.glitchDescription: Pondering. What would Kluex think about this?
racial.humanDescription: Neat, I could summon an army of birds.
racial.hylotlDescription: I suppose summoning an Avian would be okay.

missing.description: Spawn your very own chef!

racial.apexDescription: Will this chef be my slave?
racial.avianDescription: Summoning a chef would be perfect.
racial.floranDescription: Floran get person to cook meatsss!
racial.glitchDescription: Questioning. Is a chef ever truly free?
racial.humanDescription: This is gonna be better than being at McFlorans!
racial.hylotlDescription: I hope this chef respects my sensitive palate.

missing.description: Spawn your very own Floran villager!

racial.apexDescription: Spawning Florans could be a disaster.
racial.avianDescription: I'm not sure I want to spawn Florans.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. I always enjoy interacting with the plants.
racial.humanDescription: Let's get some Florans in here and get the party started!
racial.hylotlDescription: Summoning in some Florans would be a terrible idea.

missing.description: Spawn your very own Glitch villager!

racial.apexDescription: I could build a robot army to take down Big Ape.
racial.avianDescription: Perhaps these Glitch could serve as workers.
racial.glitchDescription: Encouraged. This technology could allow our species to grow exponentially.
racial.humanDescription: One robot butler, coming up!
racial.hylotlDescription: I suppose a Glitch would do well for menial tasks.

missing.description: Spawn your very own guard!

racial.apexDescription: I could do with some extra protection from the Miniknog.
racial.avianDescription: With a guard, Kluex wouldn't dare touch me.
racial.floranDescription: Floran can guard ssself! But more guard not hurt.
racial.glitchDescription: Content. There is strength in numbers.
racial.humanDescription: I've always wanted an entourage.
racial.hylotlDescription: Guards could help me spread peace.

missing.description: Spawn your very own human villager!

racial.apexDescription: A never-ending supply of hairless apes.
racial.avianDescription: What could I possibly want with humans?
racial.floranDescription: Floran not sssure if want to sssummon meat people.
racial.glitchDescription: Concern. I've heard humans are superstitious about this kind of thing.
racial.humanDescription: What sinister devilry is this! Human clones?! Awesome.
racial.hylotlDescription: A human spawner. How delightfully useless.

missing.description: Spawn your very own Hylotl villager!

racial.apexDescription: Spawning Hylotls. Uh... maybe later.
racial.avianDescription: I'll have to take care not to use this too often.
racial.floranDescription: Floran sssummon fishman right into sssword!
racial.glitchDescription: Insincere. A Hylotl gathering would be just wonderful.
racial.humanDescription: Well, I guess one Hylotl wouldn't hurt...
racial.hylotlDescription: What joy! I can finally surround myself with culture again.

missing.description: Spawn your very own wizard!

racial.apexDescription: Surely a wizard could just teleport here.
racial.avianDescription: Magic and science. What a beautiful union.
racial.glitchDescription: Mistrust. The Glitch are not fond of magic.
racial.humanDescription: Maybe I can become this sorcerer's apprentice.
racial.hylotlDescription: Will this spawn a wizard, or yet another charlatan?

missing.description: A station used to obtain employment beacons that call in all kinds of helpers.

racial.apexDescription: I wonder if I can order a freedom fighter.
racial.avianDescription: Such technology is controversial on Avos.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. Such a fair system. No lords and ladies, no paltry peasants.
racial.humanDescription: This is the ultimate evolution of online classified ads.
racial.hylotlDescription: To help another being brings inner peace.

missing.description: This ancient teleporter no longer functions.

racial.apexDescription: This ancient teleporter no longer appears to function.
racial.avianDescription: This dusty old teleporter doesn't appear to work.
racial.glitchDescription: Intrigued. This broken teleporter looks ancient... How old could it possibly be?
racial.humanDescription: This teleporter would take me to unknown lands, if it worked.
racial.hylotlDescription: This teleporter appears to have been broken for some time.
racial.novakidDescription: This ol' teleporter doesn't seem to be workin'.

missing.description: This teleporter should get you back to the Ark.

racial.apexDescription: This looks like it might be linked to the Ark.
racial.avianDescription: This teleporter looks like it might provide a quick route to the Ark.
racial.floranDescription: Thisss might take Floran ssstraight to the ruinsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Analytical. I believe this teleporter is connected to the Ark ruins.
racial.humanDescription: Judging by the look of this teleporter, I'd guess it connects right to the Ark.
racial.hylotlDescription: I believe this teleporter might lead to the Ark ruins.
racial.novakidDescription: A handy way to get back to the Ark and on to the next adventure!

racial.humanDescription: A personal teleporter! Now this is travelling in style.

missing.description: A detailed model of the Sol system's planet Earth, the homeworld of humanity.

racial.apexDescription: Earth, home of the Terrene Protectorate, and myself for a time.
racial.avianDescription: Earth, my second home. I forget it's gone sometimes...
racial.floranDescription: Sssad to remember my time on Earth. Floran missses it.
racial.glitchDescription: Nostalgic. I enjoyed my time on Earth at the academy.
racial.humanDescription: Home... I shudder to imagine what's left of it now.
racial.hylotlDescription: Earth. Such a small planet, yet the hole I now feel in my heart is immeasurable.
racial.novakidDescription: Earth. I tip my hat to ya.

missing.description: A detailed model of the Sol system's largest planet, Jupiter.

racial.apexDescription: It's laughable to think that humans once thought Jupiter a 'large' planet.
racial.avianDescription: Jupiter is quite large compared to Earth.
racial.floranDescription: Jupiter isss a pretty messs of cloudsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Amazed. Jupiter is a relatively small planet by today's standards.
racial.humanDescription: That big old gas planet, still going strong.
racial.hylotlDescription: Jupiter, once a regarded as a giant to so many.
racial.novakidDescription: I've seen bigger.

missing.description: A horizontal chair like a captain's chair on an Earth space shuttle.

racial.apexDescription: It is quite fascinating to simulate the experience of early human space travel.
racial.avianDescription: I can see how this position would have been the most comfortable during take off.
racial.floranDescription: It would be fun to lie down while zooming through ssspace.
racial.glitchDescription: Fascinated. What an ingenious idea to lay down whilst in transit.
racial.humanDescription: What a great design. It still holds up.
racial.hylotlDescription: The idea of piloting a spacecraft in this position is laughable to Hylotl.
racial.novakidDescription: This chair gives a new meaning to laying down on the job.

missing.description: A detailed model of the Sol system's red planet, Mars.

racial.apexDescription: Mars is the fourth planet in the Sol System. It was being terraformed until the Earth was destroyed.
racial.avianDescription: Mars is named after an ancient Earth god of war. It's also known as the 'Red Planet'.
racial.floranDescription: Marsss had many inhabitantsss there until the destruction of Earth...
racial.glitchDescription: Sadness. Mars was a home to many thousands of people. I wonder how they've fared.
racial.humanDescription: Mars had several colonies and thousands of people. It's been evacuated due to the destruction of Earth...
racial.hylotlDescription: Mars was in the middle of major terraforming when the Earth was destroyed...
racial.novakidDescription: Mars had a colony of Novakid wanderers. I wonder if they're still out there...

missing.description: A detailed model of the Sol system's smallest planet, Mercury.

racial.apexDescription: Mercury is the first planet in the Sol System and is gravitationally locked leading to extremely long days.
racial.avianDescription: Mercury, the first planet in the Sol System. Named after an ancient Earth god of commerce known for swiftness.
racial.floranDescription: Sssmall planet in the Sol Sssystem. The closest to the sun. Inhossspitable.
racial.glitchDescription: Fascinated. Mercury's day length is almost 59 Earth-days long and it's year length about 88 Earth-days.
racial.humanDescription: It's the smallest planet in my home system and the closest to the Sun.
racial.hylotlDescription: The planet Mercury. Besides being a Sol System planet it's perhaps best known for a series of horrible mining accidents some decades ago.
racial.novakidDescription: Mercury is a tiny, varmint of a planet in the Sol System.

missing.description: A detailed model of the Sol system's most distant planet, Neptune.

racial.apexDescription: It's Neptune. The Great Dark Spot on it resembles the more well known Great Red Spot on Jupiter.
racial.avianDescription: Neptune is named after an ancient Earth god of the sea and it's moons named after lesser sea gods.
racial.floranDescription: Neptune is the sssecond ice giant in the Sol Sssystem.
racial.glitchDescription: Sadness. A Glitch transport crash landed on Neptune due to a system fault a few years ago. All were lost.
racial.humanDescription: Neptune is the farthest out planet of my home system, the Sol System.
racial.hylotlDescription: Neptune has the Great Dark Spot and the Small Dark Spot. If it had a third spot it would be perfect.
racial.novakidDescription: Legends of a great bandit hiding his ship in the Neptunian clouds persist due to strangely common ship disappearances.

missing.description: A detailed model of the Sol system's dwarf planet, Pluto.

racial.apexDescription: I do not understand the human obsession with this minor and insignificant dwarf planet.
racial.avianDescription: Pluto was named after a god of the underworld in ancient Earth mythology. It reminds me of some similar Avian mythos.
racial.floranDescription: Sssmall dwarf planet with a chaotic orbit on the outskirts of the Sol Sssystem.
racial.glitchDescription: Perplexed. Why do the humans hold Pluto in such high regard? It's not even a planet.
racial.humanDescription: Poor Pluto... You really got knocked down a peg.
racial.hylotlDescription: I learned about this dwarf planet's controversial cultural status in Earth Culture 101 at the Academy.
racial.novakidDescription: Pluto was considered the ninth planet in the Sol System before having it's status revoked. Now it's just a little varmint.

missing.description: A detailed model of an old Earth satellite.

racial.apexDescription: An orbital satellite once used by humans. Quite ingenious.
racial.avianDescription: I wonder what humans used these for.
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. Human technology has always been an inspiration to me.
racial.humanDescription: An old satellite, it doesn't work but it still looks cool.
racial.hylotlDescription: Proof that humans have always been fascinated with communication.
racial.novakidDescription: Glorified space junk.

missing.description: A detailed model of the Sol system's most distinctly ringed planet, Saturn.

racial.apexDescription: Saturn is a gas giant and the sixth planet in Sol System.
racial.avianDescription: Saturn was named after an ancient Earth god of agriculture. Avian culture has a god that's eerily familiar.
racial.floranDescription: Saturn is a gas giant of the Sol Sssystem. The rings the biggest in the system.
racial.glitchDescription: Fascination. The massive planetary rings are composed of small space dust to rocks up to ten meters big.
racial.humanDescription: Saturn is the biggest gas giant in the Sol System. It's rings make it distinct from the other planets there.
racial.hylotlDescription: Saturn's hexagon is another example of nature's unexpected and logical beauty.
racial.novakidDescription: Saturn was home to the first Earth-origin space outlaws. They'd conceal themselves in the rings and rob trade ships.

missing.description: The design of this bed is based on an old Earth space shuttle.

racial.apexDescription: I wouldn't feel safe travelling in a spacecraft like this.
racial.avianDescription: A little piece of human history.
racial.floranDescription: Humansss used to fly around in these.
racial.glitchDescription: Proud. What a long way Humankind has come.
racial.humanDescription: It's nice to look back and remember our roots. Also space shuttle beds are the height of cool.
racial.hylotlDescription: Hylotl have their own relics of early space travel too. We just don't make beds of them.
racial.novakidDescription: Well, looky here. An old masterpiece.

missing.description: A detailed model of Sol, the yellow dwarf responsible for all life on Earth. It even casts light.

racial.apexDescription: The Sun. The centre of the Sol System. It's a yellow dwarf which count as roughly 7.6% of all main-sequence stars.
racial.avianDescription: The star of the Sol System. It's not dissimilar from one of the twin stars of my own home system.
racial.floranDescription: The Sssun. Despite the destruction of Earth it ssstill shines brightly.
racial.glitchDescription: Sadness. I wonder when I'll be able to see the Sun with my own eyes again.
racial.humanDescription: My home star, the Sun. I'll always remember the view from Earth at sunset...
racial.hylotlDescription: The star of the Sol System and a G-type main-sequence star that serves at the accepted interstellar standard for defining solar mass.
racial.novakidDescription: I would stare at the Sun for hours when at the Academy. I'll sure miss that.

missing.description: A detailed model of the Sol System's planet Uranus.

racial.apexDescription: Uranus's axis is tilted an extreme of over ninety seven degrees.
racial.avianDescription: Uranus is named after an earthen god of the sky. The legend pales compared to Avian sky gods.
racial.floranDescription: Uranus is the seventh planet in the Sol Sssystem. It has faint ringsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Fascinated. Uranus is the coldest planet in the Sol System.
racial.humanDescription: Uranus might be named after a god...but it sure sounds funny.
racial.hylotlDescription: Uranus is curious for it's lop-sided axis, making it unique in the Sol System.
racial.novakidDescription: Uranus is an ice giant which are well known for being good at masking the engine emissions of hiding ships.

missing.description: A detailed model of the Sol System's planet Venus.

racial.apexDescription: The planet Venus, covered in sulphur dioxide clouds and by far the hottest planet in the Sol System.
racial.avianDescription: Venus. Named after an ancient Earth goddess of love and beauty.
racial.floranDescription: The planet Venusss of the Sol System. It's the second of eight.
racial.glitchDescription: Fascinated. The planet Venus has natural greenhouse gases that that make the surface temperatures very high.
racial.humanDescription: Venus is the second planet in the Sol System. There was talk of terraforming it before Earth was destroyed.
racial.hylotlDescription: Venus, neighbour to Earth and almost a big but lifeless due to extreme conditions.
racial.novakidDescription: Venus. You could see it from Earth as it travelled the stars. I'll miss that...

missing.description: What's better than a bed? Two beds!

racial.apexDescription: Is the top bed for looking for approaching enemies? I don't understand.
racial.avianDescription: Bunk beds are so useful for shared spaces!
racial.floranDescription: Floran doesssn't like sssleeping so far from ground.
racial.glitchDescription: Worried. I hope that it doesn't collapse while being used.
racial.humanDescription: The bunk bed is a beautiful invention. I'm glad it's stood the test of time.
racial.hylotlDescription: The ingenuity in this furniture is ruined by the crude bedding.
racial.novakidDescription: Me, well I'd prefer to sleep on the top bunk, closer to the stars.

missing.description: An old, hand carved rocking chair.

racial.apexDescription: I think I prefer my furniture to be still.
racial.avianDescription: Hand carved furniture! I can appreciate this.
racial.floranDescription: Floran likesss wood sssmell of curvy chair.
racial.glitchDescription: Worried. A chair that isn't still must be dizzying.
racial.humanDescription: Makes me want to rock back and forth whilst playing the banjo.
racial.hylotlDescription: This is one of the nicer wooden chairs I've seen.
racial.novakidDescription: Rockin' chairs - Even better than standin' chairs.

missing.description: An electric light with a hand-carved wooden stand.

racial.apexDescription: I guess the curved form of this lamp is meant to be appealing.
racial.avianDescription: A rather nice lamp. It could be nicer if it was shaped like a bird.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. If this is wood, how is it lighting up?
racial.humanDescription: I guess this is a modern lamp that's pretending to be old.
racial.hylotlDescription: This seems like a waste of natural resources.
racial.novakidDescription: I prefer gas lights, but this works too.

missing.description: A conspicuous pair of antlers. What kind of creature did these belong to?

racial.apexDescription: Mounting antlers on a wall is a waste of resources.
racial.avianDescription: What a crude display.
racial.glitchDescription: Surprised. Upon closer inspection these antlers appear to be artificial in nature.
racial.humanDescription: Antler ornaments are a classic decoration...I don't know why.
racial.hylotlDescription: Despite clearly being artificial, this is still a crude ornament.
racial.novakidDescription: These antlers are a bit of a brazen display, ain't they?

missing.description: A small, three legged wooden table.

racial.apexDescription: If this was metal instead, it would be sturdier.
racial.avianDescription: A rather nice little table.
racial.floranDescription: Floran wondersss how far Floran could throw thisss.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. This small table will be useful for placing things on.
racial.humanDescription: A small wooden table. All it needs is a book, and maybe a lamp.
racial.hylotlDescription: This small table looks half-finished. Maybe a coat of paint would help.
racial.novakidDescription: I could think of a dozen uses of an ol' thing like this.

missing.description: A quaint metal stove, perfect for cooking.

racial.apexDescription: Sometimes, the simplest methods for heat are the best.
racial.avianDescription: Is this open fire suitable for roasting nuts I wonder?
racial.glitchDescription: Peaceful. The fire is basic, yet calming.
racial.humanDescription: An old fire stove! Does anyone have any marshmallows?
racial.hylotlDescription: This is not the most efficient way to produce heat.
racial.novakidDescription: There's few things I like more than sittin' by an ol' fire.

missing.description: A classic wooden table, suitable for any environment.

racial.apexDescription: It only took four wooden parts to make this. Impressive.
racial.avianDescription: I could carve my name into this, but that would be rude.
racial.floranDescription: Floran would prefer thisss covered in thornsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. This is actually a rather nice table.
racial.humanDescription: It looks like a picnic table. Did anyone bring snacks?
racial.hylotlDescription: I suppose I have seen worse table designs...
racial.novakidDescription: I wouldn't mind playing a round of cards at this here table.

missing.description: A sublime doom bed. It's a bit spiky, though.

racial.apexDescription: A exceptionally nice, comfy bed. Unusually creepy to look at.
racial.avianDescription: This is as good a place as any to rest my feathers.
racial.floranDescription: Floran ressst in great bed with teeth.
racial.glitchDescription: Concerned. The appearance of this bed is unsettling.
racial.humanDescription: A fantastic bed. Should easily be able to get some rest here, as long as it doesn't give me nightmares.
racial.hylotlDescription: Great build quality. I like this. Not so sure about its appearance, though.
racial.novakidDescription: This bed sure is comfy for somethin' so spiky.

missing.description: A comfortable doom chair.

racial.apexDescription: An immensely comfortable chair, even if it is a bit eerie-looking.
racial.avianDescription: A wonderful place to sit, if you can ignore the spikes.
racial.floranDescription: Floran ssit on chair, stroke sspikes and think about hunting.
racial.glitchDescription: Relaxed. This chair is exceptionally comfortable for the Glitch.
racial.humanDescription: A disarmingly soft chair. Reminds me of being at home, with added spikes.
racial.hylotlDescription: Pretty much the luxury Hylotl are used to, if not the design sensibilities.
racial.novakidDescription: This chair sure is comfy for somethin' so spiky.

missing.description: A creepy doom door.

racial.apexDescription: This door is creepy enough to stop anyone trying to break in.
racial.avianDescription: A very eerie door.
racial.floranDescription: Floran hide behind door. Then door scare Floran.
racial.glitchDescription: Nervous. This door has an eye on it.
racial.humanDescription: A fairly terrifying doom door.
racial.hylotlDescription: A robust doom door. It also has an eye on it. Strange design.
racial.novakidDescription: This here door is lookin' at me.

missing.description: A doom light. The eye glows in the dark.

racial.apexDescription: The eyeball casts an eerie glow.
racial.avianDescription: The light appears to follow me wherever I stand in the room.
racial.floranDescription: Floran ssstare at light, and light ssstare back.
racial.glitchDescription: Alarmed. This lamp resembles a giant eyeball.
racial.humanDescription: Whoa, cool. A giant glowing eye.
racial.hylotlDescription: This light has a strange style.
racial.novakidDescription: I don't like the way this light is lookin' at me.

missing.description: A doom console. Be careful how you operate it - it's watching.

racial.apexDescription: This console offers a large degree of control.
racial.avianDescription: A useful console.
racial.floranDescription: Floran push buttons. Make thingsss happen!
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. A single console can control so many different mechanisms at once.
racial.humanDescription: A control console. It's just gotta be played with.
racial.hylotlDescription: A control console.
racial.novakidDescription: I just gotta push that button.

missing.description: A terrifying doom table. It watches you eat.

racial.apexDescription: An eye peers out from under this table.
racial.avianDescription: This table is creepy to sit at.
racial.floranDescription: Floran think this table iss as hungry as Floran.
racial.glitchDescription: Disarmed. Glancing under this table, a giant eye blinks back.
racial.humanDescription: This table is unsuitable for skirt wearers.
racial.hylotlDescription: If you gaze too long into the table, the table gazes into you.
racial.novakidDescription: I ain't sure tables should have eyes.

missing.description: A lavishly decorated bed designed for lounging.

racial.apexDescription: This bed seems better suited for lounging then for sleeping.
racial.avianDescription: This bed looks somewhat similar to an Avian style.
racial.glitchDescription: Relieved. This bed looks perfect for resting on.
racial.humanDescription: This bed looks like it belongs in a museum.
racial.hylotlDescription: This bed was clearly made by a master craftsman.
racial.novakidDescription: Bit fancy for my taste - but it'll do!

missing.description: A golden chair decorated with symbols.

racial.apexDescription: There are some strange symbols engraved on this chair.
racial.avianDescription: This chair looks very impressive.
racial.floranDescription: Metal chair could use some sssoft skinsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Interested. This chair slightly resembles a throne in a Glitch castle.
racial.humanDescription: Seems like this chair wouldn't be very comfortable.
racial.hylotlDescription: This chair seems almost too nice to sit on.
racial.novakidDescription: A fella'd feel real important sittin' on this chair.

missing.description: A decorative crest with colourful wings

racial.apexDescription: Strong bold colours - I like it.
racial.avianDescription: This isn't Avian, but it really speaks to me!
racial.floranDescription: Giant wingsss - a bird like this would mean a great hunt.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. These are not real wings, but a detailed artistic depiction.
racial.humanDescription: A crest with brightly coloured wings.
racial.hylotlDescription: This crest is powerful and striking.
racial.novakidDescription: Think it's art - looks t'me like giant wings.

missing.description: A large ornate oil lamp that burns with a soft blue flame.

racial.apexDescription: A raised wooden torch.
racial.avianDescription: A tall flickering torch.
racial.glitchDescription: Serene. A tall torch, the flame flickers.
racial.humanDescription: A crackling torch.
racial.hylotlDescription: A raised torch provides light for a large area.
racial.novakidDescription: The flame is cracklin' away.

missing.description: An ornamental pillar decorated with gold.

racial.apexDescription: This pillar clearly prioritizes form over function.
racial.avianDescription: This pillar looks like it belongs in a temple.
racial.floranDescription: A tall pillar covered in metalsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. This pillar appears to be purely decorative, and not load bearing.
racial.humanDescription: This fancy pillar looks heavy.
racial.hylotlDescription: A fine example of decorative ancient art.
racial.novakidDescription: Looks like it's from some sorta palace or somethin'.

missing.description: A delicately decorated statue of a small creature.

racial.apexDescription: It looks like this statue is decorated with real gold.
racial.avianDescription: The creature this statue depicts makes me uneasy.
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. The creator of this statue must have admired this creature.
racial.humanDescription: This statue shows lots of respect for this animal.
racial.hylotlDescription: The fine detail in this statue is impressive!
racial.novakidDescription: Well, ain't that a fancy lookin' critter.

missing.description: A heavy table made from wood and gold.

racial.apexDescription: The surface of this table looks very solidly constructed.
racial.avianDescription: This table is clearly intended for an important purpose.
racial.glitchDescription: Confused. It seems the metal on this table serves no functional purpose.
racial.humanDescription: Seems like this table isn't solid good, it's just been covered in a thin layer.
racial.hylotlDescription: This table has been carefully decorated.
racial.novakidDescription: Nice big table, plenty of space for a card game.

missing.description: An executive bed. For the sleep of your life.

racial.apexDescription: The most comfortable bed in the universe.
racial.avianDescription: Once you lie here, you won't want to get up.
racial.floranDescription: Floran sssink into bed, forget about ssstabbing for just a moment.
racial.glitchDescription: Blissful. Truly, there is no better bed than this.
racial.humanDescription: The most fun I've had in bed since I ate cheese before going to sleep.
racial.hylotlDescription: I am speechless with wonder at how comfortable this bed is.
racial.novakidDescription: This has to be the best darn bed I've slept in.

missing.description: An executive chair. You'll never want to stand again.

racial.apexDescription: Sitting in this chair makes all my worries melt away.
racial.avianDescription: Sitting in this chair is enough to make me forget being grounded.
racial.floranDescription: Ssitting is nice in this chair.
racial.glitchDescription: Relaxed. Everyone should have a chair like this.
racial.humanDescription: The ultimate in comfort.
racial.hylotlDescription: A masterfully crafted chair. So comfortable.
racial.novakidDescription: This here chair is great for taking a load off.

missing.description: An impenetrable executive door.

racial.apexDescription: This door is entirely secure.
racial.avianDescription: A totally sturdy door.
racial.floranDescription: Floran hide behind door. Jump out. Ssstab!
racial.glitchDescription: Approving. A flawless door.
racial.humanDescription: An impenetrable executive door.
racial.hylotlDescription: A robust executive door.
racial.novakidDescription: This door sure is swish.

missing.description: A dazzling executive light.

racial.apexDescription: A well-made light source.
racial.avianDescription: This useful lamp will light up even the darkest room.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. A sleek and efficient lamp.
racial.humanDescription: A nice looking, executive lamp.
racial.hylotlDescription: A futuristic looking light source.
racial.novakidDescription: This fancy light sure does impress.

missing.description: An executive console. So exquisite, you can't help but treat it with respect.

racial.apexDescription: This console offers a large degree of control.
racial.avianDescription: A useful console with a large holographic interface.
racial.floranDescription: Floran push buttons. Make thingsss happen!
racial.glitchDescription: Impressed. A single console can control so many different mechanisms at once.
racial.humanDescription: A control console, it's just gotta be played with.
racial.hylotlDescription: This control console has a sleek and stylish design.
racial.novakidDescription: This console sure is somethin', I just wanna use it.

missing.description: A beautiful executive table.

racial.apexDescription: This executive table is exceptionally sleek.
racial.avianDescription: An immensely sturdy executive table.
racial.floranDescription: Table good enough for Floran to ssslice meatsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Approving. A flawless executive table.
racial.humanDescription: A cool executive table.
racial.hylotlDescription: A table that outdoes even Hylotl craftsmanship.
racial.novakidDescription: I could throw some mighty fancy parties with a table like this.

missing.description: A basket full of apples.

racial.apexDescription: Delicious red apples packed with nutrients.
racial.avianDescription: Fine red apples ripened by the sun's blessing.
racial.floranDescription: Too many fruitsss, not enough meatsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Approving. These apples appear to be symmetrical and without blemish.
racial.humanDescription: On closer examination, they're made of wax. Foiled again.
racial.hylotlDescription: A basket of land apples. Not as salty as sea apples, but pleasant nonetheless.
racial.novakidDescription: Can't get much better than a shiny apple.

missing.description: A box of fresh, crusty bread.

racial.apexDescription: These loaves are clearly handmade, nothing like the 'bread' back home.
racial.avianDescription: Finely baked loaves of milled grain.
racial.glitchDescription: Sentimental. These rustic loaves remind me of a simpler life.
racial.humanDescription: I believe that on ancient Earth these were called 'baguettes.'
racial.hylotlDescription: Freshly baked bread is much less enjoyable underwater.
racial.novakidDescription: Can't beat freshly baked bread.

missing.description: A sturdy kitchen cabinet.

racial.apexDescription: This kitchen cabinet looks lovingly hand crafted.
racial.avianDescription: This rustic cabinet is tastefully understated.
racial.floranDescription: Floran will fill cabinet with tasssty foodsss!
racial.glitchDescription: Satisfied. A well-crafted kitchen storage system.
racial.humanDescription: A quaint kitchen cabinet, just like in Grandma's house.
racial.hylotlDescription: The simple appearance of this cabinet belies the quality of its craftsmanship.
racial.novakidDescription: A handy kitchen cabinet fit for practical country folk.

missing.description: A tall, sturdy kitchen cabinet. Perfect for storing tableware and food.

racial.apexDescription: This kitchen cabinet looks lovingly hand crafted.
racial.avianDescription: This rustic cabinet is tastefully understated.
racial.floranDescription: Floran will fill cabinet with tasssty foodsss!

racial.hylotlDescription: The simple appearance of this cabinet belies the quality of its craftsmanship.

racial.hylotlDescription: The simple appearance of this cabinet belies the quality of its craftsmanship.

missing.description: A nice kitchen shelf that keeps spices handy.

racial.apexDescription: These ingredients look delicious!
racial.avianDescription: This shelf looks perfect for a sunny kitchen.
racial.floranDescription: Tiny plant isss better than no plant!
racial.glitchDescription: Curious. Is this plant intended to be decorative, or an ingredient?
racial.humanDescription: I hope someone's been watering this plant...
racial.hylotlDescription: This little kitchen shelf keeps clutter out of the cooking area.
racial.novakidDescription: Makes me wanna cook up somethin' tasty!

missing.description: A sturdy kitchen cabinet with a stove top.

racial.apexDescription: This cooking surface isn't quite standard issue, but I like it.
racial.avianDescription: A humble but well-made stove top.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. A well-ordered cooking area for a rustic kitchen.
racial.humanDescription: A lovely little stove top for a cosy house.
racial.hylotlDescription: This kettle sings a comforting note, inviting me home.
racial.novakidDescription: A nice lil' range for a cosy home.

missing.description: A rustic kitchen table.

racial.apexDescription: No frills, just a well-made kitchen table.
racial.avianDescription: Whoever made this kitchen table intended it to last.
racial.floranDescription: Nice ssstrong table for holding heavy meatsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Observant. A solid kitchen table that would look at home in any village.
racial.humanDescription: Yep, I could eat off of that.
racial.hylotlDescription: This kitchen table's thick planks blend form and function nicely.
racial.novakidDescription: It ain't anything fancy but I'd take this table any day.

missing.description: A strong geometric bed.

racial.apexDescription: A very nice, comfy bed.
racial.avianDescription: This is very comfortable place to rest my feathers.
racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. This bed looks exceptionally comfortable.
racial.humanDescription: A great bed. Should easily be able to get some rest here.
racial.hylotlDescription: Very decent build quality. I like this.
racial.novakidDescription: Now this is a good place to rest my weary head.

missing.description: An exceptionally comfortable geometric chair.

racial.apexDescription: A very comfortable chair. I'm happy with it.
racial.avianDescription: A highly decent place to sit.
racial.floranDescription: Floran sssit on chair and think about hunting.
racial.glitchDescription: Relaxed. This chair is exceptionally comfortable for the Glitch.
racial.humanDescription: A very soft chair. Reminds me of being at home.
racial.hylotlDescription: Almost the luxury Hylotl are used to. There's plenty of satisfaction to be gained here.
racial.novakidDescription: A darn good place to have a rest.

missing.description: A geometric door. Sturdy!

racial.apexDescription: A sturdy door.
racial.avianDescription: A sturdy door.
racial.glitchDescription: Calm. A very strong door.
racial.humanDescription: A strong, awesome door.
racial.hylotlDescription: A simple yet strong door.
racial.novakidDescription: This door sure is sturdy.

racial.glitchDescription: Pleased. A robust lamp.

racial.avianDescription: An immensely sturdy geometric table.
racial.floranDescription: Table good enough for Floran to ssslice meatsss.
racial.glitchDescription: Approving. A very well-made geometric table.
racial.humanDescription: A cool geometric table.
racial.hylotlDescription: Not usually my kind of table, but this is rather impressive.
